kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadmigs rim gyi ngo ṭo tsam dgod na/ sgrub pa po gang gis/ gnas/ yo byad/ 'dug stangs sogs rnal 'phyor dag rim ltar sga tsho ga'i dmigs rim ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhe snang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag ces sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ tsho ga'i tshig ris ltar byas la/ dmigs rim ni sbyor 'byung lus rags pa la btags pa'i nga dang / shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems la btags pa'i nga gnyis yod kyang / 'dir ni de gnyis so sor mi 'byed par phung 4 la btags pa'i nga la dmigs nas rang nyid 'od gsal du 'jug /'od gsal de'i ngang las rang gi go sar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmag me rlung gnyis sed bden bral ljang] dbang ldan nag /lte ba ljang] ge sar ser ba/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan dmar gamil le ba/ shel gyi maṇ+ḍal kha sbrubs pa lta bu/ pad 'dab kyi phyed tsam non pa la nyi dkyil dang 'dab ma'i bar nas ge sar ser tsig ge cung zad thon pa/ de'i steng du 'od sngon 4 khra gang ba zhig bsam la/ de ltem gyis zhu ba las/ chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du skad cig gis zhe snang rdo rjer bskyed/de yang 'dir zhe snang rdo rje ni cung zad khros pa'i rnam pa can sku mdog ldo sangs tsam yang min/nag 4'ang min par rdzo la nag shas che ba/ gzhal gyi sku mdog mthing nag cud zad khos pa'i rnam pa can/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa spyan hu re ba g.yas zhal shel ltar dkar ba/ zhi ba'i nyams can spyan zim me ba/ ga'adzin zhal byi ru ltar dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams can zhal 'dzum pa/ dbu gsum ka'ang dbu thod gcig pa la 'bur 4 gsum dod kyi rnam pa can/ mgrin pa'ang ༷ spri ༷ shā | /shā smo ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭī ṭ+wāṃ sh+lau twā 3sgyu spri ṭ+wāṃ /༷ khri n+dhi khri/ sne ṭ+wāṃ /spyaX two g.yas g.yon gnyis su rdo rje rtselnga pa dag gi bar bar du mu tig gi phreng ba dmar pos ku ru 8
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyedarim khrid kyi zin bris/kha'i tshul du bcings pa la dra ba dang dra phyed gshor lo'i steng du nyil te slebs pa/ de yang rked dkris gong ma gong ma'i rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed 'og ma 'og ma la slebs pa/ dbu gsum re re'i lteng du sangor lo rtsibs brgyad pa re/ gzhal gyi mdun steng du rtsibs gsum/ snyan g.yas g.yon gyi steng du rtsibs re re/ rgyab tu rtsibs gsum/ delangadabu skradang lusar lo gcig gis gcig mi sgrib par chu nang gi rje'u dang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal bar mthong ba/ dbu re re'i steng gi mdun gyi rtsibs dbus ma'i steng du mi bskyod pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi rtsibs steng du rnam snang dang] rin 'byung snyan g.yas g.yon gyi rtsibs steng du 'od dpag med dang] don grub bskyed/ de yang rin po che'idabu rgyan gyi mtha' gser gyi pa ṭa ris kyis bskor ba la/ dbus su sangs rgyas rigs lnga po 'bur dod kyi tshul gyis bzhugs shing dwangs gsal can/ pangor lo'i rtsibs nas 'phyang ba'i mu tig gi dra ba khug pa gnyis sbreladangaka dra phyed gsum sbrel rtsemor dril chung g.yer kha 'phyang ba/ ye shes kyi spyan yan chad nyil gyis khebs pa/ rin 4 che'i snyan rgyan ni/ rgyu gser las byas pa dbyibs zlum 4 rdo rje rtselnga pa rtogs ldan bzang po'i dung lung lta bus mtshan pa/ snyan gong ni rin 4 che gser gyis bsnams pa'i sne mor mu tig gi chun 4 'phyangs pa/ ut+pala'i gdengs ka ni rgyab nas yu ba dang mgo 4 snyan gong du thon nas mdun ngos su phyogs pa/ ut+pala'i yu ba'i mtshams nas kha dog sna lnga'i dar dbyangs snyan gyi rgyab nas 'phyangs pa/ dbu rgyan 'di rnams ni dbu gsum ka la mtshungs so/ /spyan dkyus ring ba/ shangs dkyus mtho ba/ tshems bzhi bcu tshangs pa sogs mtshanadang dpe byad rnamasani sangs rgyas gzhan dang mtshungs sesna/ /mgul rgyan nidabus su mgrin pa'i rtsa'akhor mtshon pa'i rdo rje rtsemo bcu drug pa byas nas g.yas g.yon du rdo rje rtsegasum pa dag gi bar bar du mu tig gi zeng ba brgyad sogs kyis ku ru kha'i tshul du sbrel ba la nor bu'i zeng ba mang pos do shal 9
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadang do shal phyed pa'i tshul du 'phyangs pa mgul ba gshor tsam/ se mo do ni snying ga'i rtsagashor mtshon pa'i rdo rje 〉brgyad pa gnyis mdun rgyab tu 'ongs pa la mu tig gi zeng ba sum sbrel zag ba g.yas g.yon du se ral kha byas pa/ dpung rgyan ni dpung par rdo rje rtselnga pa'am rtsegasum pa gang rung gi bar bar du mu tig gi zeng ba mang 4 sbrel ba la mu tig gi dra bdang dra phyed phyag zur du 'greng ba'i sor po'i ngos la 'phyangs ba/ gyen du 'greng ba'i dpung pa'i ngos la 'phyangs par bsam/ phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub sogs dbyibs dbung rgyan dang 'dra la/ zhabs kyi long bu'i mtshamasanas/ rin po che'i rgyanadapung rgyan ltabu la dra ba dra byed badrangos la 'phyangs pa/do shal ni lha drag 4 'ga' zhig la/ mi man rlon pa rnying pa skam 4 gsum gyi phreng ba 'ongs pa dang mtshungs par rin 4 che'i phreng bdakaradamar mthing gsum ring zung du byas pa'am/ yang na rin po che sna tshogs spel ba'i phreng ba lta bu brla'i bra sgom mtshams dang mgor gon pa/ 'og pags ni lte ba'i rtsagashor mtshon byed dudabus su rdo rje 〉mo drug cu rtsabazhis mtshan pa la bar bar du mu tig gi phreng ba mang pos bskor ba sbrel ba la dra ba dang dra phyed sngar bshad pa lta bur 'phyangs pa/ ring zung langs na rkang mgor slob pa/ skyel krung bcas pa'i nyi gdan gyi lteng du khochil le khebs pa/ spyi 4/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba'i rtsagashor rnams mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i rwa grangs ni phyogs rwa'i rwa grangs yin no/ /stod g.yogs lha rdzas kyi dar las grub pa la/ dbyibs ras 'gags lta bu'am serdzog po'i 〈snas kyi 47nga ba lta shu la rgyan sna tshogs yotshod pa/ smad ga〈snags ni rgyu lha rdzas kyi dar las grub ba/ dbyibs ni rgyab mdun gnyis leb chags pa/ g.yas ga' na gyi sul mang ba rtogs ldan bzang po'i smadagayogs ltabu/de yang lha rdzas kyi gos kyi khyad par ni/ bzung na sen mo gang ba/ btang na nam mkha' 'gengs pa yin/ phyag drug gi gyes tshul ni/ sog pa'i dkar yol kha gcig gi nang du dpung 10
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin brigmgo gsum steng 'og byas nas 'on pa'i phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtselnga pa/ gnyis pas dngor lo jibs brgyad ba lte ba zlum 4 la rtsibs brgyad kyi mthar mu khyud yod cing rtsibs so so'i thad kyi mu khyud kyi phyi rol tu rtsibs sne cung zad thon pa la rin 4 ches brgyan pa/ yu ba sor bzhi pa la rdo ñdza rtselnga pa pyed pas mtshan pa/ gsum pas badra 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba ge sar yu ba dang bcas pa/ de yang pad+ma dang ut+pala'i khyad par ni/ nyi ma dang zla bas 'byed pa ma gtogs kha dog sna tshogs 'ong zhing / lha mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan gyi skabs su pad+ma dang] lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan gyi skabs su.ut+pal bshad/ g.yon gyidang pos dril bu dang] gnyis pas rin chen 'bar ba'am cha dgu pa la yu ba sor bzhi pa rdo rje rtselnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa/ gsum pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa'i yu ba'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi gdan gyi dbus nas thon pa'i ral gri yongs grags lta bu'o/ /yab yum gnyis sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan gzhan 'dra ba la/ yum gyi dbu skra phyed bcings ni/ phyed nas bkug pa ltag par bcings pa'i lhag mas sku stod khebs pa sga yab yum gnyis gcig gis gcig la spyan zur gyis gzigs pa sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga'i dga' bas rol tshul ni/ gzugs bzang ba/ skad snyan pa/ sku lus la bro ba'i dri dang / ma mchu dang ljags kyi ro mngar ba/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad la reg bya 'jam pa ste/ 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pas dgyes pa bskyed pa/ de yang sbyi bo'i dngor lo dbu rgyan dang bcas pa mi bskyod pa'i ngo rgyo dang / snyan rgyan 'od dpag med kyi ngo 4 dang / mgul rgyan rin 'byung gingo 'o dang / phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu ni rnam snang gingo 'o/ 'og pags ni don grub kyingo bo/ se mo do ni rdo rje 'chang gi ngo 4 ste/ rigs drug po de dang de rgyan drug po de dang der shar bar bskyed/ phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje ni mi bskyod pa/ dngor lo ni rnam snang] pad+ma ni 'od dpag med/ g.yon gyi dril bu ni rdo rje 'chang / rin 4 che ni rin 'byung] ral sgra ni don grub kyi ngo 4 lte/ rigs drug po de 11
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kharnams phyag mtshan drug po der shar bar bsam/ de nas rdor dril byin rlabs ni/hril te dril na/rdor dril 'dzin pa'i tshe/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi thabs kyi cha rnams rdo rjes mtshon/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi shes rab kyi cha rnams dril bus mtshon pa'i don dran par byas nas/ deng nas bzung ste zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang ma thob kyi bar du thabs dang shes rab 'de rnams bzung bar bya zhing /de gnyis kyang bde stong dbyer med pa'i byang sems kyi rang bzhin no snyam ba'i sgos rdor dril 'dzin cing/ rdor dril gyi sngags don bskyed rim ltar bsam pa'i sgo nas brjod/nang mchod byin rlabasani/ las sngags brjod padang dus mnya5 du rang gi snying ga'i tingasnga 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne las nges don gyi bgegs mthar byed bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de drangadon gyi bgegs mthar byed lhasku bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba dpag tu med pa spros nas bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam/ shu n+ya ta'i sngags brjod pa dang dus mnya5 dunang mchod kyi rdzas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du hūṃ sngon po gyen 'grengangam nyal stabs mgo 'o pyir bstan zhabs kyu tshur la bsnyan pa/ de'i steng du yo sngon 4 gyen 'grengangam nyal stabs/ de'i steng du hūṃ gron ponang de ltabur bskyed/ yo 'od du mer gyis zhu ba las rlung gi dkyil gshor gron 4 zla ba phyed pa lta bu zla gam tshur la bstan pa/ steng 'og gi hūṃ gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje gron ṭo rtselnga pa nyal stabs su steng 'og gi phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/ gyen 'greng du mchog gnyis su rlung ngos la sbyar ba'i tshul gang rung bsam/ yang de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ hūṃ gsum 4 nyal stabs dang gyen 'greng sngar bshad pa ltar de'i steng du rngadamar 4 zhu ba las medakyiladamar po zur gsum pa/ zuragacig tshur la bstan pa/steng 'og gi hūṃ gnyis zhu ba las rdo rjedamar 4 nyal ltabs su gnas pas/ me dkyilade'i steng 'og gi phyogs gnyis brgyan 12
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyizin brigpa'am/ gyen 'greng la mtshog gnyis mtshan pa/ me dkyil de'i zur mdun ma la oṃ/ g.yas pa la ātshan〈snan pa la hūṃ/ de gsum zhu ba las mi mgo rlon pa bcad ma thag pa lta bu/ skras dbral ba yan chad khebs pa kha phyir la bstan cing / ltag pa dbus su bstan pa'i skyed bu gsum du rgyudde gsum gyi steng gi bar snang la āXlas byung ba'i 'od pa pyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du baṃ gcig zol gyis byung / de zhu ba las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du ā.a mtshan pa/ pad+ma de'i steng gi dbus su hūṃ sngon po gyen 'greng] shar ram mdun gyi gdab mar r+ghaṃ dkar 4 gyen 'greng lho'am g.yas kyi 'dab mar yaṃ ser po gyen 'greng] nub bam rgyab kyi 'dab mar dzo dmar po gyen 'greng] byang ngam ga'angan gyi 'dab mar khaṃ ljang khu gyen 'greng/ de rnams zhu ba las sha lnga bskyed pa yin la/ de yang 'dir mi sha bam ril lta bu byas na dmigs pa mi bde bas/ mi sha tshang ma hrum hrum pa byas pa'i steng du hūṃ gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ de bzhin du shar gyi 'dab mar glang 4 che'i sha tshul de ltabu la rgyudakar ṭo gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ lho'i 'dab mar rta'i sha tshul de ltabu la steng du oṃ gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar ba glang gi sha tshul de lta bu la dzo gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ byang gi 'dab mar khyi'i sha tshul de ltabu la khaṃ gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ bdud rtsilnga gshegs mar bskyed pa ma rgyud kyi lugs la yod kyang] 'derade lnga gshegs par bskyed payin pas dbus su hūṃ zhu ba las dri chu bskyed/ de yang shadang dri chu gnyis gcig gis gcig mi sgrib pa/ mar khu'i nang du sha bcug pa'i tshul du bskyed pa'i steng du hūṃ gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa byed/sha lnga dngaka bdud rtsilnga mtshan pa'i sa 'on gnyis gnyis bsgrigasanas gyen du 'grengawend pa/ sa 'onang ro can rnams ni zla tshes thig le nadadang bcas pa dgos pa ni gong 'og kun tu mtshungs so/ /shar du rgyu zhu ba las dri chen lteng du hūṃ gyen 'greng gis mtshan pa/ gzhan rnams la'ang 'dra/13

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khate/ rang rdo rje 'chang dkar 4 la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi dbus kyi gtso bo'i zla gdan yang nyi gdan du gyur pa'i stengan rang mi bskyod pa drag 4 zhe snang rdo rje sku mdog maring nag cung zad khros pa/ bzhad pa dang 'dris pa'i nyams la mche ba cung zad gtsigs nas spyan yang cung zad hur re ba lta bu'i mazhal nag 4 drag 4/ g.yas zhal dkag g.yon zhal dmag phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang 4 na khro bo'i rdo rje rtsedagu pa 'edzin pa lte/ lhag ma'i phyag mtshan rgyanan bza' sngar bshad pa lta bu la 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba tsam ma yin par 'od dmar 4 gzi bajid shin tu 'bar zhing / de yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams su zhakhrug cing dbyil ba'i dbus na yum sngar gyi rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang rgyug ma dkar mo yang reg bya rdo rje ma sngar bshad pa lta bur gyur pa dang / snyoms par zhugs pa semasadapa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can du bsam la/ denas kho so bcu ni mngon rtogs kyi tshig ris ltar gyi zhal phyag phyag mtshan can rnams rim pa bzhin yum gyi thugs ka nas gsang gnas su phabs/ de nas rang gi gsang gnas brgyud de snying gar drangs/ 'byin sngags kyis zugs ka nas phyir phyung ste/ shar sogs phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi steng du rang rang gi gdan la g.yon brkyangs kyis zhal nang la bstan nas rim pa bzhin bkod la/ snying gi kho 4 steng gi rtsibs kyi nang gi rang gi gdan gtso 4 las cung zad mdun du yol ba de la g.yon brkyangs kyis zhal gtso bo'i rgyab la gzigs pa dang] gnod mdzes ni 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang gi rangagi gdan gtso bo'i gdan las cung zad rgyab la phyogs par gnas pa/ de la g.yon brkyangs kyis gtso 'odang zhal gaphyogs mthun par bkod la/ khro bo'i cha lugs rgyan 〈snags lhag ma tshig ris ltar go sla la/ sprul gyi rgyan ni 'jigs byed yin na lha yang shin tu khos pa'i nyams che ba bzhin rgyan gyi sprul yang khrosanas phud kyi sgra sgrogs pa dang] zhal gdangasanas mche ba gamigs pa la lce gnyis g.yo ba can byed/ 'dir 'dus pa'i lha rnams ni zhi ba'i nyams gtso 'o yin pas 26

spel ba'i 'dab ma bcu drug yod pa/ phyogs bzhi bsdoms na 'dab ma drug cu re bzhi pa sto ba ljang khudangad ge sar ser po dang ldan pa/ 'dab ma'i phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar cha chung brgyad cu gya bzhi pa/ lte ba'i phyi mtha'anas phyi mtha'i bar cha phran brgyad cu yod pa/ de'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po mgodakyil lubor gyi nub phyogs su bstan nas nyal ba/ de'i steng du yo ldon po gyen 'greng] de'i steng du hūṃ sngon 4 sngar bshad pa ltabu/ de zhu ba las yo dang / yo yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung gi dkyil dngor sngon po/zlagam gzhalalas khang gi shar phyogs la bstan pa steng 'og gi hūṃ gnyis 〈snangs su gyur pa las rdo rje gron pos sngar ltar brgyan pa/de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ hūṃ gsum sngar bshad pa ltar bskyed pa zhu ba'i raṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ me dkyil dmar 4 zur gsum pa'i zur gcig gzhal yas khang gi mdun dang] zur gzhan gnyis phyi la bstan pa'i steng 'og tu sngar bshad pa lta bu'i rdo rje dmar po nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ dkar po nyal stabs/ de'i steng du baṃ dkar so gyen 'grerdza/ de'i steng du hūṃ dkar 4 nyal stabs su gnas pa rnams zhu ba las/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil paltar zlum po steng 'og tu rdo rje dkar 4 rtselnga pa nyal ltabs kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ ser 4 ltar stabs/de'i steng du paṃ ser 4 gyen 'greng/de'i steng du hūṃ ser 4 nyal stabs/ de rnams zhu ba las/ laṃ las sadakyil ser po gru bzhi pa/ steng 'og tu rdo rje ser 4 rtselnga pa nyal ltabs kyis mtshan spru/ spyan sogs bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'idakyil gshor bzhi so gcig tu 'dris pa sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa'i lte ba sngon po gru bzhi pa pyi mtha'anas pyi mtha'i bar la sgo tshad bcu gnyis sam cha 32
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khridakyi zin brigphran bzhi bcu rtsabargyad yod pa/ dpangs la rwa gsum ma ltar na sgo tshad gcig yod/ rwa lnga pa'i lugs la dpangs la sgo tshad lngane'od/ rwa'i kha dog la saṃ bhu ṭa ltaran shar gyidabus rwa rnam snang gi mdog tu byas nas rwa steng ma sngon 4/ kha nang lta'i g.yas rwa ser 4/ rgyab rwa dmar po/ g.yon rwa ljang khur byed pa dngaka yang na shar rwa rnams dkar po/ lho rwa rnams ser po/ nub rwa rnams dmar 4/ byang dwa rnams ljang khur byed pa yod kyang / bshad rgyud lung ston dgongs pas/ phyogs bzhi spru'i rwa rnams kyi dbus rwa rnams ldon 4/ steng rwa dkar 4/ g.yas rwa ser 4/'og rwa dmar 4/g.yon rwa ljang khur byed de/ rwa dbus ma la g.yas su bskor ba'i rim bzhin phyogs kyi rwa bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang bya'o/ /rwa rnams kyi srid sgo tshad bzhi yod cing dbus rwa'i rtsab cha phran gsum/ dkyil gyi slom la sgo tshad gcig /rtsemor cha phran gcig yod pa/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams 'gro ba snying rjes mi gtong ba mtshon pa'i brdar chu smin gyi kha nas thon par bya la/ de rnams kyi rtsaba thon pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba cha phran brgyad dam snyo tshad gnyis nang la dor ba'i mtshams nas rwa'i phyidangaka ga phran drug gi mtshamasanas rwa'inang mtha' 'ongs pade rnams guganasadabus rwa'i srid kyi cha phran gnyis phyi la bzhag pa'i mtshams su zug pa ga sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rgyudakar po sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i tshogs rnams 'od zer du 'phyos pas sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i rgya khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba/ de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad 〈snangs su rdzogs pa cig char grub pa rim gyis gsal gdab la/ gru bzhi pa 〈sna bzhi pa rtsig pa mi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang gro ba ste/ rim pa re re'i srab 'thug cha phran re'i lnga cha yod pa/ rtsig pa lnga ka bsdoms pa'i zheng la cha phran gcig yod pa/ rtsig pa'i nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha phran so gnyis sam sgo tshad brgyad/ rtsig pa'i 'og nas steng gi bar la cha phran bcu gsum 〈snad pa rtsig pa lnga'i rgyun shar gyi sgo 'o(gas g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ byang gi sgo 'ordzogs 33
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khag.yon pa'i bar du 'gro la/ sgo logs g.yas g.yon gyi bar du rtsig rgyun med pa'i har sgo yin pas rtsig pa dum bu bzhi ma 'brel ba yin/ sgo logs kyi jig pa lnga ka dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba kha cha da duphund pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin 4 che'i pha gu dpangs la ga phran gcig zheng la cha phran phyed gnyis yod/ cig pa la phyed 'byar gyi tshul du yod pa/ rin 4 che zur gsum padang/ gru bzhi pa zlum 4 zla gam la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng du lda'i ka chung phyi nang / ka chung re re'i steng du mu tig dmar po'i bre re re/ de'i steng du baiḍūr+ya'i gzhu re re/ gzhu re re'i steng gi mtshog ma gnyis su shel gyi ka chung gnyis gnyis/ shel kyi ka chung re re'i steng du sprug gi bre chung re re/ de re re'i steng dudangul gyi gzhu re re/ tshul de lta bu'i pha gu'i steng du rtsig rgyun gar mutsho bar du bya la/ cha phran phyed tsam doranas lda'i ka chung lhag ma rnams 'phred la bsgrigs pa'i steng du gser gyi ska rags leb mo rtsig rgyun gar 'gro'i bar du btang la/lda'i ka ba nas steng gser gyi ska rags khyon bsdoms pa'i dpangs la cha phran phyed re yod pa/ tshul de lta bu'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi ka gcig steng du gcig brtsegs yod pa/ gser gyi ska rags bzhi ka bsdoms pa'i dpangs la cha phran gnyis/ rngams zheng rtsig pa'i zheng dang mnyam pa byas la/ zur rnams su phyi nang du rdo'i ka ba/ mu tig dmar po'i n+d+ra/ steng du baiḍūr+ya'i gzhu bsnol ma/ gzhu bsnol de'i mchog ma bzhi ru shel gyi ka ba re re/de'i steng du sprug gi bre re re/ de'i steng du dngul gyi gzhu re re ma de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags grwa bzhi can sga gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i steng du lcam sne phyi ma bkal/ lcam sne nang ma ni tshangs thig gathig 'phrad mtshams nas nang du sgo tshad gcig 'ongs pa'i mtshams nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga lngador mtshams su shar du zhagar los mtshan pa'i ka bdakar 4 gnyis/ lhor rin po ches mtshan pa'i ka ba ser ṭo gnyis/ nub tu pad+mas mtshan pa'i ka ba dmar po gnyis/ byang du ral sgras mtshan pa'i ka ba ljang khu gnyis/ ka ba gdung dang bcas pa'i dpangs 34
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/la cha phran bcu drug yod de/ ka ba de dag gi steng gdung ring phyogs bzhir thal mar btang ba'i sne mo gser gyi ska rags la bkal/ gdung re re la cha bran so bzhi re yod/ 'og ngos la rdo rje dang 'khor 'o( zungags kyi ri mo mang 4 bri/ 'ar ka ba la dngor lo sogs gyi ri mos mtshan pa/rdul sgarab las ka ba grub pa'i chanas dedagagis mtshon bar byed pa yin gsungs/ shar du lcam dkar po nyi shu rtsabargyad/ de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang du yang phyogs mdog can sgya lcam nyi shu rtsabargyad re/ de'i lteng du dral ma rtsig dam rnams kyang phyogs mdog/rdul phra rab tshun chad dngor lo dang rin 4 chedang pad+ma dang ral ris mtshan pa can gye pyi khyams gru bzhi 'bubs lugs 〈sna/ /sgo khyud dang sgo 'gram gyi mtshams su sgo'i ru bzhi sgo glegs dang bcas pa'i sgo glegasanang sdom phye tshe phyir gyes 'gro ba/ sgo'ilpu them gyi steng du dngor po'i phreng bdakyus su gsum bsgrigs pa tshar gnyis steng 'og tu brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du gdung srid du cha phran drug pa rngams zheng cha phran gcig pa/ sne g.yas ga'angan gyi 〈sna khyud kyi rtsig pa la bkal ba / de dag gis sgo phub pa'i lho sgo'i them steng du rin 4 che'i phreng ba gnyis bsgrigs/ nub tu pad+ma'i phreng ba gnyis bsgrigs/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis bsgrigs/ sgo logs kyi nang gnyis su ka ba cha phran bcu drug pa rags rtsis/gnyis brtsegs pa'i steng du zhib chadagos/gdung srid du cha phran bcu gnyis pa btang/gdung de'i steng nas lcam sne nang du btang ba'i sne 'gram steng gi gdung dang 'gram pa la bkal/ sgo khyud g.yas g.yon gyi steng du lcam 'phred la btang nas sgo dang sgo khang 'bubs so/ /lcam sne phyi ma la chu srin ma ka ra'i kha byas pa nas thon pa'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa cha phran gnyis yod pa gser gyi ska rags kyi ngos su 'phyang ba/ chu srin ma ka ra'i kha'i g.yas g.yon du dra ba gnyis sbrel re re zon pa khug pa byas pa'idabus sumar bu spom 4 g.yas g.yon gzer gyis bsdams pa/ de'inang gi steng du zla ba phyed pa rin po che dmar po rdo rje phyed bas mtshan pa/ dra phyed ni chu srin ma ka ra'i 35
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khakha'idabusanas thon pa khug pa ma yin par drang sor shur la 'phyang ba la gzer gyis bsnams pa'i nor bu spom 4 dang / rin po che'i yu ba can gyis rnga yab dril bu gsum spel ba de dag gi slor gos sna tshogs pa'i dra phyedadang/de'i slo gnyis su yid du 'ongs pa'i me tog gi 'tsheng ba'i dra phyed lnga bsgrigs su byas pa/ de'i steng gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su shing tshag cha phran gnyis pa'i bya 'dab sga shing tshag gi rtsel cha phran gcig pa'i shar bu dbyibs mchu med pa'i sbyi blug mgo thur du 'phyang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du cha phran gcig pa'i mda' yab dbyibs pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu/ 'thug rngams cha phran gcig pa dang] dpangs yang cha phran gcig /de yang steng gi phyogs re re la'ang gser gyi bum pa nas thon pa'i gser gyi yu ba can gyi rtsemo gaphyog yod pa'i 〉la zla phyed rin po che rdo rjes mtshan padabyibs zlum 4 khebs can gyi steng du rin 4 che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba'i do shal yod pa la nang du dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i gsum gaphyog la srog chags kyi mtshan ma yod med kyis rgyal mtshan dang ba dan byed pa yin la/ de yang rgyal mtshan la nya spru rgyas pa dang] chu srin ma ka ra dang / seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa gsum gyi mtshan ma yod pa/ nya spu rgyas pa ni nya dang sram 'tshogs pa las byung ba yin pas lus dbyibs nya lta bu la sram gyi spucand pa/ mgo rgyo nya'i mgo la sram sgya kha spu dang mche ba yod pa mjug ma'i dbyibs nya lta bu la sram gyi mjug ma cung zad yod pa/ chu srin ma ka ra ni dung dang chu srin 'tshogs pa'i bu yin pas lus po dung gi rang bzhin mkhregs pa la/ dbyibs chu srin gyi mjug ma cung zad yod pa/sbyor chu srin gyi lus mi mkhregs kyang 'di'i lus mkhregs pa yin/ seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa ni khyung dang seng ge 'tshogs pa'i bu yin pas/ lus kyi dbyibs seng ge la mgo yang phal cher seng ge'i gdong la mchu khyung gi mchu can/ 〈snangs grags kyi rkang lag bzhi dang] lag pa gnyis kyi steng na khyung gi sbar mo gnyis dang] mchan na gshog pa gnyis te/ de bzhi la rkang pa'i tha snyad 36
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/byas pas rkang pa brgyad par grags pa de ltabu'i mtshan mgengad pa'i rgyal mtshan dang] med pa'i ba dan phyogs re re la gnyis gnyis te/ khyon bsdoms na ba dan brgyad dang] rgyal mtshan brgyad de bcu drug yod pa/ steng gi zur bzhi la spre'u kha nang du bstan pa bzhis gdugs sham dang gdugs yu dkar yo/ rtsemo zla phyed dang rin po chedamar po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ yu ba sham budang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran gsum yod pa bzung ba sga medod snam rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram nas rngamasadang zheng cha phran gnyis yod pa/ kha dog dmar 4 dbyibs 'gram stegs kyi tshul du gzhal yas khang gi logs zur re re'i sgo khyud kyi jig mtha' nas sgo khyud gzhan gyi rtsig mtha'i bar 'gro zhing / sgo bzhi'i thad gar chad nas med pa/ 'dod snam steng nas mchod lha zhal nang la phyogs pa/ bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ phyogs re re la bzhi re ste bsdoms na bcu drug gis dkyil dngor gyi mtha' bskor nas mtshod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams su zla phyed/ steng du rin 4 che dmar ṭo rdo rje ser 4 rtselnga pa phyed pa'am tshang bas brgyan pa phyogs re re la bzhi re dang] zur bzhir rtsig pa'i pyi nang gnyis spurade ltabu re re lte sgodang sgo khyud kyi mtshams kyi bcudrugadang zur gyi phyi nang gi brgyadade nyi shu rtsabazhi 〈snad pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs 'phub lugs ni/ smṛ ti dang sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs yin/sgo logs kyi rtsig pa lngadang rdo rje'i lte ba kha da chad du gnas pa'i mtshams nas cha phran gcig dor bar stegs bu gru bzhi pa 'thug rngams cha phran gnyisadang zheng la sgo tshad gcig yod pa'i steng gi zur bzhi la bum pa cha phran phyed re yod pa phyogs bzhi'i lteng du ka ba rnga yu lta bu zheng cha phran phyed re yod pa/bum pa ka ba dang bcas pa'i srid la cha phran lnga yod pa re re btsugs pa'i rta babs re re'i 'og la yang / g.yas su stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du ka chung bzhi dang / g.yon du stegs 37
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabu gru bzhi pa'i steng du ka chung bzhi 'ongs pa bsdoms pa na ka ba brgyad re 'ong / ka ba'i phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu drug /nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu bzhi kaba sgyi ma'idabang du bya'o/ yod pa sga ka ba brgyad po de'i steng du snam bu bcu gcig gi mun snam gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi rngams la cha phran re re 〈snad pa zheng la mdun mtha' nas rgyab mtha'i bar la cha phran bzhi'am gsum yod pa thams cad la 'dra zhing] srid dang] kha dog mi 'dra ba'o/ /gser gyi pa ṭa ris snam bu kun la phra mo ga de la gser snam ni rgyu gser las grub pa/dbyibs bre lta bu ste/ srid la cha chung phyed gsum dang / g.yas g.yon gyi phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu drug yod/shar bu ni gzhi rin po che sngon po la dbyibs dkar po dod pa'am bre la shar bu 'phyang ba gang rung ma rin po che ni pha khu ltabu/ snam bu 'do gnyis kyi srid la cha phran gsum/ rta smrig ni gzhi ljang khu la ltare rmig ris yod pa srid du cha chung lnga/ snam bu 'di gsum gyi gyi mtha' mnyam/ pyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bco brgyad/ mun snam kyi 'og nas steng gi bar la cha chung phyed dang gnyis/ srid du cha chung phyed dang lnga yod pa/ 'degs byed kyi ka chung gnyis phyinang du yod pa/ ka chung gnyis kyi bar du dri za'i bu mo sogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu drug /ka ba'i phyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu bzhi/nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la ga chung bcu gnyis/ wa ran+t+ra ni kha dog sna tshogs pa la dar lce zur gsum par bcad pa ltabu'i ri mo can srid du cha chung lnga/ phyi mtha'anas phyi mtha'i bar la cha chung btsudrug /mun snam sogs nidabyibs sngar bshad pa ltabu/ ka ba'i sgyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu gnyis/ de'i steng gi shar bu'i snam bu/ rin 4 che'i snam bu/ rmig pa'i snam bu gsum spu'i kha dogadangadabyibs sngar bshad pa ltabu/ snam bu 'di gsum dang bdun pa ni g.yas g.yon gyi snam bu rgyun ma chad pa 'di gsum gyi phyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu bzhi/38
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/de'i steng du srid du cha phran bcu pa'i mda' yab kyi snam bu phyi dang nang du 'dab ma bcu re dang] sne gnyis kyi 'dab ma gnyis kyi bar du 'dab ma gsum re yod pa la/ phyi nang gi 'dab ma'i bar stong cha phran gsum pa'i steng du mngor lodang ri dwags kyi g.yas g.yon du phyogs gyi mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa sga mda'5ba kyi snam budang mda'༄ba mi gcig gsungs/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'idakhus su pad zla'i gdan la gshor lo ser 4 jibs bcu gnyis pa'am/ rtsibs brgyad pa gang rung langs pa'i lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa la cha phran gnyis yod pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo gnyis kyi mig gis chos kyi zhakhor 〈sna la bltas pa/ de gnyis kyi mjug ma'i phyogs su mda' yab gnyis gnyis te/ mda' yab phyi ma'i steng du gser gyi bum pa nas thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan re re/ mda' yab nang ma'i zur du dar lce sham bu dang bcas pa'i gdugs spre'us bzung ba gnyis/ snam bu bzhi pa'i mtshog ma gnyis su ba dan dang rgyal mtshan gnyis gnyis wa ran+t+ra dang rmig pa gnyis kyi steng gi phyogs gnyis su ba dan dang rgyal mtshan re re ste bsdoms na rta babs re re'i steng na ba dan dang rgyal mtshan bcu gnyis te bdan dang rgyal mtshan kun bsdoms na zhe brgyad dang / gdugs brgyad 'ong / rta babs 'og gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su zem skas bzhi pa dang] dbyibs mchod rten gyi bang rim lta bu kha dog dkar 4 re re/ de bzhin du lhor zem skas ser po/ nub tu zem skas dmar 4/ byang du zem skas ljang khu gnyis gnyis te zem gas brgyad dang] zem skas rnams kyi bang rim bzhi po re re lalang bang rim lnga lngadod pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su gser ram/ rin po che gang rung las grub pa'i bum pa sto ldir dang dpangs la sgo tshad re re yod pa'inang nas thon pa'idapag bsam shingasprul ga bdun pa/ yal gdabus ma la khyim bdag dang/denas g.yas bskor dusprul ga re re la gshor lo sogs lhag ma drug bkod/ de dag la ma reg tsam gyi steng gi bar bar du 39
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khagrub chen phyogs re re la gnyis gnyis te brgyad/shar phyogs pa rnams rnam snang lta bu/ lho phyogs pa rnams rin 'byung lta bu/ nub phyogs pa rnams 'od dpag med lta bu/ byang phyogs pa rnams don grub ltabu/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar sprin gseb nas lha'i bu kha dog sna tshogs pas me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba/ gzhal yas khang gi jig pa'i nang nas sgo tshad gnyis phyin pa'i sar 'o brang nang ma gar bu zlum po'i rgyar cha phran bcu drug sku(da pa/ 'og gzhi'i mtha' bskor du zheng cha phran gcig pa'i rdo rje'i zeng ba dpangs la cha phran bzhi'am drug yod pa'i bar bar du ka chung brgyad tshangs rig g.yas ga〈snan du cha phran gnyis gnyis dor ba'i sar btsugs pa/ ka gdung bre gzhu gargyag gdung dngor dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran drug /de rnams kyi steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdung kha dog ldon 4 bzhi mig mang ris su bkal nas thog 'phub/ de lta bu'i gar bu zlum po'i steng gi mtha' bskor du rdo rje'i phreng ba cha chung gcig pa'i zheng dang dpangs yod pa'i bar bar du dngor lo sogs kyis mtshan pa'i ka ba bre gzhu gaphyog gdung gshor dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran bcu drug yod pa bshad ma thag pa'i ka chung brgyad kyi steng gi thad dar btsugs pa'i steng du gdung gangor btang ba la/ gdung bzhi mig mang ris su btang ba'i lho byang gi ka ba gnyis gnyis kyi steng du ka ba bseg kha cha phran drug pa gnyis gnyis btsugs te mgosna bo dbus su btud pa'i bar du btsugs pa'i gdung rngams dang zheng la sgo tshad gcig yod pa/ srid la cha phran bcu drug gam cha chen bzhi yod pa/ lho byang du thal mar btang] phyi khyams gru bzhi pa'i steng du ka ba n+d+ra gzhu dang bcas pa'i steng du gdung gru bzhir btang / de'i steng nas shar nub kyi lcam ring cha phran bcu gnyis yod ba'i mar sna phyi khyams steng gi gdung mtshams la btang ba'i yar 〉lho byang du rgyug pa'i gdung la bkal/ lho byang du rgyug pa'i gdung leb 'digs pa'i ka ba bseg kha ma gnyis kyi rked par gdung 'phed la btang ba la yar sne bkal ba'i lcam ji ltar mtshams pa 40
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/sngar ltar bkal la zur zur du lcam gdung 'gel tshul yang rigs 'gres dpyad/ lho byang du rgyug pa'i gdung de'i steng du phyir cha phran phyed phyed dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin briglus kyi cha de dang des dngos kyi nyer len dang / lus kyi cha de dang der ngo 'o dbyer med par bsgom pa'i sa 'on rnams kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas lus kyi rang bzhin can gyi lha de dang der bskyed nas bsgom pa ni lus dkyil bsgoms pa yin cing / lus yang dngos gnas pa dgos pas bsgoms pa'i zhal gsum dang phyag drug yod kyang / gzhal gyi spyan sogs dang rtsaphyag gi mthil thegags min pa zhal phyag lhag ma rnams la bsgosnam mi dgosnas la/ lus dkyil gyi lha lasad lugasadang zhal stophyogs sogs mnangag bzhin sga yi rgya sgom tshe yum gyi lus la ltabsgoms kyang lus dkyil min/ 'di'i lus kyi gnas la lha bsgom tshul sngar bshad pa ltar byas nas bsgom pa ni/ lus brten pa lhar bsgom pa'i tshul yin no/ /sku gsung zugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyo 'or rnam snang gi zugs na'am de'i go sar rnam snang dang gnyis 4 phan tshun gcig gis gcig mi sgrib par oṃ dkar po zhig thol gyis byung / de 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil lusar nya gang ba'i lte bar oṃ dkar ṭo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa zhig bsam la/ de las 'od zer dkar po bcu gcig gi sne mo re re la spyan ma re 〈snad pa yar la spros te/ steng gi gdung zlum gyi re mig dgu pa'i dbus su gsum steng 'og bar gsum gyes pa shar phyogs sogs kyi re mig re re la re re yod pa/ gdung steng du slebs pa dang mnya5 du/ shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnam snang gi rnam pas shar gyi re mig gi steng dang / lho'i de rnams rnam snang gi rnam pas lho'i re mig gi steng dang / nub kyi de rnams rnam snang gi rnam pas nub kyi re mig gi steng / byang gi de rnams rnam snang gi rnam pas byang gi re mig gi steng / shar lho'i de rnams rnam snang gi rnam pas shar lho'i re mig gi steng / lho nub kyi de rnams lho nub kyi re mig gi steng/ nub byang gi de rnams nub byang gi re mig gi lteng/ byang shar gyi de rnams byang shar gyitsho 51
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khare mig gi steng] steng gi de rnams rnam snang gi rnam pas dbus kyi re mig gi lteng / 'og gi de rnams re mig dbus ma'i 'og tu/ re mig dbus ma'i dbus su steng 'og gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar la dbus kyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnam snang gi rnam pa can ni gtso bo'i rnam snang dang / gzhan lhag ma tshan pa bcu ni lnga'or la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul yin/ phyogs bcu dbus dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa tshan pa bcu gcig spyan drangs nas byon pa dang /phar spros pa'i spyan ma rnams gtso bo de dag dang zhal lhor du gnas pa bskyed nas rang las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad de/ re mig dbus ma'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i gtso 4 rnam snang yab yum zhal sbyar ba'i mdun na thal mo sbyar te lha'od nas/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku sogs sho lo ka gcig gis gtso sho dang / de rjes phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sogs 〈sna lo ka gcig gis gshor dbus ma'i steng 'og dang phyogs mtshams lhag ma brgyad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi ngo 4ra bsgom pa 'o bdag gi lus pyin gyis brlab tu gsesnal/ zhes ga〈snal ba btab pas/ spyan ma dang rnam snang gi lha tshogs thams cad byang sems kyi ngo po 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu nas gdung gi 'og tsam nas gcig tu 'dus/ rang sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'i ral pa'i thor cog tu sleb pa na cha so gnyis su song ba rnam snang gi sgo sbyo gtsug nas zhugs pas cha che ba rnam snang la rim/ lhag ma rnams lus dkyil gyi lha so so la thim pas lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyi lus gang / bdud rtsiphyir thon dam tshig sems dpa'i lus kyi nang thams cad gang ste sku'i dbang phyug thob song snyam du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs smon lam btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid du nga rgyal brtan par byas la sngags brjod pa sku byin rlabs yin/ rang gi lce'i dbus su bsgom na 'jig rten dbang phyug dang phan tshun mi sgrib pa/ mgrin par bsgom na 'od dpag med dang phan 52
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin brigtshun mi sgrib pa'am/ de'i shugs dar āḥ las pad+ma dmar k+ko bskyed pa'i steng du āḥ dmar 4 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phyo ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i 4la gos dkar mo spros nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas 'god tshul sngar ltar byas pa'i gtso lusar la ngag byin gyis brlab par gsol ba 'debs tshul sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ba la/ 'od zer dmar por zhu ba rang gi ral pa'i thor cog tu slebs nas cha so gnyis su song ba/ rang gi mgrin par zhugs pas cha che ba 'od dpag med dang] lhag ma lha gzhan la rim pas lus dkyil gyi lha'i lus gang nas/ dam tshig sems dpa'i sku gang / gsung gi dbang phyug thob par mos la smon lam btab/nga rgyal brtan pos sngags brjod nasadon dran pa ni gsung byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar mi bskyod pa dang phan tshun mi sgrib pa'am/ de'i thugs lngar hūṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil gabor de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba/ de las sngar ltar 'od zer gyi 〉las mā ma zhi spros nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngar ltar spyan drangs te/ sngar ltar bkod la/ bdag gi yid byin gyis brlabs par mos la gsesnal ba btab pas/ snyoms par zhugs nas 'od zer sngon por zhu ba sngar ltar 'ongs nas snying gar zhugs pas cha che ba mi bskyod pa dang / lhag ma lus dkyil gyi lha gzhan la thim/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyi lus gang sku'i phyi la thon/ dam tshig sems dpa'i lus thams cad gang / thugs kyi dbang phyug thob par mos nas smon lam dang nga rgyal brtan cing sngags brjod nas don dran pa ni zugs byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ de nas rang gi lus dkyil gyi reg bya rdo rje mas reg bya rdo rje ma gsum spros pas/ mi bskyod pa dngaka gtsug tor gsor los bsgyur ba gnod ma sa gsum spyan 'drin pa yin la/ de bzhin du spyan mas spyan ma spros pa dang / mā ma khris mā ma zhi spros pa dang / gos dkar mos gos dkar mo spros pa dang / sgrol mas sgrol ma spros pa bzhis rim pa bzhin rnam snang nas don grub kyi bar 53
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabzhi spyan 'drin pa dang / de bzhin du yab mi bskyod pa nas don grub kyi bar lngas rang 'dra lnga spros pas rim bzhin reg bya rdo rje ma sogs yum lnga spyan 'drin pa dang / sa snying / phyag rdor/nam snying / 'dzig rten dbang phyug bzhis rang 'dra re re spros nas rim bzhin gzugs rdo rje ma nas ro rdo rje ma'i bar bzhi spyan 'drin pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma las rang 'dra bzhi spros pas/byams pa/ sa snying] gshen rje'i gshed/ mi g.yo ba ste/ shar dang shar lho'i kho 'o dang bcas pa spyan 'dren la/ de bzhin du sgra rdo rje ma las rang 'dra bzhi spros pas lho'i sems dpa' gnyis dang khro 'o gnyis/ dri rdo rje ma las rang 'dra bzhi spros pas/ nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' gnyis dang khro 'o gnyis/ ro rdo rje ma las rang 'dra bzhi spros pas byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' gnyis dang kho 'o gnyis rnams spyan drangs nas spros pa'i yum rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i rang rang gi yab la lurgyud pa/ spros pa'i yab rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i rang rang gi yum rnams la lubyud pa yin la/ spyan 'drin lugs spros pa'i yum nyer gsum yab dgu rnams spros te/ steng gi gdung gshor steng du slebs pa dang/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus pa'i lha so gnyis tshang ba'i rten brten pa'i dkyil lubor gcig tu gyur pa de dag re mig dbus ma'i steng 'og bar gsum du steng 'og gi khro 'o gnyis dang mi bskyod pa reg bya rdo rje ma/ de bzhin du shar gyi re mig gi steng du shar phyogs kyi gshegs pa dang sems dpa' yab yum kho 4 dang bcas spru/ shar lho'i re meg gi steng du shar lho'i gshegs ma sems ma slo 4 dang bcas pa 'god tshul 'di ni spyan drangs pa'i lha'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin du phyogs dang phyogs mtshams lhag ma rnams kyang shes par ma de nas de rnams snyoms par zhugs nas 'od du zhu ba rang gi snying gar thim nas lha dren gnyis serdzo sdud la bstim/ de dag gi sku gang nas phyir spros dam tshig sems dpa'i sku gang / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po de nga'o snyam du 54
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khridakyi zin brigsngags brjod nas nga rgyal bya ba ni/ sku gsung zugs thun mong du byin gyis slob pa yin no/ /de nas rangadam tshig sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang gron 4ra gsal ba'i zugs spur sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la lubyud pa/ de'i thugs dar zla gdan la rdo rje ldon 4 rtselnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du ting nge 'odzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon 4 snang ba'i phung 4 'bar ba lta bu mi shes pa'i mun pa sel ba/ dam tshig sems dpa'i sbyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la oṃ dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgyi 'or 'og pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rnam snang yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pa spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs nas 'od du zhu ba dam tshig sems dpa'i spyi 'o nas zhugs pa ye shes sems dpa'i sbyi 'or zhugs pas sku gang / phyir thon nas dam tshig sems dpa'i rkang mthil nas sbyi gtsug bar gang / lhag ma yar lud pa las dam tshig sems dpa'i ral pa'i zor cog la rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la lubyud pa bskyed pa ni lus rgyas par byed pa yin la/ lus rgyas par byed pa'i byed las las rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa 'byung ba yin no/ /de nas yang sngar ltar dam tshig sems ngapa'i mgrin pa'i ālas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la ādamar po spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mgrin par phog pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pa spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs nas 'od du zhu ste dam tshig sems dpa'i sbyi bo nas zhugs pa ye shes sems dpa'i sbyo 'o nas babs/ sku gang nas phyir thon te dam tshig sems dpa'i lus gang] lhag ma sgyi 'or lud pa las rigs bdag gi thugs sgar zla gdan gyi rnam par bskyed pa ni/ ngag rgyas par byed pa 55
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khayin la/ ngag rgyas par byed pa'i byed las las rigs bdag gi thugs sgar zla gdan 'ong ba yin no/ /de nas yang sngar ltar dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs shar hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i g+ne la hūṃ sngon ṭo spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zugs dar phog pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod payab yum gyi rnam par gyur pa spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs te 'od du zhu ba dam tshig sems dpa'i sbyo 'o nas zhugs pa ye shes sems dpa'i sbyo 'o nas babs/ sku gang nas phyir lud pas dam tshig sems dpa'i sku gang] lhag ma sbyi sor lud pa las rigs bdag gi shugs sgar zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi rnam par bskyed pa ni/ yid rgyas par byed pa yin/ yid rgyas par byed pa'i byed las las rigs bdag gi thugs gar sa 'on 'ong bsanano/ /de nas sngar ltar dam tshig sems dpa'i zugs spu'i hūṃ las hūṃ yig dpag med 'od zer gyi sne la sprosanas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sgar phog pas sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par bsgyur ba spyan drangs/ dam tshig sems dpa'i sbyi bo nas zhugs/ ye shes sems dpa'i sbyi 4 nas babs/ sku'i nang thams cad gang / de nas phyir lud pasadam tshig sems dpa'i sku'i nang thams cad gang / lhag ma sbyi sor lud pa yongs su gyur ba las rigs bdag gi thugs dar zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng gi rnam par bkod pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum thun mong du rgyas par byed pa yin la/de byas pas byed las las rigs bdag gi zugs zhar yig brgya 'ong zhing/ yi ge brgya pa bzla 'dod na4 dmigs pa de nyid 'edzin pa yin cing/ de ltar bzlas na yig brgya bzla tshul gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i zab khyad yod gsungs/rig ma 'du bya ba ni/ 'od gsal dang 4 'char ba'i gnas snying ga yin pas shes rab ma snyingaganas sprul par byed pa yin la/der rang sprul sku rdor sems kyi snying ga nas rang rigs kyi 56
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/rig ma phyung la/ de 'od du mer gyis zhu bas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa bon khaṃ las phyag mtshan rdo rje/ de las reg bya rdo rje ma sngar bshad nga/ lta bur bskyed pa lte/ cho ga gsum gyis bskyedanas/ de'i lus la sa 'on tsam las rigs lnga yum bzhi rdo rje ma lnga bskyed pa la/ byams pa/'jam dpal/ kun bzang ma gtogs pa'i sems dpa' lhag ma lngas 'khyud pa/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gzugs rdo rje ma sogs zhal phyir phyogs pa la sa snying rtsogs kyi zhal nang la phyogs nas zhakhyud pa/ yan lag la hūṃ las kho mo kho 'o bcu lta bu ste lha nyer dgu bkod/ de nas rang sprul sku rdor sems kyi gsang gnas kyi liṅga 'od du zhu nas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'ingang las hūṃwenangs su gyur pa las/ dbyibs liṅga dkyus ma las kha dog sngon 4 gsal zhing dwangs pa'i nang du rdo rje sngon 4 rtselnga pa shel phreng nang gi thag pa ltar gsal bar mthong ba rwa dbus ma sbu gu khong gseng can gyi mar sna phaṭa yig thur sel mtshon pa'i kha dog ser 4/ mgo nang du bstan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ yig nyal stabs mgo 'o gyen bstan gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas kyang stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'ingang lasa.āḥdamar po las pad+madamar 4 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba spu gu can gyi bu ga nas phaṭa yig ser 4 mgo nang du bstan pas bkag par bsgom ste/ 'dir bskyed rim pa'i skabs rtsalta'oradang dbu ma gsal mi 'debs kyang] yab yum gnyis kyi gsang gnas gnyis kyi mar sna gnyis rag dung gi kha ltar gdangs shing cung zad pyi la g.yel ba gnyis sprad pa gang gis kyang mi shig pa lta bur dmigs nas gron byung gi rnam thar bzhin rin 'byung ging rgyal gyis phan tshun 'khyud padang]'o byed pa dang] lajibs pa'am/ so ladobs pa dang/ sen mo 'debs padang/yangadag par bskyod padang] sid kyi sgra slogs padang/ skyes pa'i bya ba byed padang] stengan 'dug pa dngaka brgyad kyi sgo nas rjes chags byas nas sngags brjod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid du nga rgyal ma de nas rin 'byung gi nga rgyal las rdo rje 'chang 57

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/rngul chu lta bu re byung bar mos pa yin pas/ mchod pa'i skabs sogs la khyad par 'byedadagos gsungs/ de yan chad ni sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can rang gi don phun tshogs ting nge 7drin gyi rgyal po mchog gam dang po'i bh+yor ba'i ting nge 7)na yin no/ /de nas rang don phun sum tshogs pa brnyes nas/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa rgyal mtshog gnyis kyis bsgrub pa yin pas/ dkyil lubor rgyal mchog de ni rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i phaṭa yig dang 4 brjod tshe lus dkyil gyi lha las byung ba'i zig le byung ba nor bu'i bar du phab nas phaṭa yig gnyis pa brjod pa na yab yum gyi gsang gnas kyi phaṭa yig gnyis kyi zur yod tsam phye ba de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rig le yid kyis phyung ba yum gyi pad+mar phab pa/ yum gyi snying gar drangs ste cha gnyis su song ba cha gcig hūṃ du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhisogs mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba shar sgo tshur rang la bstan pa'i nang du gdan so gcig yod pa zhig tu gyur/ thig le cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha so gnyis su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sa 'on hūṃ khaṃ oṃ sogs so gnyis yi ge gsum gyi bar du bcug pa re rer gyur pa dang / yi ge gsum sa bon dang bcas pa lha rang rang gi mdog tu bya/ de yang dbus kyi gdan steng du kha tshur blta ba'i g.yas su oṃ/ de'i g.yon du āṇ+ḍa'i g.yon du sa pon gyi hūṃ dang / de'i g.yon du yi ge gsum gyi hūṃ rnams bsgrigs nas gyen la 'greng pa/ de'i mdun du reg bya rdo rje ma'i sa 'on yi ge gsum de lta bur byas nas kha yab kyi skyed sngags la bstan pa nas/ gar bu zlum po'i 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi skyed sngags oṃ āḥ/ hūṃ rnams bsgrigs nas gyen la 'greng ba kha tshur la bstan pa'i bar skyed/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ lha so gnyis kyi phyag mtshan so gnyis su rgyud phyag mtshan de dag yongs su gyur pa las rim gyis lha so gnyis su gyur pa la nga rgyal bya ste/ sngon byung la bcom 59

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim khrid kyi zin bris/rlung me sa chu'i dkyil gshor bzhir yi ge yo raṃ laṃ baṃ bzhi bkod nas nang gi sbyin sreg byed pa 'dis kyang / rim pa bzhin dbang dang drag 4 rgyas pa zhi ba'i las bzhi 'grub pa yin te/ lha mo bzhis zhus las/ nyon cig khyod kyi nang gi ni/ /pad+ma bzhi rnams khungar ba ni/ /lus kyi dbus na nye bar gnas/ /me dang de bzhin rlung dang ni/ /dbang chen dang ni chu de bzhin/ /rlung gis me la sbar byas te/ /chu yis yongs su smin par byed/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /gang du me ni khungad pa yis/ /ra yig mngon sbyongad yi ge nye/ /ya yig dbang gi las khom na/ /la yig rgyas par 'gyur ba ste/ /ba yig zhi ba zhes gsungs 〈sna/ /gang gis bza' dang btung ba ni/ /de dag thams cad chu la lte/ /pad+mar k+ṣa yig kha mar blta/ /snying gi pad+mar gzhug par s+pha /lte ba'i pad+ma 'gro pyi rol/ /kha sbyingar tshul du sbyar ba yis/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar 'phro ma thag /thal ba'i mtha' ru rnam par bstan/ /de ltar sgyin sreg bdag bshad ba/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ba ste/ /rtag par rgyun du zas zos na/ /tshe 'di kho nar 'grub par 'gyug /rgas pa med cing nad kyang med/ /shi ba'ang med cing 'gras kyang med/ /de bzhin slo bur 'chi ba'ang med/ /'tshe ba thams cad zad gyur cing / /rmi lam ngan pa'ang zhi bar 'gyud /bzang so bskal bar thegan pa ste/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar smra/ /mthong ba tsam gyis bskul byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'idagongs pa yin zhing/pad+mar k+ṣa yig kha mar blta/ /zhes pa dpe ma dag par rje'i ṭīk+kar bshad la/ don ni mdor byas su/ bza' ba kha yi pad+ma la/ zhes pa'i don yin zhingad mdor byas su zas kyi rngal 'gyor bshad snatā hā/ spya) k+ṣiṃ pa pa // gh+nā lha pa /ṭīka deXpā rtswa / sprir+shapa lhasna ༵ (spri (sri gi/ dā snashā kyi sbyangs tshul byas nas/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil lhagar sogs bskyed tshul 'dra gsungs so/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus kyi lha rnams rang dang bcas pa chos sku'i lam sabyer skabs 75

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim nyams su len tshugda༅༅//dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa nyams su len tshul kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun bzhugs 〈sna//na mo gu ru/bla ma dang rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o//brtseb chen pos dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/'der dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa nya5sa su len par byed pa la/gzhi dngos po'i gnas tshul/lam bzod pa'i rim pa/'bras bu mngon du byed tshul lo//gzhi'i dngos po'i gnas tshul la/lus kyi gnas tshul/sems kyi gnas tshul/lus sems thun mong ba'i gnas tshul/lus kyi gnas tshul la lus de la rags pa/phra ba/shin tu phra ba gsum 'dad pas/pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pa'i sha rus gdos bcas kyi lus ni rags pa/gnas pa rtsagayo ba rlung bkod pa byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar rnams ni lus phra ba/stong pa gsum dang khyad par du thams cad stong pa 'od gsal gyi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung ni lus shin tu za ba yin/sems de la yang rags pa/phra ba/shin tu phra ba gsum yod pas/sgo lnga'i dbang shes ni sems rags pa/②nyon drug/nye nyon nyi shu/rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi 81
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khasems ni sems phra ba/ stong pa gsum dang khyad par du thams cad stong pa 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems ni shin tu phra ba yin la/ lus can sems can thar/sa cad la 'chi ba 'od gsal rang dus su mngon du gyur pa'i shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems ngo 'o gcig pa ni lus sems thun mong ba'i gnas tshul yin/ denang mar lugs pa kha cig /sad dus kyi dge khungar skyong bar byed pa la sgyi 'o dang lte ba la gnad du che ba dang / gnyid dus kyi dge bh+yor skyong bar byed pa la mgrin pa dang snying ga la gnad du che bar gsungs shing / sad dus kyi las rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa sgyi 'o la gnad du che ba dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa lte ba la gnad du che ba gsungs la/ gnyid dus kyi rmi lam gyi dge bh+yor skyong bar byed pa la mgrin pa la gnad du che ba dang / gnyid 'thug gi dge spyor skyong bar byed pa la snying gar gnad du che ba gsungs kyang/ lugs 'de'i bsgrub bya'i gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ spyi twi tram̐ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ tram̐ / ṭī ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ྅: gyi rkyi ṭ+wāṃ/ khri hūm̐ sh+lau ༷ kyi rdzogs rim la slob tshul 'ong/ /dbe+en pa gsum gyi rdzogs rim la slob tshul la/ lus dbe+en sku rdo rje'i ting nge 'odzin la slob tshul/ ngag dpen gsung rdo rje'i ting nge 'odzin la slob tshul/ sems dbe+en zugs rdo rje'i ting nge 7rin la slob tshul lo/ /lus dbe+en sku rdo rje'i ting nge 'odzin la slob tshul ni/ rang gsang chen rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pa'i gsang gnas kyi ṅgha tī'i mar sna'am/nor bu'i dbus kyi ②'dab brgyad pa'i ṅgha 3'i nang du nyi gdan gyi steng du zig le khyad par gsum ldan la sems bying rgod dang bral bar gtad de rtsegacig tu sgom par byed/ de ltar ba〈snam pas rlunga'akhu mar zhugs pa gnas pa thim pa gsum 'byung] zhugs pa'i rtags su sna bug gi rlung mnyam rgyu shed mtshungs nges can du zeng ba de 'byung / gnas pa'i rtags su sna bug gi rlung 82

mched pa nyer thob la rim pa'i nyer thob rang dus su ston gnam g.ya' dag la mtshams kyi smag 'thug pos khyab pa lta bu'i stong sang nag lam pa'i snang ba 'byung ste ngo shes par byed/nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pas 'od gsal rang dus su ston gnam g.ya' dag la slod byed kyi skyon gsum bral ba'i tho rang gi nam mkha'i rang mdog lta bu'i 'od gsal 'byung ste ngo shes par byed/ de dag gi tshe gsang gnas dang / lte ba'i ñtsha tī'i nang gi gtum mo sbar ba gyen du song bas sgyi bo'i haṃ yig gis mtshon pa'i kun+da lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba sbyo bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na yas babs kyi lhan skyes rdzogs par 'char zhing / thig le de dag dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim dmar khridasngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa/thob/ 'bras dus kyi gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /bla ma'i zugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ thog med nas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag/bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ 'bras dus kyi zugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /bla ma'i gnas gsum gnas 'od zeradakaradamar mthing gsum dus gcig la 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum la zim/thog med nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi 〈sna nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin 4 che thob/ 'bras dus kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'i nus pa bzhag /de nas/ bla ma rang la bstim pa ni/ seng khri nyi gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang gi sbyi ṭo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i rtsalha'or la zim/ nyi gdan 'od du zhu nas zig le dmar po la thim/ zla gdan 'od du zhu ba thig le dkar po la zim/ bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu ba thig le dkaradamar gyi dbus kyi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo 4 a thung shad kyi rnam pa can dang ngo 'o dbyer med du gyur pa las/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar 4 zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam pa can yum bcas su bzhugs par bsam la/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus spru bde blag tu stsal byung ba'i mos pa dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan rtsaba'i bla ma rin 4 che/ /nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i sgron me legs bzung nas/ rngo /snying ga'i pad+mor bzhugs la mchog stsol cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad pu /zhes pa nas/ mtshan ma tsam yang 'byung bar ma gyur cig/mdo sngags bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas padangan /nas/ slo gsal bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim byed tshe ga/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dngaka /zhes sogs byed/ ces bla ma'i rmal 'byor 'di byas pas sngags kyi 103

dasprul gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim dmar khridasngon 'gro dngosagazhi'idamigs padang bcas pa/pa la sgyi rgyo na rtsaladab so gnyis kha dog sna tshogs kha zur bstan/ mgrin par rtsa'adab bcu drug kha dogadamar 4 kha gyen bstan/ snying ga na rtsa'adab brgyad kha dogadakar 4 kha zur bstan/ lte ba na rtsaladab drug cu re bzhi kha dog dmar po kha gyen bstan/ gsang gnas na rtsa'adab so gnyis kha dog sna tshogs kha zur bstan/ nor bu'idabus na rtsa'adab brgyad pa khadog dkar 4 kha gyen bstan/ rtsagashor thams cad kyi rtsab rtsadabu ma la zug pa rtsemo phyogs so sor gyes pa'i rtsemo nas rtsaba'i bar thams cad bu ga thal le 'dad pa/gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar khothal le 'gad par gsal btab/de'i rtsabasgom pa yin/de nas rang gi sems smin mtshams kyi dbu ma'imir sna'i nang nas yar zhugs/ spyi bo'i rtsalha'or du slebs/ de nas yar mar la bltas pas yar snanas mar sna'i bar bu ga thal le yod pa/ rtsa'adi thams cad nang nas sge'u khung la bltas pa ltar bu ga khothal le yod pa bsgom/ de bzhin du rang gi sems mgrin pa/ de nas snying ga /de nas lte ba/de nas gsang gnas/ de nas nor bu'i rtsalubor gyi dbus su sleb par bsgom nas/ yar mar la bltas pas nang thams cad na yar bu ga khra thal le yod par bsgom/ de nas nor bu'i dbus kyi rtsagashor gyi bu ga de bkag pa'i tshul gyis nyi gdan sran ma phyed gzhags tshad tsam kha gyen la bzed pa'i tshul gyis yod par bsam/ de'i steng du thig le khyad par gsum ldan pa kha dog gi khyad par gron ṭo/ dpyibs kyi khyad par zlum po/ che chung gi khyad par yungs dar gyi 'bru'i tshad tsam zhig gro hril le yod par bsam pa de la rang gi sems zhugs pa'i tshul gyis sim me thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar dmigs ltan de la sems ji ltar 'dod 'dod kyi bar lasdog nus pa ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de'i tshe dmigs lten gyi zig le de nyi gdan gyi steng du mi gnas pa'i rnam pa byung na/ gnas pa'i 'ogs 'don gnyis las jig le de shin tu lci ba'i rnam pa can 'od mer mer ba zhig tu bsgom pa dang / yang na thig le de nyi gdan la sum cha tsam zug pa'i rnam par 105

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab lam rim lnga'idamar khrid nyams su len tshul/gcig gi rnal 'byor la gnas te/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi stegs bu dang bcas pa'i steng du rkang pa skyil krung byas/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ sgal tshigs drang 4ra bsrang la rlung sna bug g.yas nas 'bud cing g.yon nas rngub pa sogs rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal nas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas/ rtsagasum dngor lo drug gsal 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ rang rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gsang gnas kyi liṅga rdo rje gron 4 rtselnga par gsal ba'i rā dbus ma'i rtse mo dhū ti'i mar sna dang kha da chad du yod la/ de nas yar sna sgal tshigs la cung zad nye ba'i khog pa'i nang drang thad nas smin mtshams kyi bar du gnas pa/de yang dbu ma sngon po gang ba'i rnam pa can/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar zhar/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar zhar phra sbom gro rtsog tsam/ ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma la 'byar pa'i tshul du khra hram me lus kyi gzhung shing gi tshul du tal le yod par bsgoms/ rtsagasum ga'i yar sna smin mtshams su yod pa sbyi bo'i rtsalubor klad rgya'i steng / thod pa'i 'og /sgyi gtsug gi thad tsam du yod pa'i dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du gabyud ngasa'i mdud mtshams nas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i rtsa'adab bzhi/ de re re la gnyis gnyis gyes pas bcu drug /de re re la gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i so gnyis kha dog dkar po 'jag ma sgom shos tsam/ phyi dbyibs gru gsum sna 6ring zung mnyam pa kha mgrin pa la phyogs pa'i sbyo 'o bde chen gyi gshor lo dang / tshal mdud kyi thad tsam gyi dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du 'gyud pa'i mdud mtshams nas g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu gyes pabazhi/ de las gyes pa brgyad/ de las gyes pa bcu drug /kha dog dmar 4 dbyibs zlum po kha gyen du phyogs pa'i mgrin pa longs rgyud kyi lta'or lo dang] nu ma gnyis kyi dbus kyi thad tsam du dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du dbyud pa'i mdud mtshams nas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i rtsa'adab bzhi/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa'adab brgyad/ kha dog 127
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadmar 4 dbyibs zlum 4/ kha lte ba la phyogs pa'i snying ga chos kyi gabor lo dang / lte ba'i thad tsam gyi dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du 'khyud pa'i mdud mtshams nas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i rtsa'adab bzhi/ de las brgyad/ de las gyes pa bcu drug /de las gyes pa so gnyis/ de las gyes pa'i ga'adab re bzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa dbyibs gru gsum kha gyen du phyogs pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i gshor lo dang / spu dkar nag gi mtshams kyi thad sor dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du zhakhyud pa'i mdud mtshams nas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i rtsa'adab bzhi/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa'adab brgyad/ de'i mtshams kyi rtsa'adab bzhi las gyes pa med la/ phyogs kyi rtsa'adab bzhi las lnga lngar gyes pa nyi shu/ de rnams kyi gyes gzhi bzhi/ mtshams kyi bzhi ste dreg gnyis kha dog dmar po dbyibs zlum po kha 'og tu phyogs pa'i gsang gnas bde skyong gi gabor lo dang / ṇā ti'i mar sna nas sor gnyis tsam yar 'ongs pa'i mtshams sudabu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du dgrad pa'i mdud mtshamasanas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon tu gyes pa'i rtsa'adab bzhi/ de las gyes pa brgyad/ kha dog dmar po dbyibs gru gsum pa kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nor bu'i dbus kyi rtsa'adab brgyad pa ste rtsa'adab rnams gadbu ma la zug cing 'brel ba 'jag ma spom 77sa kyi tshad tsam du yod pa la phyi dbyibs gdugs kyi rtsibs ma lta bu zlum bo dhū ti'i nang nas phar bltas pa'i tshe rtsa'adab kyi nang sbrub stong thal le mthong ba rtsa'adab rnams drang zhing mnyen por yod par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dmigs pa dngos la 'jug pa'i thog mar rang gi sems spyi bo'i dbu ma'i nang du gsal le hrig ge zhugs/rtsa'i chags lugs rnams ji 'dra snyam du rtsadangor gyi nang nas phar la yud tsam bltas pas/ rtsa'dab rnams kyi nang sbugs stong ha re ma'ong bar bsam/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar bltas pas mgrin pa'i rtsadangor rnams gsal por mthong / de nas smi ti'i nang nas sems khyu ru ru 'ongs 128
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab lam rim lnga'idamar khridanyams su len tshugte marin pa'i rtsalubor sgya nang du sems yud tsam bzung ste sngar ltar rtsa'adab rnams la blta ba sesnags bya'o/ /mgrin pa'i smi ti'i nang nas mar la bltas pas snying ga'i rtsa'adab rnams hrig ge mthong ba na sngar bzhin sems dbu ma'i nang du mar 'ongs/ snying ga'i rtsagashor gyi nang du sems bzung ste blta ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de bzhin du lte ba gsang gnas nor bu'i dbus kyi rtsagangor rnams su sems 'dzin pa dang / rtsa'adab la blta ba sogs sngar bzhin no/ /de rnams ni rtsalam spyong ba yin/ de nas nor bu'i dbus kyi rtsa'adab brgyad pa'i dhū ti'i mar snar nyi gdan sran ma phyed gshags tsam dmar khyil le ba zhig bsgom/ de'i steng du rang gi sems smi ti'i nang nas mar rim gyis babs pas/ de nyid thig le sngon po bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu/ yungs dkar gyi 'bru tshad tsam kha dog lnga 'phro ba zhig tu hril gyis 'gril bar bsam la/ de lta bu'i thig le la rang gi sems zhugs pa ltar byas te dbyer mi phyed par rtsegacig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /shun lasdog pa'i me+e/ dmigs rten thig le de nyid smi ti'i lam nas lte bar drangs/ snying ga'i mi shags pa dang gcig tu byas nas spyod lam la 'jug par byed do/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i gegs byung na sel zhing bogs 'don pa'i tshul ni/ ji ltar bsgoms kyang dmigs rten mi gsal ba dang / dmigs rten dum bur 'gro ba dang] lus skam zhing haṃ pa dang / rul ba la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba'i snang ba shar ba dang / gsang gnas kyi liṅga chad pa sogs kyi nyams byung na/ bla ma dang chos 'di la dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags yin pas bsgom pa'i 'phyo bshol la/ slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang bla ma'i rnal 'gyor bsgom pa sogs la 'bad cing gzhan yang bsags sbyangs la rtsal du bton te dmigs pa ma brjed par byas nas phyis yang yang bsgom par bya'o/ /nyi ma dang 4 la dmigs pa gsal zhing gnyis pa la mi gsal ba sogs byung na dang / thun dang 4 la gsal zhing gnyis pa la mi gsal ba sesnags 129
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabyung na/ dkor grib dang zas grib dang / mi grib can sogs dang 'phrad pa'i rtags yin pas/de rnams la ci nas kyang 'phrem par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dam nyams dang / khyad par rang gi bla ma dang dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang gdong ma thug par bya zhing / de dag gi zas mi za/ mi gdon can sogs kyang 'dzem la/ bsgom pa'i 'phro balha la la bla ma dang chos la dad pa bsgom/ lus kyi byed bcings slod rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal te slar yang bsgom par bya'o/ /lus kyi ro smad du na tsha sgras rtsabs pa lta bu lus sgul bskyod byed pa'i tshe yod cing dmigs pa skyong dus med pa byung na gzug yin la/ mgo lubor ba dang lus kyi stod smad gang rung du shin tu smi zhing / sna bug gi rlung 'byung 'jug 'gags pa dang / lus thag pas bsdams pa 'dra ba byung na dmigs pa skyong ba'i dus kyi lus kyi byed bcings dang dbugs bsnams pa'i skyon yin pas rlung zug yin la/dmigs pa ma zugar ba'i ngang nas lus kyi byed bcings slod/ sna bug nas ched du gnyer nas rlung 'byung 'jug byed/ des sel lo/ /gal te ma sel na/ dmigs rten las lhangor lo lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi na tsha gang du yod pa'i gnas der song nas/ nad kyi ngo 4 smra shad nag po'i rnam par bkug ste dmigs rten la ro med du sib sib bstim/ lus kyi stod smad kyi rlung stulha ༵༵ ༵ 〉pa n+d+ra snang ñtsā ༵ ba/lha spras hūm̐ /sna rnalta spya r+yaṃ dī khri/sabyi gh+nā pa/ pa/ lhag rlu( rengs pa'i rtags yin pas/ gnas de dang de dag la dmigs pa'i rdor bzlas bya/ rtsalubor rdzogs par gsal ma thub na rtsagasum gsal btab la bsgom/ gsang gnas kyi liṅga rdo rje rtselngar gsal ma thub na/ gzhung ma gsal dwangs kyi nang du gagasum yod pa'i nor bu'i nang du sgyu ti'i mar snar dmigs rten la sems rtsegacig tu gtad de bsgom par bya'o/ /rdo rje lus dang rgyang chad du serdzong na de nyid lus dang 'brel bar bsgoms/ rtsagasum lte ba man chad du 'gro ma 130
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab lam rim lnga'i dmar khrid nyams su len tshul/nyan na/ ṭhā ti'i mar sna gang du 'char ba de nyid du dmigs rten gsal btab nas mar sne ring du btang nas/ nor bu'i dbus su dhū ti'i mar sna sleb par bsgom par bya'o/ /yang dhū ti'i mar snar sems thig le'i ngo sor 'gril ma thub na/ lte ba'i rtsa'akhor gyi nang tsam nas sems thig le'i ngo bor hril gyis sgril nas/ de nyid dhū ti'i nang nas mar hril gyis btang nas ṭhā ti'i mar sna nyi gdan gyi steng du bzhag ste bsgom par bya'o/ /thig le nyi gdan gyi steng du 'phar ba dang 'dar ba dang phan tshun du 'gril na/ de nyid yid gyis mnan nas thig le phyed tsam nyi gdan la zug par k+ta /pa/ bkā da pa dzo ༵༵ ra /shā k+ṣiṃ spyan kau (( /sna (sna nade/ ñtsā ༈ hūm̐ rdzu spra ༵༵ ༈snashā ༈ spya ba'i dmigs rten la bstim/ rtsa'akhor rnams su sdig sprul 〈snags kyis 'jus pa dang / 'tshang ba lta bu'i nyams shar na rlung cung zad 'dus pa'i rtags yin pas ma zhed par gaba'i dmigs rten la bstim/ dngos sam rmi lam du 'dzag gegs byung na 'dren dang 'grems kyi dmigs pa la mkhas da〈snas pas/ de'i tshul ni/ mthe 'ong gi rtseganyis kyis srin lag gi rtsab mnan la khu tshur bcings te lag pa gnyis bsnol te khu tshur g.yas pas nu ma g.yo na pa mnan/ ga〈snan pas nu ma g.yas pa mnan/ rkang lag gi sen resna dang 'og 〈sna dam du bsdams/ nyo ba sgal tshigs la sbyar/ mig gyen du bzlog /snying ga'i rtsagasor gyi dbus na hūṃ yig mgo sbrel zhig dhū ti'i nang nas mar shi ri ri btang ste/ hūṃ gnyis kyi mgo'i bar du dmigs rten rig le de nyid tshir gyis bzung nas hūṃ yig gyen du bzlog pa dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'ong ba dang dus mnyam du lus kyi smad na sku(da pa'i byang sems rnams yar drangs te/ hūṃ yig gnyis kyi bar gyi thig le de ma4sto gyen du bzlos /de dang dus mnyam du ngag nas hūṃ ring po bdun nam nyer gcig rjod par byed/des bzlog go /log pa'i rtags ni/ pho ba grang lhang ba dang / mchin pa cung zad na ba 'ong bar 131
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabshad do/ /des ma thub na gsang gnas kyi rdo rje ber gyi phu zung nang du bsgyur ba ltar dbu ma'i nang du yar song ba dang dus mnyam du lus kyi byang sems rnams yar khyu ru ru byung bar bsam zhing / gsang gnas kyi rdo rje spyi gtsug tu ldo lhag ge thon par bsam pa dang dus mnyam du ngag nas hūṃ ring 4 bdun nas nyer gcig brjod pas bzlog /'grems kyidamigs pa byed tshulani/thog mar mgo lus thams cad drag 6sprug cing] phyis je chung je chung la btang bdang dus mnyam du byang sems rnams rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin du rtsanang so sor sib sib rim par bsam mo/ /'ogs 'byin gyi dmigs pa ni/ dmigs rten gyi nang du sems zhugs pa ltar bya dgos par ma zad lus ril po zhugs nas dmigs rten de nyid gos su gyon pa ltar byas nas bsgom pa'o/ /gsal ba'i bogs 'don ni/ dmigs rten de nyid phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros bas d+ma ti'inang thams cad du shel gyi bum pa'inang du sgron me sbar ba ltar gsal sengange mthong bar bsgom par bya'o/ /bde ba'i 'ogs 'don ni/ ṅgha ti'i nang thams cad nas byang sems 'bab la khad pa dang /la la 'bab bzhin pa dang] dmigs rten la zho rkyal la khab mang pos rtsabs pa bzhin du/ byang sems dkar phrom tshur 'ong zhing slar phar rim par bsam mo/ sems ha cang phyir 'phyo ba 'dug na rig le ldo nag mgo 4ra bsam zhing / ha cang rmugs shing bying na de nyid sngon 4 dwangs shing 'tsher ba 'od zer 'phro ba bsam mo/ /de yang lus dpen gyi skabs su 'dzag gegs sel thabs de cung zad re bsgoms pas gegs mi 'byung ngo /gnyis pa ngag dpen gsung rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la slob tshul la gsum las/ snying ga'i sna rtser sngags kyi thig le'i srog rtsol bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ thun stod la bskyed rim bsgom pa dang / lus gnad rtsagagar bsgom pa sogs phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba la snying ga'i rtsagabor 132
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i zab lam rim lnga'i dmar khrid nyams su len tshul/gsal 'debs pa ni/ snying ga'i dhū ti la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du 'khyud pa'i mdud mtshams nas phyogs kyi rtsa'adab bzhi dngan mtshams kyi rtsa'adab bzhi ste brgyad/ dbu ma las gyes ba'i tshul du yod la/ de yang g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa'adab kyis ro rkyang la phug nas yod do/ /rtsa'adab rnams phyi dbyibs tshigs pa sum rim pa'i rnam pa la nang sbubs stong dbu ma nas rtsa'adab rnams kyi rtse'i bar du tal le yod pa'i rtsagashor gyi rmya ma'i shar gyi rtsa'adab gyi nang du a ā/lhor i ī/ nub tu u lū/ byang du e i/ shar lho'i rtsa'adab kyi nang du mo zung ngu / lho nub kyi nang du au ring 4/ nub byang gi nang du yo/ byang shar gyi nang du āḥrnams 'god/ rtsadangor bar ma'i shar gyi rtsa'adab kyi nang du ka kha ga gha/ shar lhor tsa tsha dza dzha/ lhor ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha/ lho nub tu ta tha da lha/ nub tu pa pha ba bha/ nub byang du ya ra la wa/ byang du sha ṣa sa ha/ byang shar gyi rtsa'adab gyi nang du nga nya ṇa na rnams lagod do/ /rtsagasor nang ma'i shar gyi ga'adab la ṛ thung ngu/ lhor ñtsā ring 4/ nub tu laṃ thung ngu/ byang gi ②ladab kyi nang du ṇ+ḍa ring 4 rnams 'god do/ /mtshams kyi rtsa'adab bzhi stong par 'jog /yi ge rnams pyinang du bsgrigs pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ rtsaladab phyi ma'i yi ge rnams kha dog dkar pos snang ba'i ye shes mtshon pa/ rtsagasar bar ma'i ye ge rnams kha dog dmar pos mched pa mtshon pa/ rtsagashor nang ma'i yi ge rnams kha dog nag pos nyer thob mtshon par byed do/ /smi ti'i nang nas phar bltas pas yi ge rnams kha dog dwangs shing gcig gis gcig mi sgrib par khra hram me mthong bar mos nas sgom par byed do/ /snying ga'i rtsagshor gyi ṅgha ti'i nang du na shigs pa'i zig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'am/ yang na steng dkar la 'og dmar ba'i ga'u kha spyor gyi rnam kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khagsungs pa'i pyir/ bzlas pa'i grangs su gzhugs pa ni/ thun gyi ngo ṭo la ha cang myur bul la sogs pa'i skyongan dang bral zhing / sems rtsegacig pas ma yengs par bzlas pa rnams yin gyi/thun btang ba'i skabs su gang byung bzlas pa rnams grangs la mi phan kyang bzlas par ni bshad ṭ+wāṃ/ lasnyi r+shaX dz+nyo pañdzashā dwo trī dz+nyo gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ sprapa/dīpa pa( /bya(/nga/lha )pa dṛ nga palha dī 〉lha byi rgyud las/ nyal dang ma nyal 'dug pa'am/ /zas dang sbyongar sogs rnams la yang / /sngags pas rtag tu bzlos byed na/ /de la gegs ni yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ha cang myur ba/ ha cang bul ba sogs bzlas pa'i skyon de dag spangs dgos te/ dgra nag gi rim pa bcu gnyis pa las/ bzlas pa yi ni mtshan nyid mtshog /bzlas pa gang zhig rab bzlas na/ /dngos grub yangs pa thob pa ni/ /myur bar ma yin dal bar min/ /ring du ma yin zung ngu min/ /zhes dang/ de'i 'grel par dpal 'odzin gyis/ rab bzlas na zhes bya ba ni khyad par can gyi bzlas pa ste nang gi ma ning gi bzlas pa'i ngo bo'o/ /4/ngas pa zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid can no/ /myur bar ma yin zhes bya ba ni skyen par ma yin pa'o/ /dal bar ma yin pa ni yi ge re re nas dal bus brjod pa'o/ /ring du ma yin zhes bya ba ni zung ba rnams so/ /zung bar ma yin zhes bya ba ni ring ba rnams zhes bya ba'i lhag ma'o/ /zhes dang / dgra nag gi 'grel ba nag po pas mdzad pa las/ bzlas pa ni ngag gi rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /mtshan nyid ni 'byung 'jug rjes su dran pa'o/ /mchog ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'o/ /bzlas pa gang zhig ni sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sngags so/ /bzlas pa ni skyes pa dang bud med dang ma ning gis so/ /skyes pa ni ngag gi gtso 'or ro/ /ma ning gis ni nang du bzhag ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'brel ba rjes su dran pas na rab bzlas zhes bya'o/ /de'i khyad par ci zhe na/ dngos grub yangs pa ste phyag rgya 170
