kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khayan lag bcu gnyis kyi thog ma'i rtags phyir shar ba'o/ /bsnyen pa byed dus kyi lha'i kha dog gi khyad par la rgyud dang rgya gzhung las kha dog bsgyur dgos par ma bshad la/ bod kyi bla ma dag rlo padī spri snronā pa rnyi/pa pa dz+nyo ༵ shā ṭ+wāṃ bya sdu shā (rdzu ༵ slo r+shardo ḍā spya da/k+ṣiṃ ༵ swār+sha shā/ sngags kyi kha dog kyang lha dang mthun pa sna tshogs bya ba'am/ yang na 'od kyi bla ma dag lha dbang du sdud (( dhizlo ṭ+wāṃ lha) sno pa ༵ (lha ༵ /shā tār+sha/ /tram̐/papa rnyiswā drisno la gtso lo snying po la ci 'on thon bton nas/ de nas lugar gyi sngags gcig gam gnyis sogs 'don/ de nas mchod bstod/ yig brgyas brtan par byas/ smon lam btab lte thun de las ldang bar snang la/ bsnyen pa grangs bskyel ba'i go rim yang / thog mar gtso bo'i bsnyen grangs zin par byas/de'i rjes su dngor bskyed rim bzhin so so'i bsnyen grangs zin par byas/ denas bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags grangs zin par byas/ de nas ye shes 'phebs pa'i sngags kyi grangs zin par byed la/ rgyud rgya gzhung las gsal kha cher mi snang yang rung lte/ lha gtso po'i sngags song na de gtso 4yin gyi/ dngor gyi sngags gtso 'o masan pa'i pyid sa ra ha'i thod pa'i dkyil chog las/lha'or rnams gtso bo'idzin lag phyig /thadad parani bzlas mi sga /gal te mtshan ma mthong gyur na/ /bzlas pa'i 'phro yang bzugal bas 'grub/ /ces dang / abh+ya ka ras kyang] rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'phyor la ni gsor lo'i gtso bo'i snying po'i sngags nyid kyis lha gzhan rnams kyi bsgrub bya 'grub par 'gyur bas de rnams ni ma bris/ zhes gsungs pa ltas bla med kyi skabs su gtso bo'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyi go chod pa'i skabs 'ga' zhig yod pa'i phyig de nyid bsdus pa'i dkyil mchog rdo rje 'byung ba las thun re re la gtso bo'i sngags gang bton pa'i 172
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jug skal bzang re ba kun skong /bcu cha re gshor rnams kyi sngags 'don par bshad de/ dper na gtso bo'i sngags stong bton na/gshor rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsare bton pas gtso bo'i sngags 'bum song ba na lha'or rnams kyi sngags r+ṇi phrag re 'grub pa rnams thun gcig la 'ong bsade ltar byas na legs so/ /de yang thun dang 4 la tingasnga 'dzin gsum ga bya la/ rnam snang gi sngags 'don pa'i tshe lusadakyil gyi rnam snang gi thugs ka dang] mdun gyi rnarma snang gi thugs ka gnyis ka ladamigasanas bzla la/ des gzhan (r+sha snror+shaṭā/ ñtsā /spri rdzu (3 snar+shahā/shā/shā rmo nga/ snyisna shāX rnyi( ṭ+wāṃ r+shaspya tsho pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ga'i snying po nye snying gi phyir rol tu phreng sngags kyis bskyor bar dmigs la sastong bu'i bzlas pa'am/ khros pa'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa byas la bzla/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshe lha kha dog dmar po bsgoms la rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te bstim pa'i dmigs pa byas la bzla/ 'di tsam las mi gsal yang zhib cha cung zad ma de ltar nyi ma re rer dus bzhi bzhir byas nas bsgoms pas/ grub pa'i rtags 'byung bar 'gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin 'grub pa'i mtshan ma'am/ bzlas pa'i nus pas lha mnyes par 'gyur ba'i rtags gnyis 'byung ste/ snyim pa'i metog las/ de ltar sgom par byed pa nyid kyi dus su bsgoms pa'i bzlas pa 'grub par 'gyur te/grub pade yang de la dmigs pa ma lus pa shin tu gsal bar snang ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir ram/lhun gyis grub pa las byung ba'i dga' ba'i shugs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir ram/nye bar gyur pa'i sgra gsal bar zos pa la sogs pa'i ltas le'u bco lnga pa las gsungs pa'i smri lam gyi khyad par rnams kyis yang dag par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'di'i don ni bsgoms pas 'grub pa'i rtags ladamigs pa ma lus pa shin tu gsal bar rgyun mi 'chad par gonganas gong du 'phel ba'am/ lhun gyis grub pa las byung ba'i dga' bde khyad par can de gnyis 'byung la/ de ni grub pa 173
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khade yang] zhes pa nas/ dga' ba'i shugs rgyun mi 'chad par 'es nga/sa bstan la/ mu tig rlung ba las kyang de ltar bshad do/ /bzlas pa 'grub pa'i rtags la lha'i gsung gi sgra gsal bar bos pa dang/ sogs khong nas lha'i sku'i snang ba sogs 'dzin la rmi ltas kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lha'i bu dang bu mo dang / mi'i khye'u dang bu mo yid du 'ong ba mngon du phyogs pa'am/ pang bar gnas pa'am/nye pa'oran gnas pa mthonganades kyangadangos grub thob par 'gyur te/ rtsargyud le'u bco lnga pa las/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo yid 'ong dang / /khye'u bu mo dag mthong na/ /de ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba sgron gsal las kyang / rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'i bu bu mo yid du 'ong ba lte/ lha dbang la sesnags pa'i lha'i bu mo rnams mthong ba dang] yang na mi'i bu mo'am/ mtshan thams cad dang ldan pa'i khye'u dang bu mo gang gis mthong ba de ni 'dzig rten pa'i dngos grub rnams thob cing reg par 'gyur ro/ /zhesadang/ snyim pa'i me tog las kyang/ lha rnams kyi bu mo dang khye'udang bu modag gang yid du 'ong ba de rnams kyang mngon du phyogs par 'gyur ba'am/ pang bar gnas pa'am/ gang na gnas pa mthong na'o/ /zhes dang]gzhan yang dka' thub kyi gnas la sogs pa'i kun dga' ra ba dang / rgyal pos rtsed mo bya'i skyed mos tshal la sogs pa'i nags tshal dang khang bzang dang gtsug lag khang sogs yid du 'ong ba dang) ri 'o nyams dga' ba la sogs par 'gro ba dang] de na lha'i bu mo'am/ mi'i bu bu mo yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs mthong na dngos grub kyi rtags yin zhing / de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas rang la dbang bskur ba dang / rigs 'dzin gyi rgyal po chen pos mchod par byed pa ma'ong nadangos grub 'grub pa yin te/ rtsargyud le'u bco lnga pa las/ kun dga' ra ba skyed mos tshal/ /lha yi rba mo sesnags pas brgyan/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlab 174
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jugaskal bzang re ba kunaskong /pa/ /bsam gtan dam tshig can gyis/ mthong] /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /de ni mngon par dbang bskur r+ṣi/'ong / /rigs 'odzin rgyal 4 chen po yis/ /mchod pa byas par nges mthong ngo / /zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba sgron gsal las/ kun dga' ra ba ni dka' thub kyi gnas rtso/ /skyed mos tshalani rgyal po'i rtsed mo byed pa'i tshal te/ de dag la sogs pa'ad nyamasadaga' ba'i sa phyogs rnam pa sna tshogs nga/ la lha dang mi la lce gas pa'i bu mos brgyan par bsam gtan gyidam tshig canate/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'gyor la gnas pa gang gis mthong bde ni sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlab pa ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ la)ga rten pa'i bde ba yid la 'dod palang thob par 'gyur ba ni rmi lam gyi rnam par smin pa'o/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur pa gang gis rmi lam du mthong ba de ni rigs 'dzin rgyal yo chen po yis te rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo rnams kyis bdag nyid la mchod pa byas pa mthong na rmi lam gyi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang] gzhan yang rtsargyud las/ rdo rje las rgyung sna tshogs pa'i/ /'i lam dri ma med mthong na/ /sku gsung zugs kyi rdo rje las/ /skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba las/ sna tshogs pa'i ni de ltar gsungs pa rnams dang / ma gsungs pa'i rmi lam dri ma med pa ste/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel pa shan+ti pa'i snyim tog las/ sna tshogs pa'i zhes bya bani/ bdag nyid byang chub semasadapar 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub semasadapa'i mdzad pa chen po la 'jug par 'gyur ba'am/ gzhan yang sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum du 'gyur ba'am/ bu mo dang khye'u yid du 'ong ba'am/ de lta bu'i rigs gzhan 'ga' zhig mthong na zhes bya ba'i don to/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di/ sgron gsal las gsungs pa dang ma gsungs pa'i rtagasasad du 'ong ba sna tshogs 'ong lugs legs grub las gsungs pa rnamasasan 175
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khate/ dngos grub rab ni/ legs grub las/ gal te gnyid log rmi lam na/ /bstan la gtogs pa'i lha mthong ngam/ /so sor rigs pa'i gzugs dag gam/ /yang na rigs sngags bdag po'ang rung/ /daska1na ma〈snag gsum las gcig tsam mam/ /de dag la ni ma〈snad pa 〈snags/ /rgyal sras rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ /sangor ni rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /bdag nyid tsho ga :(da pa'am/ /yang na gos kyis 'phur ba dag /mthong na dngos grub ster 'gyur ba/ /bsgrub pa pos ni shes par s+pha /zhes dang / dngos grub 'bring gi ltas ni/ de nyid las/ ri dang glang po 'bab chu dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni 'bras bu'i shing / /ngang mo la 〈snags bya rnams dang / /seng ge la sogs ri dwags thenags/ /khyu ma〈snag bkra shis rta la drenags/ /bu mosna bzang resna brgyan pa dang / /bum pa la serdzogs bkra shis pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs g.yas phyogs na'o/ /nor dang gos rnams rnyed pa dang / /de la rtsogs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /rmi lam bzang 4 mthong na ni/ /slo chen 'grub par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / dngos grub tha ma ni/ de nyid las/ zho dang 'bras yos 'o ma mar/ /me tog 'bras bu rtsab dang / /yang na grub pa'i rdzas kyang rung/ /rmi lam dag na rnyed pa'am/ /de 'dra'i rnam pa mthong gyur pa'i/ / ༷༷pa /dīpa klidī nga/r+sha /lha( ༵ /ngo/ /ṭ+wāṃ /shā r+nghi sra ( k+ṣiṃ pa ༷pa /ma/pa/ nā dīpya lha/ji pazlob/ gh+nā ༵ spra sngadīpa ༈ sbyo zlo( ༵/ ba/༵༵ paX rnyis lhas da dri ༵ ༵ k+ham̐/ ṭā/ /lha r+shaX rnyisgyu bsnyen pa'am bsgrub pa yis/ /las rnams rab tu brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ nang gi rtags yang rgyud sde sbyo rnam las/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bkres pa chung ba dang / nad las thar ba dang/ shes pa khyad par can 'byung ba dang] lhag par gzi mdangs che zhing brtan pa dang / rmi lam bzang zhing bden par rngi/ ba dngad bzlas brjod la dga' ru song ba dngad ngal ba chung zhing dri zhim 176
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jugaskal bzang re ba kun skong /4 zo ba dang] yon tan lhur len pa dang / lha la gus pa che ru song na bzlas bsgom gnad du song ba'i rtagasasan te/ zhes dang/ legs grub las/ gal te bzlos tshe slo bur pu /sku gzugs ri mo mchod rten las/ /sna tshogs pas 'od byungan/ /de tshedangos grub myur du nges/ /bkres pa chung zhing nad las thag /shes pa khyad par can yang 'byung / /lhag par gzi mdangs che brtan pa/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /mtshan mo rmi lam dag pa dngaka /bden pa rnams ni mthong ba dngan /bzlas brjod byed ladaga' ba ni/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyidayin/ /ngal ba chung zhing dri zhim dang] /gtong phod yon tan lhur len zhing/ /ltal lhag par gus pani/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs se / /des na legs grub kyi rtags 'didagani rgyud sde bzhi lnga'i ltabasgrub pa rnams kyi thun mong gi rtags yin la/ /sgron gsal gyis kyang gsungs padang ma gsungs pa zhes pa'i rgyud 'dir ma gsungs pa'i rmi lam de dag yin pa ni/ /rnal 'gyor pas nyams myong gi steng nas nges par byas nas bshad dgos kyi/ de ltar masan par ci rdol smra ba ni dus lha'or sogs las rnal 'byor ngan pa sems can la gnod par byed par bshad pa'i mtshan nyid de'i nang du 'dug pas mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor bar ga yang lha rgyab kyis phyogs pa sogs kyi rtags ni rgyud sde sbyi rnam las shes par bya zhingaka rtags ngan na bsrung lubor bsgom pa dang/ bla ma la dad gus sogs byas pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang snying mi dga' ba sogs byung na'ang zugs lnga'i dmigs pa la gtad de sems ma yengs par bzlas brjod byas pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa/ sems dag pa'i bsnyen pa gsum gyi go don sngar bshad zin la/gzhan yang / bsnyen pa la/ dkyil lhagar 〈snags su 'jug pa la dbang ba'i las rung gi bsnyen pa dngan dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bsnyen pa gnyis yod cing / dang po la/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa 177
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadang/ lha'i gnang ba thob pa lta bu'i mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dang / lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang brtan pa'i sems dag pa'i bsnyen pa'i mtshan ma gsum gang rung zhig thob dgos te/ de ma thob par dkyil lha'or gyi las la zhugs na nyes pa dpag med 'ong ba'i phyir te/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas pag /dkyil lubor las la 'jug pa dang / /zhes pa'i sgom po'i char gtog cig 'ong bas sngags lugs kyi sgom 4 dang phar pyin zeg pa'i lugs kyi ltang ba bzhi ka mnyam pa'i phyis'phags pa lha'i gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags las/ dkyil 'khor mchog gi slob dpon gyis/ /ldon du bsnyen pa la 'bad nas/ /lha yi dkyil lubor de nyid ni/ /shan tu dul bas brtag par sga /lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byon yin/ /zhes dang] grub chenanag po spyod pa'i bde mtshog gi dkyil tshog las kyang / da ni dngos grub ma lus ༵/na/〈sna spra gā shāshā sna // k+shi / pa/spri ṭ+wāṃ snañdza pa jiX ma k+ṣiṃ spya/ shā/ shārnyi sprad spri/ ts+tsha k+ti ༷hā sna pa'i lam shes pas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i tshogs bsdugag cingan /bgegs ni rnam par nyams byed s+pha /bsnyen pa med pas dngos grub med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las ji lta bu zhe na/ rgyud sde sbyi rnam las/ de la dkyil gshor gyi las ni rang nyid bdag 'jug len pa dang]gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang / rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg sogs yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de'i nang gi las rung gi grangs bsnyen de la/ gtso 4 la 'bum/ gshor rnams la khri phrag re/ yi shes 'drubs pa kha skongs dang bcas par dgos pa ni/ kyai rdor sogs rgyud du ma dang) lha wa pa sogs kyi dkyil tshog du ma las bshad pa'i phyir dang / dā ri ka pas/ 'bring ngam chung ngu'i tshul gnas na/ /dkyil dngor bdag po'i 'bum du ste/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro'i stong phrag bcu/ /bzlas te lha rnams mnyes par sga /ye shes ma:snag la khri phrag ste/ /sbyin sreg ma〈snag 178
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jug skal bzang re ba kun skong /gis nye bar mchod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyis 'de'i ye shes 'phebs pa khri bshad pa thod pa'i rgyud ltar sngags pa rab la dgongs sam dpyad/ 'dir bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags khri 'don dgos te/ bsnyen dus de ltar 'don pa rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ bgesas mthar byed pa'i snying po'i sngags/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsabazhi mchog/stong phrag bcunispenangs su bzla/ /thog mar mkhas pas ji bzhin pu /bgegs rnams thams cad bsal ba'i sgyid /ldon du bsnyen pa zhes ni bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyid ye shes 'phebs pa'i sngags dā ri ka pas khri 'don par bshad kyang/ dbangadon de nyid rab gsal las/ gtso bo la 'grum dang lubor rnams la r+ṇi zag redang] bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags khridang] ye shes 'phebs pa'i sngags 'bum gyi bzlas pa song zhing] pyi ma'i bcacha'i sbyin sreg byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'idon yodade/de ltar gsungs pa niye shes pa 'beb shub pa'i dbang du byas pa yinate/ rgyud las/ri rtsenyamasanidaga' bdang/ zhes sogs kyi 'grel ba'i mchan bu las/ 'der sngon du rangagi lha'i sngags la yi ge bzhi po gdags la 'bum bzla zhing]de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg sga las tshogs gzhan las bshad pa ltar gyi bskyed rim bag padang/ rgyud pa bya b.lang sngon du 'grodagosate/ ye shes pa bshad tshad bzhin 'phebs pa lade rnamasadabostos zung/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidde ltar sngags 'bum 'don pa ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin te/ rtsargyud le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ yang na khro 4 thams cad ni/ /dpen pa'i gnas ni chen 4 ru/ /sngags pas 'bum du bzlas byas na/ /las rnams thams cad byed par bshad/ /ces pas khro 'o rnams kyis mtshon nas lha gang gi yang sngags 'bum bzla dgos par bshad pa'i phyir te/ de'i 'grel ba sgron gsal las/sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba rnams kyis khyad par gyi cho ga bstan par bya ba'i phyis yangan zhes bya ba la serdzogs pa gsungs te/ kho ṭo thams cad ni gshin rje gshed la drenags pa lte/ de rnams 179

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum laltar bcu cha'i sbyin sreg byed par bshad pa'i sgyin sreg gnyis mi gcig ste/ snga ma zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dngaka phyi ma dbang las thams cad pa'i thab tu lha dbang du byed pa'i sgyin sreg yin pa'i phyid'dod lasdo las/ gnyis ka thun mong du ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags khri phrag gcig /de rnams la spyir nyes pa dag byed la ni/ ci tsam 'tshams pa zhig gis sbyin sreg sga yi shes 'phebs pa la ni gzhan nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs te/ snga ma ni zhi ba dang / pyi ma ni dbang ngo zhes dang/ sgyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho las kyang / yang thab de la kha dog dmar 4 byas pa'i sgo nas dbang las thams cad pa yang yod de/ slob dpon blo gros bzang pos/ de nas las thams cad pa'i thab khung du 〈sna ga bzhin du mngar gsum gyis bskus pa'i me tog dmar po stong phrag bcus sgyin sreg bya ste zhes pa sreg rdzas dmar pos las thams cad pa'i thab tu lha dbang du byed pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar gshed dmar gyi mngon rtogs las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / dus gsor dbang le'i 'grel pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags rkang pa bcu drug pa ste/ 'di bye ba bzlas pas sgyin sreg 'bum phrag bcus grub pa chen po brgyad 'grub par 'gyurate/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i nges pa'o zhes dang / legs grub las kyang / rigs sngags dag ni thams cad dang / /sgyin sreg las kyis gzi byin bskyed/ /ces pa nas/ me tog 'bum dag 'bul byas nas/ /des ni lha nyid gzi byin bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa sogs mang la/ rgya ston gyi 'jigs byed rgyud 'grel las/ gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas pa las/ /sbyon sreg khri phrag gcig bya ste/ /zhes se gas sgyi rgyud las bshad par gsungs pa ni sgyi rgyud na lung de mi snang bas nor ba kho na'o/ /yang 'od kha cig gis dkyil lha'or du 'jug rung tsam gyi bsnyen pa la 'bum bzlas nas/de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg byed pa sdom 'byung gi dgongs pa yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ de zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ sdom 'byung gi 182
dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jug skal bzang re ba kunaskong /rim par phye ba bcu gcig pa las/ 47 gyiḥ hā hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sgyin sreg sga /char babs pa dang gter dang ni/ /ngag gi dngos grub bsgrub par sga /zhes 〈snags shin tu mang ba'i phyig yang rang phyogs pa kha cig gis/ bcu cha'i sgyin sreg byed pa thams cad ye shes 'be+ebs pa kho na la byed pa mi 'thad de/ lha gang dang gang gi las tshogs byed pa de'i sngags 'bum phrag du ma'am bye ba bzlas nas sngags de la man ngag gcig kha bsgyur te bcu cha'i sbyin sreg byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ sgron gsal le'u bcu bzhi pa'i spyan ma'i las sbyongar mgan bu las/ 'dir phreng sngags rnams kyi las bsgrub pa la bskyed rim brtan pa sogs sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par du 'og nas mchod pa ltar sngags gang gis bsgrub pa'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig dang / las thams cad pa'i dbang gi thab tu sngags des lha dbang du byed pa'i sbyin sreg khri phrag gcig bya ba 〈snan du btang ba ni sngags la gzhol ba'i las sgrub pa thams cad la 'dra'o/ /zhesadang] ral gcig ma'i sngags kyis klu'i bu mo 'gugs par ston pa'i rtsargyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ oṃ shu li ni swāhā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /klus bu mo mthu chen rnams/ /tshig par gyur cing bosnas dang bral/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rjes su dran/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di yis ni/ /klu rnams thams cad 'gugs par 'gyug /zhes pa'i thad kyi mchan bu las kyang/ sngags 'de bzlas pa'i grangs dang/ de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg sogs sngon du song bas don 'grub kyi ting nge 'edzin gnyis byed/ ral gcig ma ni sku mdog sogs sgrol ma dang 'dra ba de rang gi yum du bya'o/ /de nas las grar gyi dus su/ zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du sdom 'byung las/ yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas la bsgrub/ /bcu ga'i sbyin sprapa ༈ sna spyashād dī krā/ la/nām k+ṣiṃ nge ༵༵ druṃ snrobasna r+sha phyung/ṭ+wāṃ nāṃ sna /nga spra dīspra k+ti paX rnyipa/ r+dha/ ṭ+wāṃ 183

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig zung 'jug skal bzang re ba kunastong /pa'i dkyil gshor la'ang 'khor gyi sngags rgyud rgya gzhung nas ma bshad cing / gtso po'i sngags las 'don par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ don yod zhabs kyi 'jigs byed dbang chog las/ rgyud 'dir dbang thob pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa des dkyil lubor gyi lha rnams bskyed pa dngad bsnyen pa la thug par byas nas yi ge bcu pa'i snying po 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas par bya lte/ dang po bsnyen pa'o/ /zhes gtso bo'i bsnyen pa las gshor gyi sngags 'don bar ma bshad pa'i phyid byas pa la kho na re/ za ma tog las/don yod zhabs kyis de ltar gsungs pa de dpa' cig gi dbang du byas la/ zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ khyod kyis bshad ma thag pa de'i pyir zer na shin tu mi 'gal te/ kho 'os ni don yod zhabs kyis gsungs pa de ro langs brgyad bskog kho mo brgyad bskog zhe dgu ma/ dpa' cig bzhi lnga'i dbang du byas par 'dod cing] de ltar yin pa'i phyirate/ 'dir gzhor gyi lha bskyed par bshad pa dang/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs su zhedagu ma'i mtshan ma bri ba'ang bshad/ yang na ro langs brgyad bskor gyi mtshan ma 'bri bdangakayang na khro mo brgyad kyi mtshan ma sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir pad+ma'i steng du gri gug re 'bri ba dang/ bum pa'i skabs su'ang gtso bo'i bum pa dang lha mo brgyad kyi bum pa 'jog par bshad la/ lha'i rnam dag gi skabs su'ang lha mo brgyad kyi rnam dag bshad pa'i phyig dkyil tshog de nyid las/ mtshan ma dgod pa yang/ de dbus ro ni bri bar s+pha /shar du mgo 4/ zhes pa nas/ me thab la sogs pa bri'o/ /zhes pa 'di yan chad kyis zhe dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ yang dkyil tshog de nyid las/khyad par du grwa bzhir ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du sgra gug bri bar bya'o/ /dbus su ya'i steng du pad+ma/pad+ma'i steng du sgra gug bri bar bya'o/ /zhes pas khro mo brgyad bskor gyidakyil gangor bstan/ yang de nyid las/ yang na sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ro langs brgyad bri ste zhes pas ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dkyil lubor bstan pa sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ bskyed rim chen mo las kyang de ltar bshad 185

zin bris 'ga' zhigda༅༅/ /zin bris 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ /rgyud chen brtsone 'grus 'phags kyi rgyud ṭīka las/ rang gi lugs la/ bskyed rim gyi lam rnams rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du sgom pa la stong gzhi'i rlung sems las sgyu ma'i sku sgrub pa'i smin byed du sgom pa gtso che ba'i bskyed rim dang) rdzogs rim yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi'i smin byed du gtso che ba'i bskyed rim gnyis las/ de gnyis skya nang nas dang po ston pa'i rgyud pha rgyud dang / de gnyis kyi nang nas gnyis pa ston pa'i rgyud ma rgyud du 'jog pa yin la/ de ni pha rgyud ma rgyud du lajog tshul phal ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /rang nyid 'grel ba lta bur gnas nas rgyud gzhan 'chad par byed pa ma yin par/ 'grel ba lta bu'i rgyud gzhan gyis rang nyid 'chad pa'i gzhir gyur pa ni rtsargyud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ 'grel ba lta bu'i rgyud gzhan gyis rang nyid 'chad par byed pa'i gzhir gyur pa ma yin pag rang nyid 'grel ba lta bur gnas nas rgyud gzhan 'chad par byed pa'i rgyud de bshad rgyud kyi gzhug byed yin zhes dang / gzhi rgyud rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gis thabs kyi rgyud rim gnyis bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'bras bu'i rgyud mi gnas pa'i myang 'das zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe gcig la mngon du byas pa ni rgyun chags pa'i don yin te/ rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya bar grags/ /zhes dang / rgyud pyi ma las/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par bshad/ /ces dang / rdzal 'phyor gyi don/ thabs dang shes rab sku snyoms 'jug /rnal 'gyor zhes 201
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khani bshad pa yin/ /gang dag dngos med shes rab lte/ /thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes dang/ rgyud ṭīka las/gsang ba lha'i rnal 'byor brtan podang ldan pa'i rdo rjedang pad+ma 'du byas pa ni sbyo don gyi gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ rgyud rdor phreng las/ 'dus pa'i mchog don rab gsungs pa/ /'dus pa 'dris pa zhes ni gsungs/ /'dres pa nga yis khyod la bshad/ /dpa' 4 rnal 'byor ma spyor ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsang ba ṣ+ṭṛ ti'i mar sna gnyis gcig tu 'dris pa dang /ṅgha ti'i nang gi rlung gnyis gcig tu 'dris pa ni sbas don gyi gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ de nyid las/ gang tshe gsang ba'i rtsaganyis ni/ /yang dag spyor bas reg gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rlung gis gtum mo'i me sbar/ gtum mo'i mes ②stong phrag bdun cu rtsaganyis kyi nang na gnas pa'i byang sems zhu ba rnams ṅgha ti'i lam nas gcig tu 'dres te babs pa ni sbas don gyi gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ de nyid las/ de nas byang chub sems kyang ni/ /gnas kun nas ni zhu gyur nas// ngo 4 gcig tu gyur pa dang / /rtsani gcig gi 'bras bur ni/ /ro gcig tu ni gyur pa la/ /'dus pa zhes ni de la gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig de ltar phab pa nor bu'i rtser 'pho med du bzung ba las kun rtog bzhon pa'i rlung dang bcas pa thim pa las yang dag pa'i ye shes lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang / stong pa nyid gcig tu 'dus pa ni sbas don gyi gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ de nyid las/ phung po khams dang dbang 4 dang / /yul rnams dang ni sbas pa'i nang / /rnam rtog kun nas zad pa las/ /yang dag ye shes bde chen skye/ /ro gcig pa ni ngal gso gang] /de bzhin du ni 'dus pa lte/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid /zhes so/ /'di skad bdag zos sogs gyi don ni/ sam+bu ṭa las/ 'di skad ces bya ba'i tshig gi phrad ni/ de skad ces gsungs nas zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs la bsnyegs so/ /bdag nyid kyi thos pa'i shes rab kyis thos pa yin gyi rtogs pa ni min no/ /bcom ldan 'das rtogs pa'i skyon gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das 202
zin bris 'ga' zhigglib ༵༵ /pa ༵/ gh+nā ((sprad sna /da]ṅge r+shanā lha sbyo shā gh+nā r+shaXdī ༷t+na pad+me snyi ༷ (cor+sha /lha na zhes bya ba ni skad cig ma'o/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /drug 4 rnams la skal zhes sga /'di lta lte/ shes rab kyi dbang gis nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'groms pa de'i sgyig shes rab bha gar gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang zugs rnams dang / /de rnams kyi snying po dang / de nyid kyi rdo rje dang] de nyid kyi btsun mo dang] de'i bha ga de la bzhugs dren/ /zhes 〈sna/ /rgyud ṭīka las/rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku'i ga shas rnams rten gzhal yas khang du sprul pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi zhes pa'i nges don yin te/ le'u brgyad pa las/ mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rigs rnams thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ /shes rab can gyis gnas su bsgom/ /zhes dang] rgyud phyi ma las kyangan mchod rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bzhugs gnas pho brang yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i sgyig lda ྅ 'chang gi phung po lnga rigs lngar sprul pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / zhes pa nas/ rdo rje gdon mi za ba dang] zhes pa'i nges don yin te/ le'u bcu bdun pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisardo rje 'chang gi khams yum bzhir sprul pa ni sa rdo rje ma nas rlung rdo rje ma'i bar gyi nges don yin te/ de nyid las/ sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu yi khams ni ma mā zhi /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidardo rje 'chang gi mig sogs sems dpa' brgyad du sprul ba ni/ dam tshig rdo rje nas rgyal ba rdo rje'i bar dang] nam mkha' rdo rje dang / chos 203
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khakyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje rnams kyi nges don yin te/ de nyid las/ rdo rje sems bskyed nyid dag kyangaka /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil dngor mchog /ces gsungs pa'i phyig rdo rje 'chang gi yul lnga rdo rje ma lngar sprul ba ni/ gzugs rdo rje nas reg bya rdo rje dang zhes pa'i bar gyi nges don yin te/ le'u bdun pa las/ gzugs sgra dri sogs sngags pa yis/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yan lag bcu khro bo bcur sgom pa shugs la bstan la/ des na rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i cha shas rnams rten gzhal yas khangadang brten pa lha so gnyis su sprul pa ni/brjod kyis mi langs pa'i zhes pa nas/ gang bar snang bar gyur to zhes pa'i bar gyi nges don yin te/ lung ston las/ gang yang dam tshig sngon 'gro dang] /sku rdo rje sogs ming can gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems can dngaka /don yon mtha' can de bzhin gshegs/ /'di rnams sku yi yan lag grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 9ga des na gtso gsor rgyud tha mi dad du byas nas bstan pas na nges don no zhes so/ /dbu ma snang ba las/ gcig dang du ma ma gtogs pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /phung gsum mi sridade yi phyig /phan tshun spangs te gnas phyir ro/ /zhes serdzo/ /rgyud ṭīka las/ sbyor gtso bo'i gnas skabs de la lnga yod de/ lhag mos kyi gtso bo/ mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi gtso bo/ lus dkyil gyi gtso ṭo/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gtso bo/ las rgyal mchog gi gtso 'o rnams su yod pa'i phyig de'i nang nas lhag mos kyi gtso 4 dang / lus dkyil gyi gtso bo 'pho ba med de/ lhag mos kyi gtso ṭo yin na rdo rje 'chang yin pas khyab pa dang /lus dkyil gyi gtso 4 yin na mi bskyod pa yin pas khyab pa'i sgyig des na 'pho tshul ni bsnyen pa'i skabs su mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas 'pho/ de yang phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas 'pho/ phyag mtshan la dang po'i mgon 4 la rdo rje dkar po rtselnga pa nas/ gnod mdzes la rdo rje sngon po'i bar so gsum byed/ de yang rnam snang ltabu la mtshon na/ rnam snang mngon byang lnga'i go nas bskyed/ de dang 204
zin bris 'ga' zhigspyan ma snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngal nang du rnam snang gis gtso 'o byas pa'i lha so gnyis bskyed/rnam snang phyir phyung a+thi+-i dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi rnam snang la bstim/spyan ma phyir phyung / sbyi dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas rnam snang gi pang gi spyan ma la bstim/ mi bskyod pa phyir phyung/ spyi dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas rim pa dang po'i shar du lasad/ reg bya rdo rje ma phyir phyung/ sbyo dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas shar lhor 'god pa yin te/ snyim pa'i me rtog las/ gal te rgyal gzhan dbus mar gyug /de yi gnas la mi bskyod 'gyug /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid des gzhan rnams la rigs 'dra/ spyan ma gtso bor serdzong ba'i tshe na/ mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas spyan ma bskyed/ de dang rnam snang snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngal nang du rnam snang gis gtso 'o byas pa'i lha so gnyis bskyed/ rnam snang pyir phyung / sbyo dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas spyan ma'i pang gi rnam snang la bstim/ spyan ma phyir phyung sgyi dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi spyan ma la bstim/ des lha mo bzhi la 'dra/ mi bskyod pa'i gnas dang reg bya rdo rje ma'i gnas ni gong bzhin/ byams pa gtso bor song ba'i tshe na mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas byams pa bskyed/ de dang gzugs rdo rje ma snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngal nang du rnam snang gtso ṭo byas pa'i lha so gnyis bskyed/ rnam snang phyir phyung / sbyi dgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas byams pa'i rigs bdag la bstim pa'am byams pa la bstim pa gang rung byed/ gzugs rdo khu ma phyung nas byams pa'i pang gi de la thim par byed pa yin te/ de nyid las/ gang tshe gshor gtso sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /phyung ba der ni nyim par byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gtsor 'gyur/ /de yi rigs bdag bstim par s+pha /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mi bskyod pa byung nas rim pa dang po'i shar dang / spyan ma de'i shar lho dang / reg bya rdo rje ma rim pa gnyis pa'i shar snyo dang / byams pa phyir phyung nas rang 'dra gnyis pa shar sgo'i g.yas su lasdog pa yin te/ de nyid las/ rgyal ba 205
kun g.yo gsung 'bum khalas gzhan dkyil 'khor ba/ /gal te lubor lo'i gtso 'o byed/ /dbus ma de yang gzhan nyid de/ /rang gnas su yang gzhan nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des sems dpa' rnams la'ang 'gres/ gzugs rdo rje ma gtso sor song ba'i tshe/ mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas gzugs rdo rje ma bskyed/ de dang byams pa snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngal nang du rnam snang gis gtso bo byas pa'i lha so gnyis bskyed/ rnam snang phyir phyung nas byams pa'i rigs bdag la zhes sogs 'dra/ gzugs rdo rje ma phyir phyung nas mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi gzugs rdo rje ma la bstim/ mi bskyod pa sogs kyi gnas de sngar dang 'dra/ gshin rje gshed gtso bor song ba'i tshe mngon byang lnga bskyed sogs 'dra/ rnam snang phyir phyung nas gshin rje gshed kyi rigs bdag /gzugs rdo rje ma gshin rje gshed kyi pang la gzhan 'dra/ gshin rje gshed phyir phyung nas rang 'dra gnyis pa shar sgor 'jog pa yin no/ /des khro 'o gzhan la m+wa/ reg bya rdo rje ma la mi bskyod pas gabyud pa ma gtogs mi bskyod pa dang 'dra/ lha mo rnams gtso sor song ba'i tshe mtshan bsgyur ba dang nga rgyal 'pho ba sogs mi byed de/ mtha' dpyod las/ lha mo rnams gtso gar song ba'i tshe mtshan bsgyur ba dang nga rgyal 'pho ba 〈snags byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa las gzhan pa'i sa'or gyi lha gtso por ma song 'dug pas mi 'thad dam snyam du snang zhing zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / gshang gci gnyis/ khu khrag gnyis/ la sogs pa sha chen te/ bdud rtsilnga la lha bshugs su byas nas dkyil gshor ba'i lha rnams la dbul bar bya zhing / bdag nyid kyis kyang myang bar bya'o/ /bdud rtsilnga pa sha chen la byed par rdo rje 'phreng ba las bshad/ dgongs pa lung ston las rkang la bshad do/ /zhes rtso/ /sgyu lus kyi lha grangs ni/ rig byed sne bzhi dang dus dang sde drug dang me sa gsum dang yi brda/ /nyi sgri 'or nyi mas bcu gnyis kyi brda bcu drug zla rlung gi gzugs can dag /bzhi phyed gsum 206
zin bris 'ga' zhiglas yang dag par 'byung lags so/ /'di zur du mi ston pa ni gnyis snang ba 'od gsal ma dag lha/ rnyi ṭ+wāṃ pa spya/ ༵ ñtsha r+shaspridī dz+nyo te/ /de /shā di ༷dī gā pyi snab steshā shā m+p+raṃ pas ༵/ gh+nā spya ༷༷dgā n+d+ra gsum shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems las grub pa'i zhes pa 'di sgyu lus kyi lha grangs bstan par bla ma snga ma'i gsung rgyud chen dkon rgyam gyis gsungs pa bdag gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las thos zung/ /rim lnga las/ chos phung brgyad r+ṇi bzhi stong ni/ /thub pa chen pos gsungs pa las/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid ni/ /snying po las ni snying por gsungs/ /zhes dang / lha mo bzhis zhus las/ thub pa chen po'i tshos phung 4/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsabazhi la/ /gang rnams de nyid min zhes pa/ /de rnams thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ces dang] sgron gsal las/ thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad r+ṇi bzhi stong gsungs de dag /ces dang / sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyini tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'gyor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /sa ya dang ni dung phyur ji / /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde ni/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/ /zhes dang] bde mchog rtsargyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang1 /rnal 'gyor gsang mtha' dbye ba yin/ /sems can mos rnyi spra mik+ta lhag/ / spra shārnyi spra 〉〉pa ༵ hūm̐ rnyi/ /༷/spya dz+nyo (stang kau ༵ traṃ t+t+waṃ k+ti pahā /sdidī panyizlo la mos pa rgyu yi chos/ /lubor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu'i chos la nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su gsungs par 'gyug /zhes gsungs so/ /sngags kyi zeg pa yang rgyud sde bzhir nges te/ gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'phyor de ltag la'o/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes dang / kye rdor las/207
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khargod dang blta ba dag gis dang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis ni/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes dang) kha bh+yor las/ rgod dang blta dang lag bcang dang] /gnyis gnyis zhabyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes dang]rdo rje snying 4 rgyan gyi rgyud las/ 'dir ni gnyis 4 gabyud pa yis/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni lag bcang dngaka /rgod dang bltas pas shes par s+pha /zhes dang] dbang bskur dgos pa ni/ rgyud rdor phreng las/thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal dz+nyo r+sha dī/ kya/(yishāshā tā smistag ma/༵༵༵ gh+nā ( rnying pasku n+d+ra ༈ pa~X n+d+ra sbyi/na/ k+ṣiṃ byi /rgyu/ ṭ+wāṃ dang/ dbang bskur ba la dkyil gshor du zhugs pa sngon du 'ju dgos pa ni/dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil gshor sngon 'gro ba/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste/ zhes dang / bde mchog rtsargyud las/ sngags pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong bas /gang zhig rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis brten dang] /smig rgyu'i chu la 'thung dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / mnyam sbyongar las/dkyil gangor du ni ma zhugs shing] /dam tshig rnams ni spang ba dang] /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /bsgrub kyang ciyang mi 'grub 4/ /zhesadang/ dkyil lubor yang] ri mo gnas pa'i las dang ni/ /thig las tshon bkye'i rim pa bstan/ /'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /zhes dang/ phyi dkyil la yang] mtshan ma'i sgo nas/ mngon brjod las/yi ge'i hūṃ rtsogs sa 'on/dkyil 'khor dang 4 lte/ /gnyis pa rdo rje rtsogs phyag mtshan/mtshan ma'i dkyil 09gar yin/ /lag pa'i mnyam gzhag pa rtsogs lag pa'i/ phyag rgya gsum pa ste/ /gzugs brnyan lha'i sku'i gzugs bag dgod pa bzhi pa'o/ /me tog bkram pa metog gi tshom bu/ lnga pa lte/drug pa rnal 'byor pho mo 'bag chas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ tshigs 208
zin bris 'ga' zhigbcad dang pos hūṃ sogs sa 'on gyi dkyil gabor/ rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan nam mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mnyam gzhag sogs phyag rgya'i dkyil gnar/ rdul tshon la lugs ma sogs dang ras bris la lha'i sku dang lugs ma sogs bkod pa lha'i gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil dngor dag bstan te 'di dag dbang bskur rung ba'i dkyil gsor ro/ /tshig rkang lnga pas ni me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dkyil gabor te/ 'di ni bsam gtan sgrub mchod dang / sta gon sgya dkyil lubor lta bu'o/ /drug pas ni rnal 'byor pa pho mo lha'i 'dra 'bag sogs gyon pa/ chu tshon gyidakyil gangor gyi lha'i gnas so sor ji bzhin du lha'od pa'i tshogs kyi dkyil gshor te dkyil dngor 'di gnyis kyis dbang bskur pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa ma yin no zhes sngags rim dang / chos ldan rab 'gyor gyi dbang bshad dang/ bla ma rnams gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dkyil lubor gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs rang rang gi dkyil gangor ji ltab bzhin gyi ras bris dang rdul tshon gyi rten dkyil gangor la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'god tshul yang gzhi der 'bri sogs mi thub na/ tsa kra li'i tshul du ras sogs la sa 'on/ phyag mtshan phyag rgya/ lha sku gang rung bris pa'am/ lugs ma dang] 'bur rkos kyi lha'i sku gnas so sor 'dod pa'ang rung ste/ klu'i byang chub kyis/ ji ltar nus pa'i dkyil dngor du/ /sa bon dgod bya yang na ni/ /mtshan ma'am lha yi gzugs nyid de/ /lugs ma'am 'du byas dgod par sga /zhes dang] chos ldan rab 'byor gyi dbang bshad las rten gyi dkyil lhangor de'i nang du rang rang gi gdan la hūṃ la sogs pa'i sa 'on nam rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan nam/ lugs ma sogs 'bur du dod pa'i lha'i sku phyag rgya chen 4 dgod par bya ste/ zhes dang /mngon brjod bla ma las/ mi nus na ni bris pa yis/ /phyag rgya'am mtshan ma dgod par lga /gang yang gsungs pa/ tshon nam yang na pir rnams kyis/ /bris pa rnams kyis rnam par sbras/ /zhes 209
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadang]de'i don dbang bshad las/ phyag rgya ni lag pa'i phyag rgya yin la/ mtshan ma ni phyag mtshan no//de dag sogs la bris pa gnas dedangader bzhag pas kyang rung ba'i donano/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mkhas pa chos grags pa'i dus lnga'or dkyil tshog rnam bshad dri ma med pa'i 'od snang las/ oṃ dam bca' dang mgo 'dren dang bkra shis/ me de ni zhags ldan ma ste sa gzhi/ badz+re bhā wa rdo rje'i dngos 4/ /badz+ra ban+ta rdo rje bcing ba/ badzo nyi ṣ+ṭha rdo rje nye bar gnos/ oṃ sarba ta thā rngoban+ta nāṃ ka ro mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs la 'dud par bgyi'o/ /ba su r+ha rī nor 'dzin ma/ sarba bud dha dza na nī sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed ma/ sarba satwa ā ri ñtsā/ sems can thams cad la phan mdzad ma/ badz+ra satwa ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ rdo khu sems dpa'i bkas/ shī rgyu ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha myur du byon byon/ pha lāk+ṣa taṃ 'bras bu ma nyams pa/ da dwa mi ta wa ta me wa sbyin gyi m+p+raṃ ṭī/ snaXshā /lha pa ༵ ༵ sbyo r+sha pyā pa pā zlo r+sha tā ༷pa sna palta shi byi shā /ra k+ṣiṃ sbyo hā zhu sna ma ṭa zhes pa'i ru ṭa'i byings las/ ru dzo 'jigs pa la'o/ /zhes pas 'jigs par gyis/ ma ṭa rlogs shig ces pa ste bgegs rnams/ di shaṃ phyogs/ ban dha chings/ hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i sa bon/phaṭa ces brjod/ oṃ taste sogs la/ oṃ mgo 'drin/ ta pa gdung ba'am tsha ba/ de la k+ta dang ā pa 'od si dang bcas byin nas/ taste zhes grub pa de nges bzung gi don du slar yang ta〉 zhes lan gnyis slos te gdung ba ma'am/ tsha bama'am/ dro ba ma zhes pa chu 'o gaṅgā'i ming gi rnam grangs su 'gyur zhing / ma hā taste ni gdung ba chen 4 drenags lan gnyis/ swāhā gzhi tshugs zhes pa'i sngags brjod pas lha'i chu 'o gaṅgā bkug ste/ bum chu dang ro mnyam du gyur par blta'o/ /dus gshor ②rgyud las/ dbang mo dpal mo phag mo dang / /zhes pa'i dpal mo ni/ dpal mo mtshan 210
zin bris 'ga' zhignyid ni/ shing kha dog dkar 4 'bras bu pho mo lhor ba byed pa 'dra yod pa/ yul gaṅgā kyi ngar skyes/bud med kyis zos na bu tsha 'byung zhing skyes pas zos na ro tsa bar byed pa chu khams pa ro mngar ba/ 9sna tā re sgrol ma/ tut+ta re phongs pa las sgrol ma/ tu re myur ma/ 9sna paṇ+ḍa da dkar wa sī ni bosnas ma'am/ bla ma snga ma dag gnas ma zhes bshad/ bar de mtshog sbyin ma/ ma mā zhi bdag gi ma/ zhi ri zhi ri thor thor swāhā/ lo tsa ne+e spyan ma/ ba su de nor sbyin ma/ badz+ra dalta kāṣ+ṭha rdo rje so shing / tsa dur bi mo k+ṣa mu kha/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi/ bi shu) swa bhā wa rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin/ kā ya wā ku tsi t+ta dz+nyā na/ lus ngag yid ye shes/ mu khyadan+ta ā te/ kha se la 〈snags pa/ ma lam dri ma/ bi 7stor+ha ya gnyis/ rnam par sbyongangs gnyis/ oṃ sku'i sa 'on/ ñtsāgasung gi sa 'on/bi shud d+dha n+ta smaḥrnam par dag pa'i chos/ sarba pā paṃ ni tsa sdig pa thams cad rnams dang / a su gdong ngam kha/ lhag lha ya sbrengangs pa sarba ji dgra na rnam rtog thams cad/ a pa na ya bsal bar sprapas/ ṭ+wāṃ shā /pa ṭ+wāṃ snangaXn/thaX snro dwo/da shā1 nā me n+dha tsho ༵༵ r+sāhā cho~X snyisna /sna cadī ñtsā kā ma la dal gnye/ rdo rje pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i snying 4 la/ shaspru mal du/ badz+ra su kham hwa rdo rje bde ba chen po'i/ ni nāṃ ka ro mi/ gnyid par bdag bgyid do/ /ya thā ji ltag ta thā ga te na kṛ tra/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa/ haḥhaḥhalngasnam gyi rdo rje gsum mtshon/ a myo n+ya phan tshun/ a nu ga ta rjes su song ba/ sarba dharmā chos thams cad/ pa ra s+pha ra gzhan dang gzhan/ a nu bra biṣ+ṭa'is su zhugs pa/ a byarta a nu bra biṣ+ṭa/ shin tu rjes su zhugs pa/ bud+dha mai tri ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byams pas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ni srungs srungs/ saṅgān ni mi mthun phyogs thams cad do/ /lo tsa ni spyan ma/ lta ba/ ya thā ni ji ltag tatrahwa ni de kho na nyid/ saṃ bra ni brtul zhugs/taṃ mi ni byin pa/ bha shur ri dag pa/ data ñtsā de kho na nyid/ rat+na tra ya ni dkon mchog gsum gyi 211
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khached/ sa ti na ni dngos grub/ dar+ṣa ya ni mthong bar mdzod/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs/ ma mā zhi'i phyag rgya ni/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ thal mo sbyar ba yangs par byas la mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis bkug la rdo rje rtsegasum du byas pa 'di ni ma mā zhi'i phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang //pa /byi /sa rdo g+ni parmo sa zlo paX tram̐ dzo shā sna ༵༵ (sna shā )spya lha zlonā shārnyid zlongo/ dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas skud pa rked pa la lan gsum dkris nas bcing pa byas na sa son bcings pa byas par 'gyur te/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis kyang 'i lam du/ yid la gnod pa skyed par mi nus na/ rmi lam du log 'dren rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bzhin du tsho ga 'dis 'dod chags dang ldan pas kyang mi nus na 'dod chags dang bral bas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'dod pa'idabang phyug dga' ldan gyi bu mo gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'chang ba'i 'dod chags can gyis kyang yid la gnod pa skyed par mi nus na/ de las gzhan pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bud med kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes dang / oṃ ku la pa ri ban+ta ban+ta nyu phaṭa/ 'di ni ma mā ke zhes bya ba'i rig pa chen mo las thams cad byed par sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstan to/ /zhes 〈sna/ /yang thig le mi 'tshor ba'i sngags dang rdzas gnyis la/ khyi dkar po'i rigs med pa'i spu la skud pa gsum sgril la mdud pa gsum mdud pa re la sngags bdun re byas/ rked pa la bcings/ sngags ni/ haṃ raṃ thig /zab a+thi+-i/ pyi pa'i gdams pa red/ lag len kha yar byas snang bar shub par 'dug go/rdo rje khur tshur gnyis phan tshun rgyab sbyar nas mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud ltar byas te/ sdigs mdzub gnyis rab tu brkyangs nas zhags pa ltar byas pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /'dir 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya de nyid kyi mdzub mo gnyis gyen du bsgreng 212
zin bris 'ga' zhigr+sha sdi hūṃ ༵ n+t+wa pyi /spya ༵ ༷༷ ༈ gh+nā tshoX/smo/ pa/ dhī sprab shāsta gh+nā (sna ga/ kāpa//kha snro r+shardo k+ham̐ ༵ nga dmaranag mi chen mo/ raklo a bya ta bya thun bh+yo ga tshong ma khyod kyis rol/ ru lu ru lu myur du myur sa/ bh+yo / zugs byin gyis slobs/ bla ma'i gsung las/ lha mo'i sngags don 'gyur byas na/ ma mo nag mo khrag 'thung ma/ /raka mo nag mo khrag la dgyes/ /dgyes rol khrag la dgyes rol ma/ /tshur byon tshur byon gdan la bzhugs/ /'dra cig gsungs tshong yin/ da cung 'tshol yod pa 'dra bas brtag gsungs/ dre'u rta rkang gsum zhes pa'i rkang gsum gyi don kun zugs la da mi 'dug kyang gcig la ② 'phrul gyi shugs bgrangs tshod yin pas/ 'ju lugs sgo nas yin 'dra bas dper na rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs/ mgyogs pa'i bang] lam lam gyi 'gros gsum la rkang pa gsum gyi tha snyad yinanam brtag gsungs/bum pa'i nang rdzas ji tsam bzhugs pa la/rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u zhe drug pa las sman lnga/ rin chen lnga dang 'bru lnga dngad /ga bur tsan dan dmar 4 sogs/ /sman gyi chu yis bkang bar s+pha /zhes dri lnga yang gsungs so/ /rin chen lnga ni mu tig dang / gser dang / pad+ma ra ga dang / byi ru dang] mu men no/ /pad+ma ra ga med na dngul dang/ zangs dang dung gang rung ngod /mu men med na nor bu yang rung cas /sman lnga ni bri hwa ti dang] daṇ+ḍaka rī dang / a pa rā dzi ta dkar 'odangaka dana.ut+pal dkar dmar ste/ dbyug pa ut+pal la'o/ /dang po ni ltag tsher ma yin zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po'o/ /dbang gi rab byed las dbang lag gcig la bgrangs so/ /'bru lnga ni/ til dang / nas dang / mon sran dang] 'bras so pa dngakagro'o/ /gzhung kha cig tu gro'i dod la mon sran gre'u sogs zhes chag 'gyur du 'byung la/ dpang lo'i 'gyuradang] dbang gi rab byed las/ 'bras so ba'i dod du gsungs so/ /mon sran gre'udang mon sran rje'u ni sran ma che chungasan zhes bla mdag gsungs so/ /'brudang sman lnga la rdo rje mkha' 213
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha'bror len dang sung mi yo tsam re byas so/ /gzhung 'dir bdud rtsilnga dang bcas pa'i dri'i chudang zhes gsungs pas de'i dri ni dā ri ka pas/ ga bur kur gum tsan danadang/ /tsanadan dmar po gla mirnams/ sngags bzlas nas ni blug par sga /zhes gsungs pa ltar dri lnga ste lnga tshan lnga'o/ /pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas snying po lnga yang bshad pas lnga phrag drug lte bum rdzas sum cu'o/ /snying po lnga ni ye shes rdo rje'i rnam lasdoms kyi 'grel ba las/ sa'i snying po hil dngaka chu'i snying po lan tshwa dang/ rtsithog gi snying po mar dang] shing thog gi snying po bu ram dang] me tog gi snying po sbrang rtsi'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /tshogs bdag gi rtog pa las/ de nas la phug ces bya ba/ ro brgyad ldan pa'i nyungs ma ste/zas rnams kun gyi mchog kyang yin/ ro mchog brgyad dang ldan pa yin/ /kha dang skyur dang bska ba dngan /mngaradang tshwa dang lan tshwa'i ro/ /gzhun dang bro mchog che ba yang] /nad sna brgyad kyi gnyen 4 yin/ /mkhris pa bad gan 'dus pa dang/ /khrag dang chu ser ma zhu ba/ /rlung dang rims nad kun la phan/ /zhesadang] la du zhes bya'i zhal zas ni/ /mngar gsum 'bras bu gsum pani/ /de bzhin zhim pa'i spos kyis bran/ /bag zan gyi ni ril bu sga /'o ma mar du btsos byas ṇ+ḍalan gyis la du bag la/ /tshogs pa'i gtor ma chen ṇ+ḍas gtor ma blta snang bas/ po s+pha /mar dang khur ba mngar gsum dang/ /mthun pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs kyis/ /tshogs bdag chen po mazla da par dra/ /zhes so/ /myang ladas bam 4 bzhi bcu gcig pag mar dang / bag phye dang / sbrang midang / bca' sga dang] pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang/ rgun 'brum dang / bal 4 se'u dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu la sogs pa bsdus pa la la du zhes bya'o/ /zhes dngaka214
bde mchog bskyed rim gyi bshad pa'i zin brigda༅༅/ /bde mchog bskyed rim gyi bshad pa'i zin bris bzhugs serdzo/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung rgyun lū i pa'i bskyed rim las/rtsargyud kyis ltadrug cu rtsaganyis tsam bstan nas sku mdog phyag mtshan ma bstan cing]de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la bshad rgyud rnams kyis bskyed rim gyi skor la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba bzhi bcu lhag tsam bstan kyang]'chi ba chos skur zha4ra ba'i lam ga4ra la stong nyid sgom pa khyad med bstan/b.rado longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer la lha'i rnam pa sgom pa la bshad kyang ho yig gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i yi ge gsum bsgom pa dang /yi ge gsum tsam bsgom pa dngakanyu yig bsgom pa dang]nā da bsgom pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gsungs/skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer la bar do mtshon byed kyi yi gede nyid rgyu rdo rje bedzin pa yab yum gyi zhal du 'jug pa/nyi zla gnyis/zla ba dkar ladamar ba'i mdangs can la 'jug pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma zhigabānd cesadang]rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i ngag nas hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod cing snying ga nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros pa'am/ngag nas khaṇ+ḍaro hi brjod cing snying ga nas du ma skyes ma spros la bdud mil gnas pa'i bgegs bsangs zhes dang]gzhan rnams dri lan/stong pa'i ngang las skyed pa'i don/de rnams bden par med kyang tha snyad du yod pa dang]rlung me gnyis ming yig las skyed pa ni/ming gis btags tsam yin pa'i dang / dbyibs dang kha dog dang rgyal mtshan dang me 'bar ba bsgom pa 215
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khani/ ming gis btags pa tsam las med kyang dbyibs sogs dang byed las dang ldan pa'i don no/ /'od gdan mi mge'i skyed pur byed pa ni/ bskyed rim skabs su thod nang gi bdud rtsibasten nas rang rgyud la bde chen nges don rdzogs rim pa'i bde chen lus ngag yid gsum la brten pa dang] gzhi la bde chen gyi rten khams dkar thod par gnas/ sa bon ni stong nyid/ phyi dkar nang dmar ni khams dkar dmar kyi 'du 'phrod mtshon/ dri chen sogs bdud rtsir gzhug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de dag thog mar lus zungs chags pa'i dwangs ma yin pas sbyangs rtogs sbar nas bsten na 'chi med bdud rtsir 'gyur ba'i sha lnga rigs lnga'i sa 'on las bskyed pa ni/ngo 4 rigs lnga/ rnam pa bdud rtsir shar ba dang] sbyangs sogs byas nas phul bas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las grub/ sbyangs gzhi rnams phung khams skye mched du 'dus/ sbyongang byed rigs lnga'i sa 'on bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis grang nus/ bdud rtsir dang khor brlab pa ni bgegs bsang ba dang / 'grel ba gsum ga las bdud miril bus kha dab par byas te gsungs la/ nang mchod myangs pas dgos pa de 'grub/ kha lhor bltas pa ni rgyud gsungs pa dang mthun/ mgron spyan 'drin pa'i tshe rkang pa g.yon pa'i maze 'ong gis g.yas pa'i mthe 'ong mnan te/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbus su g.yon bskor g.yas bskor du bcings te/hra brjod par sdom 'byung las so/ /gtor sngags yang sdom 'byung las byung ba bzhin/ kha kha khā hi khā hi ze 3༄ cho zhig zo zhig /sarba yak+ṣa 〈snags/ thams cad gnod sbyin/ srin 4/ 'byung 4/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ rdo rje mkha' las/mkha' 'gro ma/ i me zhes sogs ni/ 'di gtor ma zungs/ dam tshig srung du gserdzol/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol/ ji bzhin du/ ji ltar legad pa gsol/ shun mong ba rnams blo'i rim pa/ bdag thams cad/ rnam par dam pa'i bde ba rnam par dag pa grogs mdzod cig ces dang] rnam snang ni lus dag byed yin la/ gzugs phung sga dri ma khams dkar po sbyi 216

bde mchog bskyed rim gyi bshad pa'i zin brigdpa' mo dngos yin snyam du bsgoms te/ de yang bskyed rim 'de ltar bsgoms pas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'i sngags bskyed rim rnal 'byor dngan mkha' spyod sogs zhing skyes kyi rnal 'gyor ma mchog rnams kyis lam gyi grogs byed cing / rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa byed pa'i tshe lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gros spogs byas nas phyag rgya srog rtsol du song ba'i sgo nas bde chen gyis stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes 'drin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir lam 'di la pho nya gsum gyi myur lam zhes gsungs te/ de yang rten gyi dbang du byas na phyi'i yul nyer bzhir dngor lo rtsibs nyer bzhi'i lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi/ brten pa'i dbang du byas na de dag na gnas pa'i dpa' 'o dang rnal 'gyor ma rnams la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa ni drang don gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /nges don sgya dbang du byas nas bcu la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la serdzogs pa'i ming gis 'dogs dbo sa serdzo/ /phyi'i yul nyer bzhi dang de na gnas pa'i dpa' 'o dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya dbang po rtul 4 rnams kyis gnas de dag bskor ba la brten nas rang lus la zhen pa ldog pa'i ched yin/lubor lo'i rtsibs dang de'i lha rnams la gnas la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ dbang po 'bring pos lha de dag la gsal snang dang nga rgyal bston te bsgoms pas bskyed rim rags pa la slob pa'i ched yin/ gangor lo lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi dang/ de la bkod pa'i lha rnams la gnas la sogs pa'i ming gis btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya dbang po rnon po'i rtul po des bskyed rim phra mo mthar phyin pa dngaka rdzogs rim las dang 4 bas khams rlung k+ṣiṃ ma( spras dī trī /saX dz+nyo dīhā ñtsā k+tasta shā r+shakā gā twā de r+shasdi ༵༵ /spyarnyi lha dzosdu 223

bde mchog bskyed rim 6 phud pa'i zin bris/gcig tu snang ngo] /zhes dang]jo 'o lugs kyi lha gtso so yab yum dgongs gtad/ rnal 'byor ma bzhis dbang bskur sogs dbang don dang mthun tsam pa/ de nyid las/ gtso so la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa ni rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas btab pa yin te/ rnam shes kyi phung po stong nyid las mi 'da' ba yin pa'i pyig yum la rnam snang gis rgyas btab pa ni chos sku la gzugs skus rgyas btab pa yin te/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes la dag pa'i gzugs phung gis rgyas btab pa yin pa'i pyir/lhag ma rnams rigs can gyis rigs la rgyas btab pa yin pa'i phyir ces dang] gsang dbang gtso 'o yab yum gyis byang sems byin pa myangs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes/ sher dbang he ru das phag mo phyag rgyar gnang ba dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i ye shes dbang bzhi'i dag pa sbyi dang 'dra/ de nyid las/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ zung 'jug gi ya gyal don gyi 'od gsal chen 4 khyad chos du ma dang ldan te/ rgyu'i khyad par phyag rgya srog rtsol du song ba la brten nas byung ba'i snang ba gsum rgyur byas pa las byung ba/ ngo bo'i khyad par gnyis snang ma lus pa dang bral ba'i zag med kyi sher phyin yin pa/ yul gyi khyad par gnyis snang can gyi yul las 'das pa'i bde stong mngon sum du yul du byed pa/ rnam pa'i khyud par bden 'odzin dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i bdag med kyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ yang ya gyal gyi sgyu lus chen po khyad par du ma dang ldan te/ rgyu shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems las grub pa/ ngo 'o lha so bdun me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin mtshan dpe gsal la rdzogs pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog ma 'dris par gnas pa/ chu zla ltar snang brnyan tsam du grub pa/ snyo skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i phyig de yangad mkhas pa phal che ba skabs 'dig dbang bzhis sngags sdom gso nus par bzhed/ rang lugs kyi bla ma kha cig /'di la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa 'odzin pa gron du btang na sngags sdom gso nus par 225
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabzhed/ yang kha cig /de'i steng du dam tshig gsum dran pa sngon du song bas gtso 'o yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pa las skyes pa'i bde stong gi ye shes slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo bsnan na sngags sdom gso nus par bzhed do/ /zhes dngad sbyang gzhi sbyangs pa'i phyir bsgom pa ni/ sbyang gzhi skye shi bar do yan lag dang bcas pa 'di dang 'di gyong ba'i phyir lam lngar bshad pa/ 'di dang 'di sgom gyi 'phen pa shugs drag btang ste/ dngos gzhi'i tshe nga rgyal dang gsal snang la slob pa yin no/ /tha mal gyi snang zhen dag pa'i phyir bsgoms pa la/ tha mal gyi snang zhen spong ba'i phyir du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa na rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa dngos yin snyam pa dang/ lha bsgom pa'i tshe rang gi thob byar gyur pa'i he ru ka dngos yin snyam pa'i dag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal shugs can re skyed pa dang] blo 3'i shugs ma yal gyi bar du de'i rgyun nyid las gzhan mi g.yeng bar 'jog pa zhig dgos te/ tshad ldan du mas/ dag pa'i lha la sesnags pa'i mchog gi nga rgyal skyed pa dang] tha mal gyi nga rgyal bsal dgos par gsungs pa'i phyis yang tha mal gyi snang zhen 'char ba'i gnyen khor/ 'dzings su dag pa'i rten brten pa'i snang ba bsgom pa na rim can du bsgom pa'i tshe skabs gang yin gyi dmigs rten khyad par can re re nas gsal 'dobs pa dngan'jog sgom byed pa'i skabs yan gyi dmigs rten gsal btab pa de la sems rtsegaceg 'grog pa yin no/ /tha mal gyi snang zhen slong ba'ang 'das lam/ gyis spang bya'i sa 'on spong ba ltar ma yin te/ don gyi 'od gsal ma thob par du spang bya'i sa son spong mi nus nga 'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis sa bon nyams smad nas mngon gyur pa slong ba ltar ma yin te/ mnyam bzhag de las langs ma thag tu tha mal gyi snang zhen mngon gyur skye ba'i phyig 'o na ji ltar 'dog snyam na/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil gangor la nga rgyal dang gsal snang bton/ zun gaphyong gargyang bar du bying rgod dang bral bar skyong bar byed na de'i tshe yid ngo'i tha mal gyi snang ba dang zhen pa log pa yin 226

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khridaskal bzang 'jug ngogs/ga4/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khrid thun lngasnang ma yin pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhal lung grub pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi gzhung lam skal bzang 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs gleng/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhi khro dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun yab dang bla ma mchog rnams dang //'jigs byed khro rgyal lha tshogs la btud de//bskyed rim snyan brgyud yid ches gsum ldan khrid//lam de mngon gyur mgon de'i gsung bzhin bri//tshe 'dir sku bzhi lam lnga myur bzod nas//gsang gsum rtser/ longs spyod mtha' klas la/ /ci dgar rol 'dod skal bzang de dag rnams/ /snod skyon dngos grub gegs rnams spong la nyon//'dir pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis lnga'i lam gyi gnad thams cad tshang zhing / rgyud gzhan la med nga/'i zab khyad lnga dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen po ma he'i zhal can dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi rim pa dang po nyams su len pa la/gang gis nyams su len pa'i rten/gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/gnas der yo byad 'god pa sogs kyi khyad par 231

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim padang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogagdrangs/ zhal du zhugs/ zugs kur chags pa chen po'i mes 'od du zhu/ rang mdog can gyi rig le bcur gyug rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar brgyud de zugs dar song / thig le bcu las rang mdog can gyi hūṃ ring po brga de las khro bo bcu mngon rtogs ltar steng 'og phyogs mtshams byasate rim pa ltar bskyed/ rim pa ltar thugs gnas phab/ pad+ma dang rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ thugs dar drangs/ hūṃ brjod padang] de nas phyir spros te gdan so so la lasad pa'am/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bh+yor mtshams nas spros pa gang bde byas tshog/steng gi gtsugator dngor bsgyur ni/ gtso 4 steng gi mdun ngos su yod pa'i gdan la zhal nub ngos su gzigs pa/rdo rje sa 'og gi gdan gtso bo'i rgyab ngos la 'dzur ba las zhal shar gzigs/ kho ṭo bcu gcig po thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing / zhal so so'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra smin ma sma ra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi rus kyi dngor lo dang rna cha la sogs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ mtha' yas gron pos dbu skra bcings pa sogs sna tshogs pa'i sprul gyi rgyan can/shin tu 'jigs su rung ba rdo rje che chung sna tshogs padang gzhur lo dang kho 'o bcu las kho chu bzhus ma'i khu ba 'jor ba ltabus/ rwa gur sogs kyi pyi rol tu 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par bsam/ rgyun par 'de tsam gyis tshog /'di la gsar lo lha'or ba'i gnad/ bsgrub bya sba ba'i gnad/ khro bo zhal gzigs pa'i gnad/'phrin las mdzad pa'i gnad rnams zhal las shes/ gzhal yas khang ni/ rang gnod mdzes yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa 'od du zhu ba las/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ de snyoms par zhugs te 'od du zhu ba las chos 'byung kha dog phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dbyibs shog bu gru bzhi leb leb pa gsum gyi sne rnams sbyar nas zur gsum byas pa'i zur gcig 'og tu dang /zur gnyis steng]shar nub kyi ngos gnyis thal mar gnas ba de ltabu byed pa'am/ chos 'byung phyi 249
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khadkar la nangadamar ba dbyibs gtor ma zur gsum gyi nang brus pa'i rtsemo zur du bstan cing]gdengs ka che ba gyen la bstan pa/ stengan kha yod cing zur gcig shar du bstan pa/de'i 'og zur nas paṃ ljang gu las yu ba 'og zur 'phrad mtshams nas zon pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma dkar ser dmar ljang srel ba'i re bzhi'am/ so gnyis sam/ bcu drug yod pa/ de dag gi phyogs kyi 'dab grangs rim bzhin/ bcu drug dang/ brgyadadang] bzhi re yod pa/ pad+ma de'i ge sar seg lte ba ljang/ 'dab ma'i phyi mtha'anas phyi mtha'i bar la cha phran gya bzhi/ lte ba'i phyi mtha'anas pyi mtha'i bar la cha phran brgyad cu/de'i lte bar hūṃ gron po nyal 'greng gang rung las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa rwa rnams phyogs mdog /lte ba gron po/ rwa'i spom ladakhus rwa rnams kyi rtsab la cha phran gsum/dbus kyi sgom la bzhi/ rtsemo la gcig /phyogs rwa rnams kyi rtsab la cha phran gnyis/ dbus la gsum/ rwa thams cad kyi srid la cha phran bcu drug /dbyibs phyogs rwa rnams dbus rwa'i tshangs thig gi steng nas phyogs phyogs su cha phran brgyad brgyad song ba na rwa'i pyi thig thon zhing /drug gi mtshams nas nang rig zon pa/ cung zad phyir gyes te dbus rwa'i 〉la cha phran gnyis phyir song ba'i mtshams su zug pa/ de'ang phyogs kyi rwa rnams ni 'gro ba snying rjes mi gtong ba mtshon pa'i chu srin gyi kha nas thon par ma lte ba'i dbyibs gru bzhi bre leb kyi rnam pa can/ rgyar cha phran zhe brgyad/ dpangs su cha phran nyi shu/ de'i lte ba'i lteng du rgyu dkar po sangs rgyas kyi sprin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba las rnam snangasab yum mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ snyoms par zhugs/ 'od du zhu/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan bcas/ dur khod tshun chad dus gcig la grub pa byas nas/ rim gyis gsal 'debs ba ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng gi phyogs phyogs su lte ba'i dbus kyi tshangs thig las cha chen bzhi bzhicasar ba'i mtshams nas jig pa lnga sbrags kyi zheng cha phran gcig /sgo logs kyi gdung gi steng du dbangs cha phran 250
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogs/gcig /gzhan phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su bar ma chad par kho ra khor yug tu gru bzhi byas nas bskor ba/ ngos so se'i dbus nas brgyad cha gyis pa'i sgo/ de dag gi mtshams nas phyi rol tu cha phran bzhi drang por song ba'i sgo khyud / de'i rtsonas cha phran gnyis ngos su song ba'i sgo 'gram/ de dag gi rtsenas phyi rol tu cha phran gnyis drang por song ba'i sgo logs te/ sgo logs kyi rtsenas sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i zad mtshams bar la cha phran gcig yod pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga ni/ phyi rol nas rim bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang gro ba/ zheng cha phran gcig gi lnga cha re/ de'i steng du rin 4 che'i pha gu zheng cha phran phyed gnyis sam cha phran gcig /dpangs cha phran gcig pas khor yug tu bskor ba'i cha phran phyed phyed phyir dpag pa/ de'i gzhi rin 4 che dmar po la/ rin sa che zur gsum gru bzhi zla gam/ thig le thenags sna tshogs pas phra btab pa lta bus mdzes par spras pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags zheng cha phran phyed dang gnyis sam cha phran gcig /dpangs cha phran phyed re yod pa bzhis khor yug tu bskor ba/ de'ang gser gyi ska rags re re la'ang rin 4 che bdun ldan te/ 'og tu lda'i snying po'i ka ba/ de'i steng du mu tig dmar po'i bre/ de'i steng du sprug gi gzhu/ de'i mchog ma gnyis kyi steng du shel gyi ka chung re/de'i steng du baiḍūr+ya'i n+d+ra re/ de'i steng du dngul gyi gzhu rnams brtsegs pa cha chung phyed phyed kyi bar dang bcas pa bkod pa phyi nang du tshar gnyis/ gzhal yas khang gi zur rnams su lda'i snying po'i ka ba/ de'i steng du mu tig gi bre/ de'i steng du spug gi gzhu bsnol ma/ de'i mchog ma bzhi'i steng du shel gyi ka chung re/ de'i steng du baiḍūr+ya'i bre re/ de'i steng du dngul gyi gzhu gaphyog dra bar btang ba/ de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags leb mo snam bu lta bu thams cad du khor yug tu 〈snad pa/ de dag bsdoms pa'i dpangs la cha phran phyed re yod pa/ de lta bu'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ gser kyi ska rags bzhi lnga'i dpangs la cha phran gnyis/ rtsig pa'i rtsa251
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabanas gser gyi ska rags steng ma'i bar la cha phran bcu drug yod pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi rgya phyed dang mnyam pas/ rgya phyed dpangs mnyam pa'i tshul lo/ /gser gyi ska rags de'i steng du sgyi gabyams gru bzhi pa'i lcam rngam zheng cha phran phyed yod pa bkal ba'i lcam sne phyi la cha phran phyed re thon yod pa la chu srin ma ka ra'i mgo yod pa sga gzhal yas khang gi nang du lte ba nas phyogs phyogs su cha phran bcu bzhi re dor bar rngam zheng cha phran gcig pa'i gser gyi rdo rje'i phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ dbus kyi tshangs zig las phyogs phyogs su cha phran bzhi re dor ba'i mtshamasanas rngam zheng cha phran gcig pa'i re mig gi snam bu drang 4 bzhi phyogs phyogs su rdo rje'i phreng bar g+ne bkal te re mig dgu pa sga re mig gi snam bu drang po dang zlum 'o 'phrad mtshams su 47de 'argyur ltabu'i ka ba phyogs mdog brgyad btsugs/ steng dulang re mig ltar gyi gdung lubor dang gdung ring bzhi re mig tu bsnol ba'i dbus skya rgya mthong gru bzhi pa ma gtogs pa'i phyogs phyogs su lcam gaphyogs mdog nyer brgyad re'i pyi sne gser gyi ska rags la bkal/ nang sne gdung gshor zlum 'o la bkal/ yang gdung gangor zlum po la phyi sne dngaka nang sne rnams re mig gru bzhi pa'i gdung la bkal/ rgya mthong gru bzhi'i shar lho'i gru dang / byang shar gyi gru steng du ka ba bseg kha gnyis mgo nub dud/ lho nub dang nub byang gi gru steng du ka ba bseg kha gnyis mgo shar dud/ bar du rgya phebs kyi gdung 〉lho byang du rgyugs pa bkal/ rgya mthong kha gdangs la bre spungs dpangs sgo tshad tsam yod pa gru bzhir gsor ba la mar sne bkal ba'i lcam gyi yar sne rnams rgya trabs kyi gdung la bkal rgya pibs steng du rtog sogs 'chad 'gyur dang 'dra ba bya ba'am/ 'ogs 'dzub lugs len dgani/ slobadapon rang nyid kyis bla ma'i bzhed ba bkod pa yin snang la/ gzhan zhedagu garo lungs brgyad bskogadapa' cig rtsogs rgyud skyadangos zin gyi thog 'bub lugs bcugasum ma la byas chog pa zhigagasungs yodade ṇ+ḍar ma bris rtso/ /yang na rdor 'phreng zlum 'o dang drang 4 'phrad mtshams nas cha phran re nang du 252
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim padang po'izab khridaskal bzang 'jugangogs/'ongs par rdor phreng gi gzhogs g.yas g.yonate shar du ka bdakar po gshor los mtshan pa can gnyis/ lhor ka ba ser 4 rin 4 che cha dgu pas mtshan pa gnyis/ nub tu ka ba dmar 4 pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa gnyis/ byang du ka ba ljang khu ral sgras mtshan pa gnyis/ de rnams kyi sgom la cha phran re/ dbyibs gru bzhi/ ngos so so la lha'or lo la sogs pa'i ri mo bris pa ltar yod cing/ rdul phran rnams kyang gshor lo sogs kyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ dpangs steng du n+d+ra/ gzhu zungaka gzhu ring dang bcas par cha phran bco lnga yod pa/ de'i lteng du gdung ring sngon po 'og ngos la rdor phreng gis mtshan pa/ sgoms su cha phran gcig yosnad pa/ phyogs bzhir thad shar btang ba'i gdung gnyis gnyis bsnol te/ sne mo rnams gser gyi ska rags 'og ma gnyis la bkal/ steng ma gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon bsten pa/ gdungade dag gi steng du phyogs phyogs su pyi 'khyams gru bzhi pa'i lcam spoms su cha phran phyed pa/ phyogs re re la lcam nyer brgyad re yod pa/ lcam sne nang ma gdung ringadedag la bkal bas/ lcam sne gdung las cha phran phyed thon pa la gsal byed kyinor bu dga' ba 'khyil bas smras pa/ zur rnams su zur lcam cha phran gcig pa gdung bsnol mtshams kyi steng du bkal ba/ lcam sne nang ma gdung las cha phran gsum las lhag tsam thon pa/ sgo khyud g.yas g.yon gyi steng gi nang dngos su pyi sabyams gru bzhi pa'i lcam sne pyi ma 'gel ba'i gdung dang] sgo khyud kyi phyi ngos kyi g.yas g.yon steng du sgo khang gi lcam snenang ma 'gel ba'i gdung]de gnyis kyi bar gyi sgo khyud g.yas ga〈snan la lcam sne bzhi 'tshed la btang / sgo logs kyi steng gi rtsigs rgyun pha gu dang bcas pa'i steng gi gser gyi ska rags la sgo khang gi lcam sne phyi ma bkal zhing] de'i lcam sne nang ma sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon dang/ de'i bar gyi gdung la bkal/ sgo logs g.yas g.yon gyi steng du pad mchod kyi phur pa zur pa btsugs la chu srin gyi kha ga de rnams kyi steng du dral ma dang thog 'dam rngams su cha phran phyed pa bkab ste/ khro khang dang sgo khang rnams kyi 253
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha'og kha mnyam zhing snyoms par phub/ sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi bar du sgo'i ru bzhi cha phran pyed pa/ g.yas g.yon dang steng gi ngos gsum la pad mchod yod pa btsugs/ de la sgo glegs zheng cha phran phyed dang gnyis 'byod sdom nang nas byed pa/ phye tshe phyir gyes 'phro ba phyogs mdog /sgo'i ya zem dang gdung gi bar du shar du gangor lo/ /lhor rin 4 che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje/ rgyar cha phran gcig pa 'tshed la bzhi sgrigs/ de tshar gnyis gnyis steng 'og tu byas pa/ pyi khyams gru bzhi pa'i zur lcam gyi sne mo nang du 'phags pa/ de'i steng du rgya phibs kyi ka ba bseg kha sgom cha phran gcig /srid cha phran bcu gnyis 〈snad pa bzhi btsugs pa/ de'i nang tshan gyi byang shar dang shar lho'i ka ba gnyis kyi mgo nub dud/ lho nub dang nub byang gi ka ba gnyis kyi mgo shar dud/ de dag gi steng gi rtsemo phan tshun sgo tshad kyis ma reg pa la rgya phibs kyi gdung zheng cha phran bzhi/ steng 'og gi rngams cha phran gnyis/ srid cha phran nyer brgyad dam nyer bzhi yod pa lho byang du rgyugs pa bkal/ gdung de'i sne gnyis la khyung gi mgo mgrin pa dang bcas pa/ rwa bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu kha phyir bltas/ kha nas rin po che'i phreng ba ka ba bseg kha gnyis kyi sgrog gdung sleb par 'phyang ba/ rgya phibs kyi gdung de'i steng gi dbus su rdo rje lajigs byed kyi rtsargyud bzhugs pa'i khang bu chung dbyibs gru bzhi/ rgyar cha phran gsum mam gnyis/ dpangs su cha phran gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du rin 4 che'i pad spungs cha phran gcig pa/ rin po che 'bar ba'am cha dgu pa cha phran gcig /de'i steng du rgyu nor bu rdo rje las grub pa'i rdo rje rtselnga pa'i rtog dpangs cha phran gcig /gzhal yas khang gi nang gi 'og gi maril nas tog gi rtse'i bar la cha phran gleng gnyis yo da pa/ nang mthil gyi rgya la cha phran se gnyis 'dzid par mnyam pa'i rgya mnyam dpangs mnyam gyi 'bub tshul lo/ /lho byang du rgyugs pa'i rgya 3bas kyi gdung de la lcam sne nang ma bkal/ lcam sne phyi ma 254
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khridaskal bzang 'jugangogagrnams phyi khyams gru bzhi pa'i kha gdangs la gser gyi ska rags sngar bshad pa lta bu'i n+d+ra lungs dpangs cha phran bzhi'am/ de las lhag tsam yod pa phyogs bzhir gabor mar btang ba la lcam sne phyi ma bkal ba'i shar nub kyi lcam dang ka ba bseg kha gnyis kyi bar la sgrog gdung btang la/de dang ka ba bseg kha la lcam sne nang ma bkal/ pyi ma phyi khyams grwa bzhi ba'i steng gi gdung la bkal ba'i lho byang gi lcam sne rnams cung zad phyir thal ba/ 'og ngos su shar bu'i snam bu dang /steng la pad+ma zob ma phyed pa'i chu skyor ma kha dog ldon sho can gyi rgya sgabs rta rgyab khyung gzhog can phub/ rin 4 che'i pha gu'i steng du gser gyi ska rags bzhi la bkal ba'i lcam sne gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i pyi ngos su cha phran re thon pa'i sne mo la chu srin ma ka ra'i mgo byas pa'i kha g.yas g.yon nas thon te 'phyang ba'i nor bu rin po che sna tshogs srel ba'i phreng ba khug par byas pa'i dra ba/ de'i dbus su nor bu spom 4 g.yas g.yon gser gyis bsnams pa'i steng gi nang ngos su zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ kha'i dbus nas rin 4 che'i phreng ba drang po'i dra phyed sne mo la nor bu sgom po steng 'og gser kyis bsnams pa/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon du gos sna tshogs kyi dra phyed/ de'i slo g.yas g.yon du me tog sna tshogs kyi dra phyed de/ dra phyed lnga bsgrigs kyi rtsemo la gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha lce la zla phyed rdo rje dang rnga yab dkar po 'phyang ba/ dra ba dra phyed thams cad mar sne pha gu la sleb pa/ lcam sne de'i steng du dral ma dang / de'i steng du shing tshag ga phran gcig phyi ngos su lhag pa'i bya 'dab/ shing tshag rnams kyi sne 'og tu rin po che'i shar budabyibs sbyo blug mchu med mgo thur bstan lta bu'am/ rus rgyan rnying pa'i za ra tshags ltabu kha dog dkar 4/ bya ladab kyi mtha'i steng du mda' yab kha dog dkar po dbyibs pad 'dab phyed pa lta bu/ dpangs dang rgyar cha phran gcig /'thug rngams cha phran phyed pa bu shu ltar bslang ba/ shar la sogs pa'i sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi steng gi mda' yab la gser gyi bum pa nas 255
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha'on pa'i rin po che'i yu ba 6ngos gsum gargyag pa/ rtsemo zla phyed rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa la 'phyang ba'i stod lha rdzas kyi dar yug gcig pa/ smad kyi dar lce gsum thur du 'phyang ba/ 〉mo la dril chung zla phyed can gyi ba dan dang rgyal mtshan re re ste phyogs re la ba dan gnyis re dang /rgyal mtshan gnyis re ste bsdoms na rgyal mtshan brgyad dang ba dan brgyad/ nya spu rgyas pa/ seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa/ ngang pa klu za ba/ mi'am ci pho mo sogs kyis mtshan pa dar lce yod pa ni rgyal mtshan dang / med pa ni ba dan no/ /rtsig pa'i zur bzhi la gdugs yu ba cha phran gsum pa/ rtsel zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ gdungs khebs dkar po cha phran gnyis pa can gyi gdugs dkar po bzhi spre'u bzhis bzung ba/ rtsig pa'i 'og gi mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu kha dog dmar po zheng cha phran gnyis pa/ rngams cha phran gcig gam gnyis pas 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor ba la/ mchod pa'i lha mo me tog ma/ mar me ma la sogs pa rang ming gi mtshan dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs pa brgyad/ sgo sesna so'i g.yas g.yon du gnyis re lte bcu drug /kha dog dmar skya la 〈snags pa gar stabs kyis gzhal yas khang la phyogs te lha'od nas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa re re/ 'og gi phyi'i grwa bzhi dang / nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa re re ste zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa so gnyis/ sgo so so'i mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rtsab nas them skas dpangs rdo rje'i lte ba dang mnyam zhing/ zheng dang dkyus bang rim steng ma steng ma la cha phran bcu drug /'og ma rnams rim gyis je cher song ba bang rim lnga pa bzhi brtsegs pa phyogs mdog sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa dang zem skas gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig mi sgrib pa'am/ dbus rwa'i g.yas g.yon du zem skas bang rim lnga pa/ bang rim re re la skas kyi gdang bu lta bu'i bang rim bzhi bzhi yod pa rwa rtse'i steng du dbangs cha phran dgu/ bang rim lnga mchod rten gyi bang rim lta bu'i steng gi rgya la sgo tshad 256
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogaggcig yod pa'i zur bzhir gser ram rin 4 che gang rung las byas pa'i bum pa cha phran phyed 'amad pa las thon pa'i ka ba rnga yu lta bu dbus ldir la sne gnyis phra ba phyogs mdog ka ba bum pa dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran lnga yod pa/ rta babs re re'ang g.yas g.yon gyi 'og tu ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa/ ka ba de dag gi steng du gdung bzhi bkal ba'i gdung bzhi 'phrad mtshams nas btegs pa/ de'i steng du gser snam ser 4 srid cha chung phyed dang gsum/ g.yas g.yon gyi pyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar cha chung bcu drug /nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha chung bcu gcig /dpangs cha phran gcig /de'i steng du shar bu'i snam bu dang / rin 4 che'i snam bu gnyis kyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha phran bcu gnyis re yod pa/ dpangs cha phran re re/ shar bu ni dbyibs sgyi blug mchu med mgo zur du bstan pa lta bu dkar 4 gzhi rin po che sngon po las 'bur du dod pa'am/ snam bu gong ma'i 'og la 'phyang ba gang rung ma rin po che ni gzhi dmar so la rin so che zur gsum gru bzhi semags kyis sbras pa pha gu lta bu/ snam bu 'di gnyis kyi srid la cha phran gsum gsum/ rta mig ni nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la cha chung brgyad/ srid cha chung lnga/ dpangs cha chung gcig /kha dog mdzes tshon nam/ ljang khu la rta'i rmig ris nag 4 yod pa 'de gsum gyi pyi mtha' mnyam pa'i pyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar cha chung bco brgyad/ mun snam ni snam bu gong 'og gi bar stong ste/ dpangs cha phran phyed dang gnyis/ 'og ngos kyi g.yas g.yon gyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha phran brgyad/ steng ngos kyi g.yas g.yon gyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha zan bdun/ steng ngos kyi srid la cha phran phyed dang lnga/ 'og ngos skya srid la cha phran bzhi/ de ni steng gi snam bu'i 'og sne nas mun snam gyi ka ba phan la cha phran gcig yod pa de'ang tshur mun snam la brtsis pa lte/ phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar la cha chung bcu drug yod par bshad/257
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khayang g.yas g.yon gyi ka ba'i phyi mtha' nas sgyi mtha'i bar la mun snam du byas te/ phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar cha chung bcu bzhi dngaka yang ka ba'i nang mtha' tshun la mun snam du byas te mtha' nas mtha'i bar cha chung bcu gnyis su bshad/ de ltar na dang po'i tshe steng gi srid la cha phran phyed dang lnga/ 'og ngos kyi srid la bzhi/ gnyis pa'i tshe steng ngos kyi srid la cha phran phyed dang bzhi/ 'og ngos kyi srid la cha phran gsum dang / gsum pa'i tshe steng ngos kyi srid la cha phran phyed dang gsum/ 'og ngos kyi srid la cha phran gnyis/ mun snam la ka ba phyogs mdog can sgyi nang du bsgrigs pa'i gzhogs nang ngos su seng ge dang] seng ge rkang brgyad pa dang] rma bya dang] mi'am ci pho mo brtsegs pa kha rdo rwa ngos la phyogs pa/ wa ran+t+ra ni phyi mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar cha phran bcu drug /nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha phran drug /dpangs cha phran gcig /srid cha phran lnga/ dar lce zur gsum par bcad pa lta bu'i ris can nam/ 'bol ris/ mun snam ni bar stong ste mtha'i dpangs cha phran phyed dang gnyis/ dbus kyi dpangs cha phran phyed steng gi g.yas g.yon nas rgyab 'brel ba/ 'ogangos kyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha phran drug /steng ngos kyi snam bu dang mnyam pa'idabang du byasanas/ ka ba'i phyi mtha'anas cha phran re bsnan pa'i tshe phyi mtha' nas pyi mtha'i bar cha chung bcu bzhi dngad ka ba'i phyi mtha' nas sgyi mtha'i bar cha chung bcu gnyis dngakaka ba'i nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar cha chung bcu ste/ de ni stengangos kyi dbang du byas/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ngosanas phan tshun ma 'tshel bar yod pas/ phyogs re'i srid kyi tshad ni/ dang po'i tshe cha phran bzhi/ gnyis pa'i tshe cha zan gsum/ gsum pa'i tshe cha phran gnyis/ 'di'i ka ba'ang sngar bzhin/ 'di yan gyi snam bu rnams ni g.yas g.yon bar ma chad pa/ gser snam gyi phyed nas cha phran phyed kyi bar can gyi glang rgyab kyi kyog po snam bu de rnams kyi nang mtha' ji ltar kyong ba ltar gyi kyog sar bya la/ de la rin 4 che sna tshogs pas phra btab/ rta dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim padang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogagngos kyi cha phran drug pa glang rgyab kyi ri mo dang bcas pa'i 'og la bla re rnam par bkra ba/ srid cha phran drug /zheng rta babs kyi 'og rgya dang mnyam pa dar gyi sham bu 'phyang ba'i mtha' bskor rin po che'i do shal dang] do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng gi shar bu/ rin po che/ mig pa rnams ni sngar bshad pa ltabu la/ g.yas g.yon kyi snam bu rgyun ma chad pa/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'ang de bzhin no/ /mun snam dang/ shar bu dang] rin ṭo che dang / rmig pa bzhi ni mtha' nas mtha'i bar dang/ srid la ga phran bcu bzhi/ steng gi mda' yab kyi snam bu'i srid la cha phran bcu khadog dkar po/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'i pyi nang du dpangs dang zheng cha phran re re/ dbyibs pad 'dab phyed pa lta bu/ mthug rngams cha phran pyed pa phyi nang du bcu re/ g.yas ga〈snan gnyis kyi sne gnyis sam/ngos gnyis su de lta bu'i pad 'dab pyed pa'i dbyibs can gsum gsum bsgrigs pa'i steng du/snam bu leb mo bkab pa/ de'i steng gidabus su pad zla'i gdan la gangor lo ser 4 rtsibs brgyad pa'am/ bcu gnyis pa cha phran phyed pa yu ba mu khyudadang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran gcig gyen du 'greng ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon cha chung phyed phyed du ri dwags pho mo gser mdog gdong 'greng zhing gsor lo'i rtsemo la bltab/ lus po'i 'og gzhinas gdong mgrinadang bcas pa'idapangs cha phran gcig /mjug ma gnyis kyi mthar mda' yab gnyis gnyis sngar bshad pa lta bu/ rta babs kyi rmig snam gnyis dang / wa ran+t+ra'i snam bu'i steng gi mchog ma gnyis su sngar bshad pa lta bu'i ba dan dang] rgyal mtshan gnyis gnyis/ rta babs kyi steng ri dwags kyi mjug ma'i phyogs kyi mda' yab phyi ma gnyis la ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan re re ste/ rta babs re re'i steng du bdanadang] rgyal mtshan brgyad re lte/ bsdoms na bdanadang rgyal mtshan rtso gnyis/ rta babs kyi mda' yabanang ma gnyis kyi steng pu spe'u kha nang du blta ba re res bzung ba'i sngar bshad pa lta bu'i gdugs re re ste rta babs re la gdugs gnyis re/ bsdoms na gdugs brgyad do/ /259
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kharta babs kyi snam bu rnams kyi sne ngos kyi zheng la cha phran bzhi'am gsum 〈snad par mtshungs/de lta bu'i rta babs rnams ni gzhal yas khang gi sgo logs kyi gdung dang cha phran gcig gi bar can no/ /rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon 'dod snam gyi 9 rol tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba cha phran lnga lhag pa'i steng du gser ram rin po che gang rung gi bum pa las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing lha rdzas kyi gos dang] rin ṭo che'i phreng ba dag 'phyang ba'i yal ga drug pa can gyi yal ga dbus ma la khyim bdag dmar 4 mdzod ldan kha nang bstan/ mtha' skor yal ga drug la lhagar lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ bud med gro bsang lo bcu drug/glang chen dkar po mche ba drug ldan/ dmag dponanag po ral gri can/ rtamatshog ljang khu'am ldon 4/ rin po che zur brgyad pa'am drug pa ser ñdzi gang rung rnams rim pa bzhin gnas/ shing de dag la ma reg tsam gyi steng du grub chen re re phyogasade'i sangs rgyas rnam snang se gas kyi rnam pa can/ de'i steng ginam mkhar sprin gsebanas lha'i bu kha dog sna tshogs pas me rtog gi char 'bebs pa dang] phreng ba bzung ba gzhal yas khang la phyogs pa/rdo rje rwa ba me ridang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod kyis bskor ba dur khrod kyi skad dod shas ti la yi ge bsnan pas sha ba ni ro dang] bas ti ni gnas te ro'i gnas/ yang shra shan zhes pa dur khrod de/ sha ba nam pas na zhes pa la/ sha ba'i ba ma yig tu byas/ sha'i smrasag gi a nyis/ dbyangs med pha rol tu sbyar ba'i rtu/ bas na'i ba ar bsgyur ba la sa byin pas sā ring ṭ+wāṃ ( lhasna/salha par rnyi sno ṭā gh+ri ra'i bsdu ba byas te yi ge lhag ma phyis pas/ shra sā na zhes par bsgyur ro gnas pa'i bya ba byed tshul ni/ ro mgo med kyis 'chag pa dang] 'gags te dbyangs pas langs pa dang/ 'gyel bas nyal ba dang/ gsal shing la bskyon pas ni 'dug pa'i bya ba byed pa'o/ /des na dur khrod kyi gnas la dur khod ces bya'o/ /dur khod kyi gnas ni dur khod dngos 260
