kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha)dpal gyi thugs gar 'phyos nyi ma'i dkyil gshor 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ de dag 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs pas/ gdug pa can gzir bar byed pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil lubor shin tu tsha zhing bzod par dka' ba'i 'od zer dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa'i nyi dkyil chen sor gyur par nga rgyal bzhag /de'i steng du hūṃ yig shin tu che ba gdug pa can skrag par byed pa'i 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa yi ge'i gzugs tsam ma yin par hūṃ sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bur sgrogs pas gdug pa can rnams brgyal bar byed pa la nga rgyal bzhag /de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa 'bras bu'i lha zhe dgu'i rnam par spyan drangs/hūṃ la zhugs pa las kho bo'i rdo rje chen po kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa/ phyogs rwa rnams kyi rtse dbus rwa la ma reg par shin tu gdengs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gyi 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/ lte ba'i bum pa'am sgo nga'i nang du sngar las 'jigs pa'i hūṃ yig mthing ga hūṃ sgra'ang sngar las cher sgrogs pas mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne mo las rdo rje phra mo dpag med/ rdo rje de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i rnam pa can/ 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum bcas yum med/rdo rje rtselnga pa rnams nyi gdan la gnas pa dpag med du gyur te/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams thams cad til gyi gang bu bzhin du phan tshun gcig la gcig bcar te gang ba slos nye/ yum med dang] phyag mtshan rnams kyis 'od zer spros pa'i dang/ yum bcas rnams kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur bas/ sems can rnams gang la gang 'dul gyis btul te spyangs/ rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi go 'phang la bkong/ de nas phar spros pa'i sprul pa rnams dang / sems can rdo rje 'dzigs byed du gyur pa rnams lhan cig tu 266
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim padang po'i zab khridaskal bzang 'jug ngogs/'dus/ rdo rje la rim/ zla ba de'i steng gi nyi ma/ rdo rje sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su rgyud tshogs zhing nas 'de'i bar gyi sbyang gzhi dang bcas pa lam lngar lezhug tshul ni/ 'phyo ba bzang 4ra skye 'gyur gyi las gsog pa'i thog ma nas bsags pa'i mthar 'chi ba'i snga logs kyi smig rgyu'i bar gzhi dus kyi tshogs lam/ 'chi dus kyi smig rgyu nas/ bar do mngal du zhugs dus kyi 'chi ba 'od gsal tshun chad ni gzhi dus kyi bh+yor lam yin la/ de gnyis ni mos bh+yod kyi sa dang / sa bcu'i dang po dang /mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i lugs ldog gi nyer thob nas bzung lte/ las kyi rlung gis mngal gyi sems can mgo mjug ma bsgyur gyi bar gyi zla ba bcu ni rim bzhin gzhi dus kyi sa gnyis pa rab tu dga' ba nas/ gzhi dus kyi sa bcu gcig pa chos skya sprin/ de'ang mngal gyi zla ba dang 4 ni gzhi dus kyi sa rab tu dga' ba mthong lam dang/ zla ba gnyis pa ni sgom lam dang sbyar bar bya la/ mngal gyi sems can las rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur nas phyir ma phul ba'i bar ni gzhi dus kyi sa bcu gnyis pa dpe med kyi sa khyad par gyi lam dang / mngal nas phyir phul ba nas/ phyir ma btsas pa'i bar ni gzhi dus kyi sa bcu gsum pa ye shes ldan gyi sa bar chad med lam yin no/ /de dag ni gzhi dus kyi slob lam dang / phyi rol tu btsas ma thag pa ni gzhi dus kyi mi slob lam sa bcu bzhi pa kun tu 'od rdo rje'i sa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya la/ de dag spyong byed bskyed rim la sbyar na/ tshogs zhing gi mgo thugs lnga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros ༷ spyaX n+d+ra/ spyo ༷྅ spyaX ༷ ྅༷༷ /pa/ shaṃ spya /rdo ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷ sgyuX hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ñtsā//( /༈ sde 267
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khanyi ma'i dkyil lubor la zhugs pa'i bar mthong lam/ nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ bskyed pa nas/ rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i bar 〉khom lam/ sa gnyis pa'am sa gsum pa 'od byed pa nas/ sa bcu pa'am sa bcu gcig pa chos kyi sprin gyi bar dang / rdo rje las 'od 'phros pa nas tshur ma 'dus kyi bar ni sa bcu gnyis pa dpe med kyi sa'am khyad par gyi lam dang / 'od zer tshur 'dus te rdo rje la thim pa nas 'jigs byed kyi skur ma gyur pa'i bar ni sa bcu gsum pa ye shes ldan gyi sa bar chad med pa'i lam yin la/nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ bskyed pa nas 'di'i bar sgom lamadangaka 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur bzhengs pa ni sa bcu bzhi pa kun tu 'od rdo rje'i sa dang mi slob lam yin no/ /bskyed rim la sbyang gzhi bh+yong byed ngo sprod dgos la/ngo 'phrod lugs kyang skye 'chi bar do gsum ci 'dra ba de bzhin du bsgom pa yin te/ bskyed rim ni mar sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum dang mthun pa'i sgo nas der grang ba dang / yar rdzogs rim gyi sku gsum dang / 'bras bu'i sku gsum dang rnam pa mthun pa'i sgo nas smin par byed dgos pas so/ /de la sbyatshong gzhi'i skye ba len pa poni/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyi mir skye 'gyur gyi 'dzam bu gling pa des lus ci 'dra zhig gi skye ba len na/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan zhing khams drug ldan gyi mir skye ba 'odzin/ gnas gang du skye ba 'dzin na/ pyi lcags ri nas dbus kyi ri gling gi bar ste/ dngos su na 'dzam bu gling der ro/ /las ci 'dra zhig bsags pas skye ba len pa ni/ zhing khyad par can la badrend nams bsags pa'i las kyis 〈sna/ /de ltar mi'i lus phyi ma len pa la/ snga ma'i phung 4 ma dor bar mi rung bas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyis phung sogs kyi snang zhen zhi bar byas nas len no/ /snga ma'i phung podor nas phyi ma'i lus ma thob pa'i bar der bar do med par mir mi skye bas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi rjes su shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi rang bzhin can gyi bar do 'odzin/ bar do ba des lus rags pa don du 268
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khridaskal bzang 'jug ngogs/gnyer ba las/ las kyis 'phangs pa ltar 'dzam bu gling pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rags pa thob 'ong lte/ dpe de bzhin du lam bsgom pa la sbyar na/ 'di yang nyungang byed lam gyi skye ba len pa po ni/lam ba〈snam pa'i sngags pa des/ lus ci 'dra ba zhig gi skye ba len pa ni/ sprul sku 'bras bu lda ྅ 'jigs byed kyi skur skye ba 'dzin/ gnas gang du skye ba 'odzin pa ni/ rdo rwa nas gzhal yas khang gdan bcas kyi bar ste/ dngos su na gzhal yas khang gi gdan dbus ma'i steng der ro/ /las ci 'dra ba zhig bsags pas skye ba len pa ni/ zhing khyad par can la dmigs nas phyag mchod/sdom bzung sogs zhing la tshogs bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis so/ /de ltar lha'i lus khyad (dī /spya 〉 ñdza r+sha tshi r+yaṃ r+sha dī dīpa ñtsā shuzlo sbyo pahādī rnyi tsho ṭ+wāṃ ñtsha hūm̐ sbyo (3zhe/hūm̐ sna pa/ pa spra /shā len no/ /snga ma'i tha mal pa'i phung po doranas/ phyi ma'i lha sku khyad par can ma thob pa'i bar ma do'i lam med par lha skur mi skye bas/ stong pa bsgom pa'i 'og 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rdzogs gong du rgyu rdo rje 'odzin pa longs sku 'jam dpal gyi skur ldang ba dgos/ sku tha mal ba'i mig gis rgyud yul du ma gyur pa de/ yid ngor rags pa'i lha sku khro bo'i dbang sa sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed du ldang dgos/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas bskyed tshul ni/ a yig dang po las byung ba'i zla dkyil bsgom pa ni zla ba las byang chub pa dang] me long ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ zla ba'i steng du sa 'on phyag mtshan las 'jasmu dpal bskyed/ nyi dkyil gyi 'od zer dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa ni/ nyi ma las byang chub pa dang] mnyam nyid ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /nyi ma'i steng du phyag mtshan sa bon las khro bo'i rdo rje bskyed pa ni/ sa 'on dang phyag mtshan las byang chub padang / sor rtogs ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla nyi rdo rje rgyudang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad lhar byas pa dang lhan cig tu tshur 'dus nas thams cad 269
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha༵ sbri dz+nyo pyi ༵nga swā/ pa k+ṣiṃ ༵ shā rnyilha paspri( ༵༵ spya/ (( hūm̐ gh+nā ༵ /༷dzo k+ṣiṃ ༵ ༵༵ phru( chen po'i skur bskyed pa ni/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa dang/ chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /'di yan chad yum bcas tsam bskyed pa dang po bh+yor ba'o/ /rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa khros pa las kyang cher khros pa/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis kyang khro bo'i dbang po thams cad kyi lag cha dus gcig tu 'chor ba/ 'jigs pa las kyang ches shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i dpal rdo rje 'dzigs byed chen po sku mdog char sprin lta bu'i mthing nag /dbus zhal gsum/g.yas kyi rwa rtsan zhal gsum/ g.yon gyi rwa gan zhal gsum ste/ zhal dgu'i 'og ma bdun gyi snyan tshun chad kyi dbu 'od dang mgrin pa gcig pa la/ snyan phan chad 'bur po bdun dod kyi tshul lta bu/ g.yas g.yon gyi rwa rtse'i dbus zhal gnyis ni gzhal byas/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi zhal gnyis gnyis ni dbus zhal de dag las g.yas g.yon du gyes pa lta bu/ ma he'i zhal gyi rgyab tu zhal med par ral pa ser skya gyen du brdzes pa skyes yod pa/ g.yas su sog pa'i dkar yol kha gcig gi nang nas dpung mgo brgyad mdun ngos su steng nas 'og tu bsgrigs/ brgyad rgyab ngos su steng nas 'og tu bsgrigs/ rgyab phyag mdun phyag tshar gnyis gnyis kyi steng gi gyes mtshams nas thon pa'i glang lngags 'dzin pa'i phyag ste g.yas na bcu bdun/ g.yon na bcu bdun te sum cu 〈sna bzhi/ dpyi'i gshor mig gcig gi nang nas g.yas su zhabs brgyad mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrigs pa/ ga〈snan du mdun nas rgyab tu brgyad bsgrigs pa lte zhabs bcu drug /zhabs g.yas pa brgyad kyi zhabs ma〈sna rnams g.yas phyogs su bstan nas pus mo phyir bkug lte g.yas pa brgyad bskums shing/ g.yas pa brgyad kyi zhabs rting nas g.yon pa brgyad kyi zhabs nying gi bar lha rang gi mtho lnga yod par byas te/ g.yon brgyad drang por zhabs rtsegayon logs la bstan te 270

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khaser po/ de las rdo rje sna ser po zhal gsum phyag drug gri thod thugs dar 'dzin pa/ sna dbang gi ngo 4 zhal sna sgo la phyogs pa/ lce'i rtsaba'am dkyil gang rung du raṃ dang rga gang rung dmar po las pad+madamar po/ de las 〈 khu lce dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug sgra thod zugs spur 'dzin pa/ lce dbang gi ngo bo zhal phyir blta/ lus kyi dpral ba nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi lus dbang mtshon byed gnas dpral bar kaṃ ljang gu las ral sgra ljang gu /de las rdo rje lus ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug sgra thod thugs nar 'dzin pa/ lus dbang gi ngo bo zhal phyir blta/ lte ba'i bug pa yod pa'i nang ngos su saṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar 4/ de las rdo rje yid dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug sgra thod zugs dar 'edzin pa/ yid dbang gi ngo 'o zhal phyir blta/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan can/ rgyan cha lugs sogs yab gshin rje'i gshed brgyad lta bu/ 'dir rdo rje mig nas rdo rje yid kyi bar rnams rim pa bzhin/ sa snyingaka phyag rdog nam snying / 'jig rten dbang phyug /sgrib sel/ kun bzang] 'jam dbyangs rnams dang don gcig /lha thams cad kyi zugs spur hūṃ gron po las rdor sngon rtselnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du hūṃ sngon 4 las rdor smon/ de las thugs rdo rje rdo rje rna ba lta bu/ mgrin pa'i rtsalubor yod sar āḥ dmar 4 las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba'idabus su༄ཿdmar 4 las pad+ma dmar po/ de las gsung rdo rje rdo rje lce lta bu/spyi bo'i rtsagasor yod sar oṃ dkar po las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po las gshor lo dkar 4/ de las sku rdo rje rdo rje mig lta bu/ de gsum gyi thugs gar rang rang gi phyag mtshan gyi lte bar rang rang gi sa 'on gyis mtshan pa can bskyed/ denas rangadang rdo rje gsum sgya lha'i thugs sga'i sa 'on las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phyos pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod nas/ 'od zer gyis zugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs bkug /sbyo 'o nas zhugs/282
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogs/zugs spu'i thugs rdo rje la thim/ oṃ bkra shis pa dang / skabs 'di'i 'khor gsum bden par med pa dang / sku gsung zugs gsum zungags mtshon/ sarba thams cad/ ta tha de bzhin/ a ga ta sdudang ba'am gshegs pa/ tsit+ta sems sam thugs sam snying / badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bha wa rang bzhin/ad+ma ko bdag nyid/ a haṃ nga'o lte/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid de nga'o snyam du nga rgyal dang sngags brjod/ 'od zer gyis gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs bkug /sbyi so nas zhugs/ mgrin pa'i gsung rdo khur thim/ wa ka ni gsung ngam smra ba'am ngag ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid denga'o snyam dung rgyal dang sngags brjod/'od zer gyis sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs bkug /ñtsha ṭo nas zhugs/ sku rdo rje la rim/ka ya ni lus sam sku ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid de nga'o snyam du nga rgyal dang sngags brjod/ yang skye mched sku gsung zugs kyi lha 'di dag la yum ༵༵ dṛ r+sha byā dī r+nghi/ r+shasdi pa paspras ༵ sna kli sh+lau ñtsā snab ༷nga sbyoX cik+ta/ sprasna nā kyi ṭ+wāṃ /rnyipa kyi ltabaskyed rjes ye shes pa sbyan drangs la mchod de bzhugs pa'ang rung la/ yang na skabs 'dor rdo rje gsum gyi lha dang mnyam du spyan drangs la mchod de bstim pa'ang shin tu rung shing / cho gar dngos su ma bshad pa ltag lā li tas kyang / skye mched sku gsung thugs byin rlabs las/ lha spyan 'dren sogs kyi gsal kha med pas ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bar mngon/ 'dir dang po zugs byin rlabs/ de rjes gsung dang / de rjes su sku byin rlabs kyi rim pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'jam dpal shes rab kyi lha yin pas/shes rab ni lus ngag yid gsum du phye ba'i tshe yid kyi nang du gtogs pa dngan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe thog mar sems la byin gyis brlabs te shes rab rgyas pa 'byung / de rjes shes rab de'i stobs kyis drangs nas 283
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha'chad rtsod rtsom pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i gsung gi dngos grub stsol/ de rjes de lta bu'i mkhas pa des sems kyi dga' bde 'bar nas lus kyi gzi mdangs rgyas pa 〈snags dang] mkhas pa mang po'i dbus na'ang lus ngag yid gsum la 'dzigs pa med cingad mngon par mtho ba'i gzi brjid kyi sku'i dngos grub 'byung bas na dngos grub stsol pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa dang / 'jam dpal thugs kyi lha yin pas yid kyi bya ba gtso bor ston pa'i pyir du'ang yin pas/ dri chab zhon la thugs lngar 'bul ba'ang gnad 'di'o zhes gsungs pa snyan brgyud zab pa kho na'o/ /rang gi thugs zha'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phyos/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rang bzhin gyi gnas chos longs kyi nang nas rnam pa sprul pa'i sku dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rten dang brten pa'i dkyil gshor yin pa la/ grangs dpag tu med pa 'od zer gyi sne lcags kyu can gyis lcags kyus btab lte/ bal lcags kyus drangs pa bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ spyan 'dren r+nghi ṭ+wāṃ )spra ༵༵༵ (( (zhi( dz+nyo k+ham̐ zlo ṭ+wāṃ ji /sna ()spra sna rnyis ba/shāspya dī paspri k+ti/bya(dī rnyi dripa bzhin bden par med pa de ni chos rnams kun gyi ngo 'o la khyab yod pas/ yul gcig 'di kho nar gnas serdzo zhes pa lta bu'i gnas med cing / chos thams cad la khyab pas na sngar ma slebs pa zhig tu 'gro ba dang 'ong ba bral ba/ dper na nam mkha' bzhin/ thugs chos sku'i dbang du byas nalang sems can de dang de rjes su bedzin par 'ong ba dang/ de dang de rjes su mi 'odzin par 'go ba ltar snang yang/ dbyar sogs kyi dus kyi khams bzhin du gdul bya skabs su babs pa na rjes su 'dzin pa sogs yin gyi/ thugs rjes thams cad la khyab pas 'gro (nga dang bral ba/ dper na zhing 'de'i dbyar sogs zhing gzhan zhig gi dbyar 'der 'ong ba dang 'di'i dbyar zhing gzhan du 'a〈sna ba min pa bzhin no/ /284
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khrid skal bzang 'jug ngogs/sprul pa'i sku'i dbang du byas na'angaka 'gro bdang 'ong ba sogs dang bral bani/ dper na skyes bu'i bzhin ras me long nang du 'phos pa dang / de nas gzhan du 'pho ba med kyang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin no/ /de ltar 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid mi mnga' yang chu snod gar yod du chu zla 'char ba bzhin du/ gdul byas gar dmigs pa der ji ltar bsam pa bzhin snang bas na/ deng da lta nyid 'dir bdag gis spyan 'dren zhing gshegs su gsol ba'i lha rdzu sdu/ paspri ṭ+wāṃ m+p+raṃ shā ṭā lha tsho gh+nā tshosna snyi/ rī ༵rno ༷ tsho(pa (( m+p+raṃ ṭ+wāṃ snyi( rnyi lha spra/ khros pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed kyi lubor gyis bskor ba/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bzhi byed pa'i sprul pa la)ga rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i gshin rje gabor dang bcas pa 'dir gshegs pa ste phebs nas bdag la thugs rjesadagongs shing/ byang chub kyi bar du dgyes bzhin du bzhugs su gsol zhes bsam zhing brjod/ 〉gi lha'i sngags don bod skad du bsgyur na/ oṃ ñtsā e ma kho chen kye/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bdag las ni/ /rab dwangs mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /bdag kyang blo dang ldan par mdzod/ /swāhā zhes sam/ yang na oṃ bkra shis pa dang rdo rje gsum sogs kyi don/ hrīḥ'aphyog byed/ halhokye khyod dam e ma kye khyod/ yang na ha ni ngo mtshar ba'i e ma dang] nyo ni kye khyod/ mahā kye chen po/ kro rnyi kho 4/ a gats+tsha a gats+tsha tshur gshegs tshur gshegs sam/ tshur spyon tshur rgyun/ usma ta bdag /pū dza mchod pa/ pra ti so sor ram rab tu/lharnon du bzung ngam bzhes/ pra sā da bka' drin dang] khang bzang dang/ dwangs pa dang / gsal ba dang / bya dga' 'o/ /me bdag la/ dhī mā na blo ldan/ ku ru mdzod/ swāhā gzhi tshugs shig ste/ oṃ 'phyog byed rmad byung kho chen khyod/ /kwa ye tshur gshegs tshur gshegs nas/ /bdag gi mchod pa rab tu bzhes/ /bdag la dwangs pa'i blo ldan mdzod/ /swāhā gzhi tshugs legs par sbyin/ /yang 285
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khana/ oṃ 'phrog byed e ma kye khro ṭo/ /chen po tshur spyon tshur spyon te/ /bdag gi mchod pa rab tu bzung / /bdag la blo ldan bka' drin mdzod/ /swāhā zhes pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ 'phrog byed rmad byung khro chen mye/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bdag las ni/ /〈sna sesnar mchod pa bzhes nas su/ /bdag la gsal ba'i slo ldan mdzod/ /swāhā zhes brjod cing bsam/ 〉ཿṣ+ṭi brjod/ khro bo'i tshogs rang gi snying ga nas spros/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs tshar bcad/ mchod/ muṅga ra dzaḥbarjod/shar gyi sgo bas phyag mtshan phyar tsam gyi brda' byas pas/ gzhan yas khang gzhal yas khang gi steng] lha so so ltaso so'i sgyi sor lta phyogs mthun par bkug pa nyis brtsegs kyi tshul byas/ danhūṃ brjod/ lho'i sgo bas phyag mtshan phyar tsam gyidabyug pas brda' byas pas/ ye shes pa dam tshig pa so rtso la zhugs kyang cung ma 'dris par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin nam/ chu nang du 'o ma blug ma thag pa lta bu/ pad+ma baṃ zhes brjod/ nub gyi sgo bas pad+mas brda byas pas/ dam ye 'o chu 'dris pa bzhinadabyer med pa phyag mtshan gyi rdul nas/ spyan rdul gyi bar dbyer med du 'dris/khaṅga ho brjod/ byang gi sgo bas ral sgras brda byas pas/ sgrub pa sos ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa'i sgo nas lha sgrub pa po'i dbang du gyur/ slar yang sngags rgyas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/mchod/ gsol ba gdab/ de rnams kyi shugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo tsa r+ṇi ka la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs dang me tog gi char 'bebs pa sngon du byas/ bum pa dkar 4 bdud rtsilngas gang ba bzung nas/ sangs rgyas rnams skyes tsam nyid nas lha rnams kyis dbang bskur ba thob pa ji lta ba de bzhin du/ lha mo bdag cag gis kyang dag pa lha'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin gyi chus dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing spyi 'o nas chu rub kyi tshul gyis dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang/ dri ma thams cad skyangs/ chu'i lhag ma ṣ+ṭṛ gtsug tu gnas pa dren serdzo las/286
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim pa dang po'i zab khridaskal bzang 'ardug ngogs/gtso bo'i 4zhal gyi tshangs bug gi steng du mi bskyod pa la longs sku'i mkhas grub rje'i gsung zin bris dag ba gcig las/ longs sku'i rnam ba can g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon〉nga nge bedzin gyi byag rgya can/ gtso bo'i 'od zeng dasas ma'i mchog ma'i steng du rdo rje skyil spung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ cha byad can rdo dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'am/ yab rkyang sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag gyi can/rdo khu skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar dang shar lho ba rnams la rnam snang dkar po yum bcas sam/ yab rkyang chos 'chad mnyam gzhag /lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung ser 4 yum bcas sam/ yab rkyang mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag /nub dang nub byang pa rnams la 'od dpag med yum bcas sam/yab rkyang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang dang byang shar pa rnams la don grub ljang gu yum bcas sam/ yab rkyang skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ yum bcas ltar na dkyil chog gi rigs lnga ltar dang] gnyis ka gang yin kyang longs sku'i cha byad can/ rin 'o che'i rgyan drenags kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis lha so so'i 4zhal gyi tshangs bug gi steng du pad zla'i gdan la 'od dang 'od zer gyis bskor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir byin gyis brlab/ bdag mdun tha mi dad pa 'jug pa gcig pa yin na/ skabs lanar rang nyid gtso bo las rang 'dra gnyis pa phye ba dur khod kyi'ang phyi rol tu gshod de/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par byed/ 'jug pa gcig pa min na/ rang gis spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon lnga ni/gzugs rdo rje ma lag pa gnyis kyis me long dmar 4 ngos gnyis la stong gsum kyi gzugs kun gsal bar byed pa/ sgra rdo rje ma phyag gnyis kyis bi wang brdung ba'i sgra stan pas stong gsum 'geng ba/ dri rdo rje ma phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ ro rdo rje ma phyag gnyis kyis gser sogs rin po che'i snod zhal zas ro brgya bas bkang ba/ reg bya rdo rje ma phyag gnyis 287
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khakyis gos mchog bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang bzhin ras zla ba lta bur rgyas pa la mig ut+pal rgyas pa lta bus sbras pa/ byi ru'i mchu sgros mdzes pa/ 'dzum chags pa'i dbus su mu tig lta bu'i tshem phreng can/ nu ma gnyis 'jam zhing 'bur la bar dog pa/ rked pa phra zhing ro smad rgyas pa lha'i rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyis bklubs pa/ sgeg la 'phyos dal ba/ de lta bu'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bas phyi nang gi 'dod yon lngas mchod pa dang / rgyal srid sna bdun gyis mchod pa ni phyi bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa/ gtso bo'i rigs bdag gi shugs lngar zla gdan gyi dbus su rtsaba'i bla ma/ de'i mdun nas g.yas bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bsam pa'am/ rigs bdag bla ma thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du mos pa'am/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rnams khom tshogs sam mthor brtsegs byas te/ nang mchod lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can/ nang gi khams dkar dmar gyi ngo bor mos la g.yon pa'i mazeb srin sbyar bas/ mtshon don dran te byang chub kyi sems kyis mchod par bsam la/ spyi gtsug gi thad nas rtsaba'i bla ma/ smin mtshams kyi thad nas brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan nas rtsaba'i bla ma'i bar/ snying ga'i thad nas bsgom pa'i dkyil lubor dang / rang gi gnas gsum du reg la rig le byas te rang gis bsten pa'i/ brgyud pa'i bla mas bsten pa'i rtsaba'i bla mas bsten pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil gshor gyi lha tshogs mchod/ de nas rdo ra'i nang ngam bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khod la sogs pa'i rang rang gi gnas su chos skyong ye shes kyi mgon 'o phyag drug pa sogs dmigs la/ lte ba'i thad nas sgos kyi chos skyong dag dang / srung ma dam tshig can gzhan la'ang 'bul/ de nas dur khod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / klu/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyang lhar bskyed la 'bul/ de dag gi tshe mthon rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las rdo rje dkar 4 rtse gcig pa sbru gu can gyis drangs nas longs spyod par 288

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor dmar khrid/dkar po de 'od du zhu ba las pad+ma lanab brgyad rtsab dmar mdangs chags pa lte ba ljang khu/ ze'u 'bru dmar ser/ de'i steng du chu las chu bur gyi tshul du ngo 'o bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin pa la rnam pa a yig dkar po/ de 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil ga'or shel dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal lta bu dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i steng du ngo 4 dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin pa la/ rnam pa hūṃ dkar po/ de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje dkar 4 rtselnga pa la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phyos/ 'od zer la la'i sne la mchod pa'i lha mo lag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa phul bas/ de rnams kyi zugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskrun par byas/ yang 'od zer la la'i sne la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi sbyi bor lubod pa'i sbyongar mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang]pyi thams cad bkrus pas/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad mun khung du mar me btegs pa bzhin sangs kyis dag pa'am/ dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sems can rnams kyi sgyi ṭo nas thim pas sems can rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams dang] phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams bkug nas rdo khu hūṃ dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo sgra gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'byud pa/ gnyis da'ang rin 4 che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis smras pa/ yab rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bo'i rtsalha'or gyi dbus su oṃ dkar 4/ mgrin pa'i rtsagashor gyi dbus susmunamar po/307
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khathugs lnga'i rtsapangor gyi dbus su hūṃ sngon 4/ thugs sgar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo ṭo zla ba'i dkyil lubor 'o ma'i mdog can nam/ kham thug ge ba/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo 'o hūṃ dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng 'greng stabs su gnas pas bskor ba/ sngags phreng hūṃ dang bcas pa las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin chos sku'i pho brang nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa gzugs sku'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur slar yang thugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phyos pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga lubor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du ga〈snal/ zhes ga〈snal ba btab pas de rnams kyis yi shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lha ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / bde ba chen 4 myong / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa rnams la dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'grod sems drag 4 byed pa ni/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ sdig pa'i lubor gsum rang bzhin med par lta ba gnyen po kun tu rgyud pa'i stobs rnams dran par byas la rang dang sems can thams cad kyis dus mnyam du brjod par mos la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes ga〈snal ba btab pas/ thugs da'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pa sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsam/ yang na hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar 4 dpag tu med pa 'phros pa sems can thams cad kyi sgyi bor zug /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi zugs ka nas bdud rtsidakar po byung ba/ 'od zer de la 308
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor dmar khridbrten pa'am bskyod nas song ba sems can thams cad kyi sbyi bo nas zhugs lte/ byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag nas rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur bar bsam/ yang na sngags phreng nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer re re'i sne la rdo ñdza sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa sems can thams cad kyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros/ de rnams kyi spyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sems can thams cad kyi sbyi bor zhugs/ lus gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsam mo/ /de dag gi skabs su gzhan don gyi dmigs pa de gsum gang rigs re byed do/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ zhes sogs kyi dus su rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros nas/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod nas/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi yon tan thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug ste yab yum la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs rgyas par bsams la yig brgya bzla'o/ /de'i thugs lnga'i sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud/bh+yor mtshams nas 'on pa/ rang gi sbyo 4 nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thon nas/ lus phrum phus btab pa'am/ shel sgong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur par bsam/ yang na bdud rtsi'i rgyun de nyid rang gi sbyo 4 nas zhugs/ rkang mthil nas yar lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis ldem me gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas lus shel sgong ltar gyur par bsam mo/ /yang na rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad rang gi snying ga nas nag nur re 'dug par bsam ste/ yab yum gyi bh+yor mtshams kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te rang gi sbyo 'o nas zhugs/ thal phung la phu chu drag 4 phog pa ltar nag had had khyer nas lus shel sgong ltar gyur 309

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnala'abyoradamar khridlha'am bla ma chos 'di sogs la sel yod pa'i rtags yin pas/ bsgom pa'i 'phro re zhig bzhag la/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshags bsnam la 'bad cing bdag 'jug sogs byas la/ nyams dang 'i ltas gang rung 'gyur ba dang slar yang bsgom/ dmigs pa nyi ma dang por gsal la/ gnyis par mi gsal ba lta bu dang / thun snga phyi la'ang de ltar gsal mi gsal steng shugad byung na/ dkor zas sogs zas grib can dang mi grib can sogs dang 'phrad pa'i rtags yin pas/ de la 'dzems shing mtshams dam par sga yang rang gi bla ma dang dam sel yod pa'i mi dang gdong mi 'phrad cing / de'i zas nor la mi spyad la gdong gsar gzhan la'ang 'dzems/ gal te 'phrad na thun de'i sgom rgyu bzhag la/ rnam rtog bsal te/ bla ma dang chos la dad pa bsgom/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas/ lus lhod de bzhag nas rlung ro dgu phrugs su bus te/ slar bsgom par bya'o/ /yang bsgom snying mi 'dod pa dang / rgod g.yeng sogs la dga' na bsgom pas gshor ba'i skyon spangs shing myang 'das kyi yon tan 'thob pa sogs kyi phan yon dang / ma bsgoms pas 'khor bar 'khyams snroshā spraX (〈sna sna tha3 spras ༵༵ snashā paspya pa 91/ pad merdo ṇā da sbrang lha spri ci/ byi / dzo ༷hā dwo ༈ tshogs thob kyang bzhag nas 'gro dgos pa 'di la sems g.yeng ba bdag la snying med pa'o/ /da sngon gyi rgyal sras rtag tu ngu dang / te lo/ nā ro/ mi la sogs ltar lus 'di la rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i snying po zhig len snyam du snying rus bskyed la sems skyo dung nge byas la bsgom/gnyis pa gegs sel la mgegs/ rlung gegs/ 'dzog gegs/ gnad gzhan gyi gegs sel tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ sems dmigs rten la bzhag cing / bsgom dus lta bu dang / lus bsgul bskyod sogs ma byas pa'i tshe na zug med cing / bsgul bskyod byas na lus la na zug 325

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khabrgyad spyadaka /'od gsaladang pos shes sgribadangos gnyen byed/ /gnyis par rnam mkhyen thob cing mi slob pa'i/ /zung 'jug kha bh+yor yan lag bdun ldan dang/ /dus gcig gdul byar gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /bye ba zer 'bum ston pa'i sku gsum dang] /sku lnga'ingo bor sangs rgyas yid bzhin nor/ /ji bzhin gdul bya'i re skong rgyun mi 'chad/ /bla med lam 'brel nges 'byung byang chub sems/ /bcos min rnyed pa tshun chad tshogs kyi lam/ /de bsgoms snang gsum rnyed phyin sbrengar lam dang / /rnam dag ye shes nas bzung mthong sgom dang / /sa bcu'i dbye ba rgyun mtha'i bar du byed/ /dpal ldan rdo rje lajogs byed dus kyi mthag /ngur smrig gar mdzad yab sras gsung ji bzhin/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i zhal/ /gang de snyigs dus tshe gcig 'grub pa'i lam/ /zab pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi bcud/ /sa gsum zla bral rin chen gcig bu 'de/ /dran pa yis kyangadangos grub char chen 'phebs/ /'der 'bad lhag bsam rnamadakar 'od zer gyis/ /skye shi b.rade'i mun tshogs kun bral ba'i/ /sku gsum sku bzhi sku lnga'i pad tshal rgyas/ /zag med bde chen sbrang mil spyod shog /de skad smras len sayi tshangs pa che/ /don grubadabang gi rgyal dang bka' rab 'byams/ /mang pos snganas bskul ltar rgya 'od kyi/ /sngags kyi zeg par mang bltas mang thos pa/ /dge slong 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rgyal bas lung bstan bkra shis zhakhyil du sbyag /zhesadabalardo rje la)gas byedarim gnyis kyi mnangag bdud rtsi'i bum bang rnaphung ñdzi glamakhab sras kyigasung rab kun dang 'phags yul gyi sngags kyi lamarim du mdangalhardo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyagazhung ma lus ba mthong ba'i mang thosagasang sngags kyi na5 'gyor ba'igazugs bag laramadabyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bris ba kun ladage zhing bkrashis bar gyur cig/352
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs gsharasgom gyed tshugda༅༅//rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs yid la gshar sgom byed tshul gyi dmar khrid dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs dren//nam7) badz+ra lha ra wā ya/ma lus rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs//khros pa'i gar mdzad rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid//ngur smrig gar mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs//rnam gsum dbyer med dus kun gtsug na mdzes//mgon des sras mtshog shes rab seng ge la//bla ༵ hūm̐ spyug ñtsha ( spra ṭ+wāṃ ༈ py-i dzosnashā //bya/traṃ dh+ri k+ṣiṃ dz+nyo ñtsha zlo/ sbyon snro sbyo ༷༷ /'i//sgrupa /pa ji gh+nā dge legs rin chen spel phyir 'bri//chos bdag chos rgyal gsum 〈snags grogs mdzod cig/'dir thog mar rang lus mi dmigs pa'i bde chen stong pa'i ngang las bde stong gi ye shes de nyid sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar lte ba dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil gshor dmar khyil le ba me shel gyi maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i steng du chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa brkyangs bskums can gcig la nga rgyal dang gsal snang bsgom la/de yang dal bus ma he'i zhal gyi rwa gnyis/shangs/353
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khazhal gdangs pa'i mche ba/ sma ra dang rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs kyi gsal snang dang / khams gsum thams cad kyi bdag por nga rgyal gsal bar bsgom la/ nang mchod bsangs dus bde stong gi ngang nas thugs lnga'i hūṃ gi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtsela khro bo'i tshogs dpag med spros nas bgegs glerdzogs rgyang ring du rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram du tsho da /( ba/༵༵ k+ham̐ kā/ m+p+raṃ gh+nā par+shadī lha (snro rnyi/ shā ṭ+wāṃ rnyi /( r+shardoda~X bhe+e tshor+sha kau pa/shā rdzu grangs med spros la phyogs skyong re re'ang dngor grangs med can bkug nas phyogs skyong dngor bcas kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam pa can du byas la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lhas bdud midrangs pas/ ljags rdo rje sbu gus drangs te bzhes shing 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangs par bsams la/ de nas yig brgya khrid ltar dang / de nas tshogs zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed spyi gtsug na bla ma bzhugs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa la/ rang gis bde stong gi ngang nas phyag dang / zugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo tsa rtsika sogs kyis mchod pas lha la bde ba skyes par bsam zhing] dper na mchod yon gyi dus su lha mo bzhi mchod yon thogs pa mang pos mchod yon bla ma dang lha'i zhal du phul ba bla ma dang lhas bzhes pa mthong ba lta bur bsgom/ des gzhan rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du mchod pa'i skabs gang yin gyi dmigs pa 〈sna then la snga ma snga ma shar ba dang nga rgyal re gyis/ de nas tshad med bzhi'i bar byas/ de nas chos sku'i lam ga6ra ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'chi ba sbyongang zhing lam gyi 'od gsal dang 'bras bu'i 'od gsal bde chen gyi stong pa la 'jug snyam du 'phen pa btang la/chos 'di dag thams cad ming gis btags pa tsam las med pa'i lta ba bskyed la sngags gnyis kyi brjod don la nga rgyal dang gsal snang gyis/ 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i 'chi ba spyong / lam dus dang 354
dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs gsharasgom byed tshul/'bras dus kyi chos sku 'grub par byed do/ /de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rten brten pa'i lhar langs te sems can gyi don bya snyam du bsams la/ skad cig tsam gyis abh+ya dang mi tra dzo ke ltar 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / phyogs mtshams kun tu rdo rje bsgrigs pa bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba dang / steng rdo rje'i gur dang / gur gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re dang bcas pa bskal pa'i rlung yang mi chud pa'i brtan 4ra bsams la/ de dag gi phyi la rdo rje'i dra ba dang /me dpung rdo rje'i tsha zer can bskal pa'i me dpung ltar phyogs bcur gnyil zhing 'tshub par 'phyo bar bsams la nga rgyal dang gsal snang sgom pa srung gsor thun mong ba'am/ thun mong ma yin pa kho bcu can yang rung / de la dmigs nas de'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang rdo rje dang me ri rnams rang gis rig pa lta bu'i gsal snang la sems gang zin gyis/ bsrung gshor de 'dra rgya shin tu che ba'i nang du yi ge hūṃ las gzhal yas khang blos bslang lta bu sgyi nang gsal dwangs 'ja' 'od lta bu gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ steng na rgya 3bsadang / sgo 〈sna so rta babs can gyi phyogs bzhi'i rtsig pa'i nang thams cad sngon po dar sngon gyi yol ba lta bu/ phyi dkar 4 dang / bar ser 4/ de'i nang dmar 4/ de'i nang ljang gu can 'od chem pa/ nang gi mthil gyi shar dkag lho seg nub dmag byang ljangaka dbus sngo ba la nga rgyal dang snang ba sbyangs te/ des sangs rgyas kyi zhingadag pa 'grub 'o/ /bar do longs sku'i lam gabyer ni/ de nas bar do sbyangs la lam dus dang 'bras dus kyi longs skur ldang snyam du bsam la/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba la 〉chen 4 'od zer sna lnga can bde stong gi ngo 'or bsam/ de 'od du gyur pa las ral sgra 〉slo mtshan pa/ de 'od du gyur nas rje btsun mtshams sprin nam gur kum gyi mdog can/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yosnan glegs bam bsnams pa/ rang gis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mthong ba lta bu/ shugs spur nyi ma can du nga rgyal dang sems bedzin/ 'dis bar do grang zhing lam dus dang 'bras dus kyi longs 355
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khasku gnyis 'grub par byed/ skye ba sprul sku'i lam gsar ni/ de nas lhangor ba'i skye ba ma lus pa grang zhing sems can thams cad la gang la gang 'dul gyi rnam par ston pa'i skur ldang ba dang lam dus dang 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed du ldang bar bya'o snyam du bsams la/bdud dang gshin rje bcom pa'i brdar ma he sngo skya nga ro cher 'byin pa'i steng du/ spang bya thams cad spangs shing mkhyen brtsenas pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par thob pa'i 'jam dbyangs khro 'o/ zugs 'gro ba kun la byams pa dang snying rjes gang ba/ stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes dang bde ba chen 4 dbyer med pa de nyid rnam pa dpal rdo rje la)gas byed ma he khros pa'i zhal can/ de yang zhal gdangs pa'i ljags dang / mche ba dang / shangs dang/ spyan gsum/rdzi ma dang / dbu skra dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug gi mgo 'tsheng 'phyang ba dang / me dpung 'bar ba/mig gis mthong ba lta bu'i gsal snang gis g.yas bskums ga'adon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ma he de'i steng na bzhugs yod snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang gyis/ 'dis lubor ba'i skye ba bh+yong zhing rgyu dus dang 'bras dus kyi sprul sku 'grub par byed/ de'i sbyi sor ngo 'o 'jam dbyangs dang bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam pa bde lhang ba can dang / rang gi zugs dar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs dang] de'i zugs gar rdo rje rtselnga pa'i lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phyo ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ yi shes pa tshogs zhing ltar spyan drangs/ dzaḥzhes pas kho bo tho ba gshin rje gshed kyis ye shes pa de rang gi sbyo 'or bzhag pa 'jigs byed ma he dang bcas pa nyis brtsegs lta bur bsam/ hūṃ zhes pas dbyug pa gshin rje gshed kyis rang gi ye shes pa de rang gi lus la zhugs la ma 'dres pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ baṃ zhes pas pad+ma gshin rje gshed kyis dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis 'o ma dang chu 'dris pa ltar dam ye gnyis dbyer med du byas/ hodzes pas 356
dpal do rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs gsharasgom byed tshugral sgra gshin rje gshed kyis ye shes pa naṃ 'dod kyi bar du dgyes nas bzhugs par mdzad par bsam/ yang de las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ rigs lngas spros pa'i tsa mika serdzogs kyis zla ba'i 'od can gyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba myong/dri ma dag/bdud rtsis gang ba sbyi sor thon pa mi bskyod par gyur par byas/ de nas sangs rgyas la mchod pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon lam byed ni/ mchod bstod kyi tshe rang las spros pa'i lha dang lha mos rang la mchod bstod byas par bsam/ de nas yun ring tsam du de 'dra'i rten bsrung gshor dang / gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i zhal can gyi lha gsal bar snang ba'i gsal snang dang / rang sngar bshad pa ltar gyi rten brten pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed do snyam pa'i nga rgyal gtso sor gyis/ bzlas pa'i dus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ gi mthar a ra pa tsa na dang / ya man+ta ka sogs bkod/ yi ge de dag gi 'od zer gyi 〉las 'jam dbyangs dang rdo rje rnon po sogs zhi ba dang / zhe dgu ma'i ma he'i zhal can gyi kho 'o du ma spro sa/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la ma37da pa sna tshogs byas/ sems can thams cad la dbang bskud rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dgyes nas zugs rjes 'od zer sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par /sdi dī ༵༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ la~X ༷ pa r+yaṃ/ ༵ dīsta /dīdzā pa/sna dīX pā ( ༵ spya ( ṭ+wāṃ shā sna pa pa~X 'tshub gtan mi 'ong gsungs pas 'di gal che/ de nas yi ge bdun pa dang] gtso bo yi ge bcu pa gyis/ rtsasngags kyang thon/ de nas mchod la/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas dngos grub brtan par byas par bsam la/ thun mtshams la ldang bar gyis/ thun mtshams su gtor ma dang / kha zas 〈snags rjes thob kyi nyungad pa rje'i bcu gsum ma dang / bdud las rnam rgyal ltar byas na legs 357

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khanang gsang gsum dang] /gnas gsum dpa' 4 mkha' 'go bcas pas kyang] /snyan brgyud bdud mi'aphyed la dgyes pas skyongs/ /de la 'dir pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las khyad chos lnga'i go nas khyad par du 'phags pa dpal rdo khu 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag gi tho tsam 'god pa la/bsnyen pa'idang/ sgrub pa'i dngarga las gyar gyi rnam bzhag gsum/ dang 4 la bh+yor ba'i khyad par dngan dngos gzhi'i khyad par dngan mjug gi khyad par ro/ /dang 4 la/ 'di'i che ba dang/rten gyi gang zag dngaka gnas dang] yo byad sogs kyi khyad par bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'di la rgyud sde gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos lnga dang ldan zhing / byin rlabs myur la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don du ma rang shugs gyis 'grub pa/ lhag tu deng sang lta bu'i dus su nges par bsten dgos pa yin te/ bde dgyes gsang gsum gyi lam gyi gnad rnams tshang bar ma zad/ dus deng sang lha 'di lta bu bsten dgos pa rgya mtshor brgal ba la ded dpon bsod nams can bsten dgos pa lta bu'i khyad chos dang 4 dang / yang rgyu ma dang me thab kyis 'dus par bshad pa'i sgyu lus 'od gsal mtshon pa'i khyad chos gnyis padang] kha ṭ+wāṃ nas pha rgyud la med pa'i 'bar 'dzag dang bde dgyes kyi bde stong ston pa'i khyad chos gsum pa dang/ yang 'jigs byed rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad tshos me thab kyis shes rab che ba mtshon/ sdigs mdzub kyis 'dzig rten las 'das ma 'das la bsdigs pas dngos grub myur zhing phyogs bcu'i gdon lasdoms/ skyes bu gsal shing la bskyon pas sdig 4 che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar ston pa ste khyad chos bzhi pa dang] spyir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas pa dang rgya 'gyur kun gyi yab tu gyur cing] 'gyur dgos dang]'jigs byed la rgyu dus 'bras dus ye shes sems dpa'i dus gsum ga'i skabs su rje btsun gyi zhal dngos su yod pas rje btsun gyis rjes su 'odzin cing/ rwa gnyis kyis thun mong dang thun 390

'jamadabyangs zhi khro zags sgrub kyi rnam bshad 6ltam ṇi'i phreng mdzes/go༅༅/ /'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rnam bshad skal bzang 'jug ngogs 'dod pa kun ster tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru tsi ka si ta nā tha mañdzu lho ṣā :ñtsa swa ra swa ste tsa/ mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ye shes phung po'i sku/ /mdzes sdug rgya mtsho rdzogs ldan srid zhi na/ /rang las rnyed min rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /dbyangs can lhar bcas la 'dud mgrin mtshor bzhugs/ /gcig gnyis sogs min yongs kyi srid gsum bgegs/ /'joms phyir bdud sde'i mgo na gar mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs ba ma lus 'jigs mdzad ma he'i zhal/ /dran pas bgegs 'joms la 'dud rtag tu skyongs/ /'jamadapal kho bo'i grub brnyes lā li ta/ /la sogs rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras bcas/ /lugs 'dis sa kun khyab mdzad rgyal ba'i tog /yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /'jigs mdzad ma he'i zhal gyis bka' bsgos shingaka /rtswal 'byor bran dang pho nyar /lha snañdza pa(/ skyo/ spyu/ /'a/ kli kā lha sna sra dī rnyisno 〉mi r+shahā ༷/pa ngo/ ༵/ /༵༷dzo/rdzu dkāñdzadī dngos rgyal ba gnyis pa yis/ /rgyal kun yab gcig la zhus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhi khro'i sgrub thabs sngon med ma ṇi ka/'chad pas mchog can dngos grub 'dod dgu kun/ /ster ba'i gdams 431

'jamadabyangs zhi khro zanas sgrub kyi rnam bshad 6ltam ṇi'iphreng mdzes/lo bskor ba'i dus su/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas byang sems du mas lung bstan pa'i gdan sa chen po rdo rje gdan dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du gsungs so/ /rje bdag nyid chen ngos mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge gnyis la dngos su gnang/ de nas rim pas brgyud de/ pho brang chen ṭo 4 ta la nas rang cag gi rnam 'drin rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag po chen po'i zhabs drung pu 'ol kha'i ri khrod pa dge slong ye shes rdo rje dang paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sogs kyis bka' lungadang bcas pa thob/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba khri rin po chede nyid las bdag 'jamadabyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes lan gnyis bshad padang bcas pa thob/yang rje sher senganas 'dulanags padapal ldan bzang po/ 'jamadabyangasadage 'dun 'phel ba/rdo rje 'chang bkra shis 'phags pa/ 'dul nag sprul sku paṇa chen bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/ brgyud pa gnyis 'dus kyi gdamasangag mnga' ba rgyud chen brtson 'grub 'phags pa/ 'dulanag sprul sku rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rtsaba'i bla ma sre rdo rje 'chang chen ṭo la sre rin cen rtsenas rdo khu 'jigs byed kyi rim gnyis cha lag zhal shesadang bcas pa zhus pa'i tshe thob so/ /brgyud pa gzhan yang yod/gnyis pa gdams padangos kyi rdo rje tshig sbram gyidon la/ mchod par brjod padang/gzhung gi don/ mjug gidon gsum/ dang poni tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dngaka bar chad zhi bdang] 'de bzhin du rjes su 'jug pa la bkra shis padang / bka' drin dran pa sogs kyi ched pu rdo rje tshig sbram las/ lhag pa'i lta'ajamadapaladabyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes gsungasate/〈sna graganyis pa gzhungadon la so sor bshad padang/nya5sa su len tshul las tshogasadang bcas padang/'de'i thun mong masan pa'i khyad par phan yonadang bcas pa dang zhi kho sbrag sgrub kyi rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa dngaka gdul bya'i khyad par bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i don bshad pa dang lnga'o/ /dang 4 la 433
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khasgyi'idonadang] bye brag gidon gnyis/ dang 4 ni/'og nas 'chad pa ltar tshul ṇ+ḍa ltar gsungs pade/ blo dman pa rnams kyi blo yul du shong dka' bas dogs pa bkod de cung zad bshad na/ rwa skyo sogs kyi lugs tsam la smyangs pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung gi bshad tshul mi shes pa'i blo chung kha cig na re/ 'di ltabu'i zhi khro sbrag sgrub la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa thus/sa nar bkod padagos kyi/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dngaka 'jamadabyangs ye shes sems dpa' dngaka 'jam dkar sogs bkod pa med snyam na/ cho ga'i kha 'don tsam zhig shes pa dag la de tsam dogs pa skye ba bden yang]dogs pade shin tu mi yodade/ laramadabyangs de dag thugs spur bkod pa'i zhi kho sbrag sgrub rgyud rgya gzhung du ma'idagongs pasan pa'i phyirate/rtog bdunadang/ se bhu ṭa las 'jam dbyangs tsam las 'jamadabyangs so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan mi gsal ba gang zhig/saṃ lcaṭa'i don/ a bh+ya kā ras 'jam dpal rdo dril gyedzin pa tsam zhig bshad/ rtog bdun gyi don lā li ta'i ro langs brgyad bskor du/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing] g.yon glegs bam 'dzin par bshad/ zhe dgu las g.yas ral gri 'dzin cing / ga'angan sdigs mdzub can zhig bshad/don〈snad rdo rje che ba'i lha bcu bdun mar grags pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs ma bshad ga skye mched skugasung thugs pyin gyes rlabs padang/ ye shes semasadapa' (spra dā r+shalha dī (lha (snas ma ca pa/ gā k+ṣiṃ n+dha ༵༵ dī k+ṣiṃ r+nghi shā dzo(shā r+shapa dīpa/snapa ṭā rdzu dī /lha/ dzārwa ka ra'i sgrub thabs las 'jamadapalawe shes semasadapa' g.yas ral sgradang g.yonakha.al (( dītā pa/ /ra/ m+mu sbyong/r+shasna gle pa/ ༵ dīr+shadī dhi /༷/ spridī spri ༵ shālhalha (( hūm̐ gcig bshad/ grub chen zhi ba ye shes kyis 'jam dpal rdo khu sku mdog ser ṭo g.yon ut+pal 434
'jam dbyangs zhi khro zags sgrub kyi rnam bshad tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng mdzes/bsnams pa/ g.yas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya can zhig bshad/ don yod rdo rje chung ba'idapa' cig spra/shā rnyi ༵ ༵ r+sha sna ༵ tsho ༵༵ sdi )phyu rnyi dz+nyo sa (nā ba zlo tsho rjo/ n+d+ra/ spyad spya ṭ+wāṃ ti can rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa cig bshad la/ 'grel ba snga ma las 'jamadabyangs gang yin mi gsal yang / phyi ma las 'jam dpal rdo rjer bshad la/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi 'grel ba las 'angamadabyangs zhi ba tsam las gangayin mi gsal/rtog bdun gyi 'grel ba rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa mnadag gi rgyan ces pa lasadam tshig semasadapa'i zugs lngarawe shes semasadapa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser 4 dz+nyān a ka ras bshad pa ltabu cig bshad/ zhi ba'i las bdun pa las 'jamadapaladakar sa.ut+pal bsnams pa zhig bskyed/ drag po'i las bdun pa las dmar ser ut+pal bsnams pa bshad la/ 'di gnyis lnga'i g.yas zhi ba ye shes ltar mchog sgyin yin par mngon pa yin pa'i pyig shes byed kyang rim pa bzhin du dang 4 yin te/ rtog bdun rwa 'gyur las/ de'i steng du 〉rnam pa la 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs su gyur pa bya'o/ /zhes dang rong zom 'gyur las/ de'i steng du yi ge 〉slos laram dpa la gzhon nu'i gzugs can du gyur par bya'o/ /zhes dang] rgya gar gyi mkhan 4 pradz+nyā shalta dang / lots+tsha ba pradz+nyā ka ras bsgyur ba las kyang] de'i steng du dhīḥser po las bskyed pa'i 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa rdzogs par sga zhes dang so bhu ṭa las kyang] bha ga'i nang du yo las rlung gi dkyil gshor du ba'i rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i dbus su dhīmenangs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal dbyangs gyi gzugs su bsams nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggnyis palangasanate/ saṃ lcaṭa'i rgyudade'i 'grel bar man snye las/ du bani cung zadadamar ba'inag po'o/ /'jam pa'i gzugs canani 'jam pa'idapal shin 4ser ba cung zad khos pa/ phyas 435
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khazung gis rdo rje dang dril bu 'odzin pa zhal gcig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gsum pa yang yin te/ ro langs brgyad bskor las/ rgyu rdo rje 74na pa'i skabs su/ der ni dhīḥlas byung ba yi/ /'jamadapal gzhon nu bsam pani/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /cung zad ser po phyag g.yas na/ /ral sgra g.yon na thegs bam bsnams/zhes dang] sku gsung zugs kyi rdo rje bsgoms/ /de bzhin ye shes sems dpa' bsams/ /zhes ye shes semasadapa' rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pade ltabu gcig bsgoms par bshad pa'i mig bzhi palang yin te/ zhe dgu ma las/ des steng dus ge dhīḥ'ajam dpal gzhon nu yi ni gzugs/ /de yi snying sgar rnam bsam pa/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jamadapal gzugs ni bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /g.yon pa na ni sdigs mdzub yang / /bgegs dang bar gcod yang dag gsod/ /ces gsungs pade lta bu'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes ba tsam las/ ye shes semasadapa' mi gsal ba yin pa'i pyid lnga pa yangasan te/ don yod zhabs kyi sgrub thabs che ba las/ gtso bo bskyed pa'i skabs su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil gshog grwa rnams dang sgo rnams su'ang pad+madang nyi mdang zla ba'idakyil gzhug dbus su pad+ma'i gdan steng duya li kā ⑥ las gyur pa'i zla bdang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/de rnamasayongs su gyur pa las rdo rje la)gas byed chen po kha dog nag 4 drag po chen po/ la)gas padag kyang 'jigs par byed pa zhes dang] yi shes sems dpa'i skabs su yang de nyid las/ skye mched byin gyis rlabs pa sku gsung thugs kyi lhadang ye shes sems dpa' mtshon pa'o/ /zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs la/ mañdzushrī dz+nyā na'i sprapa za~X migā dī l+li rdzu lcu rnyi k+ham̐ k+ti sdu d+dhiswā pas/ ༵༵༵༵ shā ñtsā sna /rdzu sna hūm̐ dzo ༵ thar+shadī pa tsam las mi gsal ba'i phyis drug pa yang yin te/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs kyi 436
'jamadabyangs zhi khro༄gas sgrub kyi rnam bshad 6ltam ṇi'i phreng mdzegrgyu rdo rje ladzin pa'i skabs las/de'i steng dudabyangs yigadang po las rdzogs pa'i zla ba'idakyil 'khor bsam mo/ /de'i steng du 〉〈ga las 'jam dpal 'og nas bshad pa'i gzhon nu'i gzugs can skad cig gis bskyed la/ zhes pa tsam las ye shes sems dpa' dang phyag mtshan rdzu bzlo (sbyo rnyiswār+sha k+ta sna sdutsho sdi k+to/ts+tsha nākli rī k+ṣiṃ ༷dhi m+p+raṃ ñtsha t+t+waṃ ༈ / ༵ ༷/lhasna gzhon tshul can/ /ral gri g.yas lakha.al ga'adzin/ /rgyan rnams kyisani rab mtshes pa/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhes dang] ye shes sems dpa'i skabs su/ de nyid las/'jamadapalawe shes semasadapa'ani/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog seg /rang gi snying sgar bzhugs pas/ /snying la nyi ma'i lte ba la/ /zhes 'jamadapal ye shes semasadapa'ade ltabu gcig lasad par bshad la/ 'de'i rjes 'brang lā rla ta badz+ra pyi mas kyang de ltar bshad tshul 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyig brgyad pa yang yin te/ shrī bhā tra'i dpa' cig sgrub thabs las/ /rgyu rdo rje 'odzin pa'i skabs su/ /ral gri'idabus su yang dhīḥde thams cadacanangs gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral sgra dpung pa'i thad dkar 'dzin spru/ g.yon pas glegs bam thugs gar bsnams pa/ gzhon nu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsaganyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhes dang/ ye shes sems dpa' de 'dra ba gcig lasad pa gzhir bzhag byas nas/ snying dar ye shes sems dpa' bsam la/ de'i snying sgar ting nge 'odzin sems dpa' bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig slob stsu do/ shā papa shāshārnyis m+p+raṃ gh+nā ri kānyi r+yaṃ shā spyu k+ṣiṃ pa n+dha 〉〉 rje b.rā nā dī ñtsha /hā 437
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum khaskabs su/ yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du gyur ba'i steng du a yig dang 4 las zla ba'i dkyil gshor gyi dbus na dhīlas ral sgra'i lte ba la dhīḥser pos mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal rdo rje sku mdog ser po g.yon ut+pal bsnams shing g.yas mchog sgyin gyi phyag rgya can/ gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan pa zhes pa dang/ de ltar gzhal yas khang chos 'byung bsrung 'khor rnams med par bdag bskyed dpa' 4 gcig pa byas pa la/ de'i thugs spur ye shes sems dpa' sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur pa'o/ /zhes pa tsam zhig bshad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes sems dpa' rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu zhig gzhir bzhag byas 'dug pa'i phyir/ bcu pa yang yin te/ don yod rdo rje chung ba'i bzhed pa 'chad pa'i skabs kyi bskyed rim chen mo las/de nas chos 'byung gi dbus su yo las rlung gi dkyil gshor du ba'i mdog can gyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil pangor gyi steng rnyilas ral gri'i dbus su pad+mas mtshan pa/ de nas pad+ma ral gri zla ba rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal rdo rje ser 4 ral sgra sa ti 'dzin pa/ zhes gsungs pa de lta bu rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa las ye shes sems dpa' mi gsal yang / de ltar bsgom pa gzhir bzhag tu 'dug pa'i pyigbcu gcig pa grub ste/ rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel ba las/ dhī7)ga zhes pa ni ser po'o/ /'jam dpal zhes bya ba ni/ mgon 4 zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /ral gri po hi phyag na bsnams/ /rdo rje skyil krung bh+yor ba ste/ /rgyu yi rdo rje 7thun bdag nyid/ /de nas rgyud gsungs bas 'chad par 'gyur pa'i rim pas/ bdag nyid dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i 'bras bu he ru ma'i gzugs byas la/ zhes dang] so na shrī'i 'grel ba las/ dhīlas zhes bya bani ser po'o/ /'jam dpal rdo rje zhes bya bas so/ /mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag na ral sgra dang glegs bam can/rdo rje skyel krung gis bh+yor ba'i rgyu rdo rje 7ngon gyi bdag nyid can/ rgyud dang rgyud du gsungs pa'i 438
'jamadabyangs zhi khro sprugs sgrub kyi rnam bshad tsin+ta ma ṇi'iphreng mdzegrim pas 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi ngo 'or bdag nyid dur khrod kyis brgyan par bskyed/ ces 'grel ba gnyis ka nas ye shes sems dpa' mi gsal yang 'di ltar bsgom rgyusan par mngon pa'i phyir/ bcu gnyis pa yang yin te/ 〈 khu 'jigs byed kyi 'grel ba gyis zhes gnang ba byin pas slob dpon mi bskyod zhabs kyis 'di rgyu rdo rje 'edzin pa dang ye shes sems dpa' la du ma yod paradagongs nas 'jamadabyangs dpa' cig la dmigs kyis ma gsal bar dang 4 zhi bas 'dul ba na lan+dam dbyangs zhi bas 'dul ba dang] des 'dul mi nus pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis 'dul ba 〈snags tsam zhig mdzad pa'i phyir/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi dka' 'grel las/ zla ba'i ( spridī hā dī/ rdzu ༈ ( shā k+ṣiṃ gh+nā hūm̐ sna zloji ṭ+wāṃ lhaX/ rdzu r+sha dzhai/ཿ/spya ༵ pa rtswa snror+shadī lta ṭī ༵//'dir don dang po 'jam dbyangs de nyid kyi bdag nyid kyi zhi ba'i skus snang ba rnams 'dul ba ma yin par gzigs nas/ zugs sgar nyi ma la gnas par bya lte/ de'i 'od zer gyis snang ba rnams bsregs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig des na slob dasan 'di gcig pur ma zad/ slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs la yang] rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang ye shes semasadapa' mtshan gzhi tsam bzung ba yin gyi/ rang gi lugs kyi de gnyis kho na rgyud kyi donayin par 'dod pa ma yin te/ de ltar yin na/ gzhan gyi lugs dag 'gog dgos pa las ma bkag pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon mi bskyod pas kyang / dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs kyi skabs su gzhan lugs kha cig bkag kyang 'di skabs su gang gi'ang lugs ma bkag parade ltar bshad cing slob dpon de dag gis rang lugs de tsam las gzhan lugs ma mthong pa yang ma yin pa'i phyig des na rgyu mtshan de dag sogs du ma zhig shes dgos so/ /bcu gsum pa yang yin te/ de yang rgyud rtog bdun rong zom 'gyur las/ 'di ltar bdag gis rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i rdo rje 439
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kha'dzigs byed chen ṭo ma he'i gdong ba can du bdag nyidadamigasate bsgomasanas zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis 'di ltar zhes pa'i sgras ye shes sems dpa' la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' gcig dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs spur bsgoms par bstan pa'i pyir te/ de'i thad kyi lā li ta'am rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel ba mnangag gi rgyan las/de ltaradam tshig semasadapa' bskyedanasawe shes semasadapa' bsam zhing rang bzhin gyidakyil zhanar spyan drangs pa bag par bya ba'i smiga'adi ltabu rgyu zhes bya ba la sogs bgasungasate/'di ltabu rgyu lte 'jamadapalawe shes sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser 4 rang nyid rang gi snying por rtag tu nyi ma la'o//mi g.yo bani hūṃ gidamigs pa bsgom pa'o//ladesanirangagi snying dar 'jamadapalade'i snying kur nyi ma la hūṃ bsgom par bstanato/ /zhesadang/rtog bdun le'udang po las/ 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud 'aradabang bskur ba'i rnal 'phyor pas/zhes pa'i 'grol ba'ide nyid las/ rgyu rdo rje 7)na pa'i skabs sudesang ldan par gyur pa las/ lajamadapaladamar po ral sgradanga.āt+paladang ldan pa zhes pa dang] ye shes sems dpa'i skabs su yang de nyid las/ de las ma he'i gdong can spus bzhi'i mtshan nyid bskyed gasnying dar sku mdog ser po zhalagacig phyagaganyis ba'iwe shes sems dpaganyi ma'i steng du rgyudang bcas pa bsam la zhes gsungs pa'i phyirate/ 'doni dzāna.a ka ra'i mnangag la brtenanas rgyud kyidon 'tshad pa la shin nyumakhas pa gcig 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /basbzhi payang grub lte/ zhi ba'i bya ba bdun pa las/de'i lteng du.a las zla ba'idakyil pa'or bsams nagadenasa'age dhīḥlas 'jamadapalagazhon nu.ut+paladakar po bsnams pa zhigabaskyedado//zhes gsungs pa'i phyis7do'i langamadabyangs kyi phyagagayas pa mchog sbyin mdzad gagayon padzo.al bsnams pa zhi ba ye shes kyis bshad pa ltabu zhigasan par mngon la/ 'di ltar du bsgoms pas byams snying rje skye sla ba 'og nyu47dado/ /bco lnga bsangasanate/ drag po'i bya ba bdun pa las/ ye 440
'jamadabyangs zhi khro zags sgrub kyi rnam bshadatsin+tam ṇi'i phreng mdzegge a las zla ba'idakyil 'khor bsamasate/ de'i steng du 〉gis 'jamadapal gzhon nu sku mdog ser po ut+pal bsnams ba zhig bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig desan slobadapon 'dodag gis kyangagad byung masan parardo rje 'gas byed kyi rgyud las bshad pa slobadapon snga ma'i mnangaglas thos pa'am/ rang nyid la yidam gyi lhasadangos su gsung ba ci rigasasan par snang bani lo rgyus sogs du ma la brtenanas grub pa'i mir ro/ /desan mkhas spru 'dagagis kyang/ 'a ltar mdzad mod kyangaka 'dag las kyang zab pa'i gdams payod tshul 'og nyulag par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rdo rje tshig sbram gyi sa bcad kyi don la 'bru snyel ba'i sgo nas bshad na/ 'jam dbyangs zhi ba yab yum dang] do rje 'jigs byed kho 4 yab yum gnyis lha dzo r+shasdiX /paṅgi /sprim 〉pa dzor+sha rnyi pa(3 s+dza rmo ༵༵/ dz+nyo rmo / mi sbya gh+nā ñdzadī m+p+raṃ zugs sbragasanas sgrub padang/ yumadabyangs can mdang ro langs mganyis kyi sku gsung thugs /kādhi/pa lha( zlo r+shadī]k+ṣiṃ ga ṭ+wāṃ spyu sna zlozlo snarnyishārnyi 〉pa snro zu pa pa~X d+dhi r+shatā rnyilha rnyipa la/ sku khro bo'i zugs nar zhi ba bkod pa'i sku'i zhi khro sbrag sgrubadang]gsung kho bo'i sngags phyinang du 'god ba'i gsung gi zhi kho sbrag sgrubadang] zhi khro'i thugs phyag mtshan sa 'on spel ba'i zugs s+t+ri sdi //smi mru /shaṃ/ / lnga sdi shaṃ ༷༷/༷༷] snye khros dhī ༷༷ /khro ṭ+wāṃ tingange 'dzin semasadapa' ral gri bsgom pani/ 'chad pa gtso sar byed pa'i skabasacan la/ zhes 441
kun mkhyenagasung 'bum khagsungs pa'i migadonani/ rangadam tshig semasadapa' rdo rje lajigs byed zhaladagu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa kho ba'i nyamasaphungangs su rdzogs pa'i zugs spur ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsan 'gro ba smin byed dmar ser gur kum gyi mdog can g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon ut+pal la'i yu ba thugs spur 'dzin pa 'dab ma snyan gyi thad nar kha phye ba'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa sogs 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi nang ltar bsgom/ de'i zugs dar zla gdan la ting nge 'edzin sems dpa' ral sgra yu ba gser gyi rdo rje rtselnga pa phyed pas mtshan pa gyen du 'greng bar bsgom pa ni/ lha khro bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dam tshig semasadapa' byas la/ ye shes sems dpa' dang tingasnga 'dzin sems dpa' gnyis zhu dh+ri parlo ༵ na spra //༈ k+ṣiṃ pa/ ṭ+wāṃ shā spya sna n+d+ra dī/shā pa/ sdu sa (shā sngu dīpa /pa paX chi/ lha/rdzu dngaka 'di ltar zhi drag gang gtso bor bsgrub kyang gcig shos 'grub 'ong pa yin te/ 'grub rtags kyang zhi kho gnyis da'i rtags 'ong bar mkhas grub du mas nyams su myong bas grub pa'i phyig des semasadapa' sum brtsegs gzhan yang go bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed a ra pa tsan gnyis kyi sku'i zhi n+dha dzī sna( pyā shārnyi stusta hūm̐ (ngopa sta ༵ lha paXpa paX/ hūm̐ sdi ṭ+wāṃ/ gyi/ zugs spur ye shes semasadapa'/ 'jamadabyangasawe shes sems dpagade'i zugs zhar tingange 'dzin sems dpa' ral sgra bkodanas bsgom pa ni/ rtsod ba gtso 'or byed pa'i skabs yin zhing zhes gsungs pas/ don ni dam tshig sems dpa' yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi khro bo'i skur bsgomanas/ de'i shugs rkar ye shes semasadapa'ani sbyor 'jam dpal sems dpa' la zhal gcig phyag bzhi sogs du ma yod kyang sngar dz+nyā na a ka ra rjes 'brang dang bcas pas 442
